Supervisor, NOC: Lead the Team That Keeps Our Clients Running

At DYOPATH, we're looking for a Supervisor, Network Operations Center (NOC), who is passionate about developing people, driving operational excellence, and leading through high-impact situations.

This isn't a role where you'll spend all day reviewing tickets and approving schedules.

You'll be entrusted with leading a team of talented engineers, guiding critical incident response efforts, improving processes that directly impact clients, and helping shape the future of our Network Operations Center.

Whether you're a seasoned NOC leader looking for your next challenge or a high-performing NOC Lead ready to step into people leadership, we'd love to talk.

Role Details

  • Title: Supervisor, Network Operations Center
  • Location: Remote
  • Schedule: Monday–Friday, standard business hours
  • Availability: Occasional after-hours support for incidents or escalations
  • Travel: Periodic, based on client and business needs
  • Salary Range: $115,000 – $120,000

Why This Role Matters

The DYOPATH NOC is at the heart of delivering exceptional service to our clients. As Supervisor, NOC, you'll play a pivotal role in:

  • Leading and developing a team of network and systems professionals
  • Coordinating responses during major incidents and service disruptions
  • Improving operational processes and service delivery standards
  • Ensuring clients receive world-class support and communication
  • Helping build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement

Your decisions will directly influence client experience, team performance, and operational success.

What the Supervisor, NOC, Will Do

Lead and Develop Your Team

  • Coach, mentor, and support NOC engineers
  • Conduct regular one-on-one meetings and performance discussions
  • Assist in onboarding and developing technical talent
  • Foster a culture focused on teamwork, accountability, and growth

Drive Operational Excellence

  • Oversee day-to-day NOC operations
  • Ensure service level agreements (SLAs) are met
  • Manage workload distribution and team coverage
  • Monitor performance metrics and identify opportunities for improvement

Lead Through Critical Events

  • Act as a primary escalation point for complex issues
  • Coordinate technical resources during major incidents
  • Provide clear communication to clients and leadership
  • Lead post-incident reviews and continuous improvement efforts

Improve and Build

  • Enhance runbooks, processes, and documentation
  • Identify opportunities for automation and efficiency
  • Partner with leadership to strengthen operational maturity
  • Help shape the future direction of the NOC

What Makes a Successful Supervisor, NOC at DYOPATH?

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, developing people, and improving how things work. You may be an excellent fit if you:

  • Have experience leading or mentoring technical teams
  • Thrive during high-pressure incidents and escalations
  • Enjoy building processes and driving operational improvements
  • Communicate confidently with both engineers and business leaders
  • Take ownership and inspire others to do the same
  • Believe strong teams are built through coaching, trust, and accountability

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years of NOC, infrastructure operations, or related IT experience
  • Experience serving in a lead, supervisory, or management capacity
  • Experience managing incidents and escalations
  • Strong understanding of networking, systems, and service operations
  • Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences

Preferred

  • Experience in an MSP or multi-client environment
  • ITIL knowledge or certification
  • Industry certifications such as:
    • CCNA / CCNP
    • Network+
    • ITIL Foundation
    • Azure Network Engineer
    • AWS Networking Certifications

Why DYOPATH?

At DYOPATH, we're committed to helping our employees grow professionally while delivering exceptional service to our clients. As the Supervisor, NOC, you'll find:

  • ✅ Opportunities to grow your leadership career
  • ✅ Exposure to diverse technologies and client environments
  • ✅ A collaborative team that supports learning and development
  • ✅ High visibility with technical and business leadership
  • ✅ The opportunity to make a measurable impact every day

Looking to Take the Next Step?

If you're currently a NOC Lead, Senior Engineer, Technical Team Lead, or Operations Leader who's ready to expand your influence and grow into a broader leadership role, we encourage you to apply.

Come help us build a world-class NOC while growing your own career along the way. Apply today and let's get started.

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building competitive-programming problems and their automatic graders (test cases + checkers) used to train advanced AI coding models. You'll create problems, write both correct and deliberately-wrong solutions, and design the tough test cases that catch subtly-broken code. Your work is what makes the training signal trustworthy.

To apply, share: your competitive-programming handle(s) + current/peak rating, any problem-setting experience, and IOI/ICPC/olympiad history.

What you'll do

  • Write original algorithmic problems — clear statement, sound constraints, an intended solution;
  • Write correct solutions in C++ and Python;
  • Write realistic wrong solutions (common mistakes) to test against;
  • Build and harden test cases: generators, edge cases, stress and "hacking" tests;
  • Write checkers/interactors (testlib) for problems with more than one valid answer;
  • Confirm the quality bar: correct solutions pass, wrong ones fail, within time limits.

What we look for

  • Strong competitive programming background, shown by a public profile — a Codeforces rating (see levels below), OR an IOI / ICPC / national-olympiad record;
  • Fluent contest C++ (STL, complexity); comfortable writing Python;
  • Can explain why a solution is wrong and build an input that breaks it;
  • Strong written English (C1+).

Levels (by Codeforces rating, or equivalent olympiad achievement):

  • Associate — 1700–2100 (Expert / Candidate Master): easier problems;
  • Expert — 2200–2600 (Master / Grandmaster): harder problems
  • Senior / Reviewer — 2600+ (Int'l Grandmaster) or IOI/ICPC medalist: hardest problems + quality review.

Nice to have

  • IOI / ICPC alumni and top competitive programmers especially encouraged to apply;
  • Experience setting or testing problems for real contests (Codeforces rounds, ICPC, national olympiads, online judges);
  • Testlib experience (checkers, validators, generators);
  • Experience creating data for LLM code benchmarks or similar RL / evaluation datasets.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $90/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Logitech is the #1 market leader in video conferencing, with double-digit above-market growth over the past several quarters.   • Tell compelling stories. Create engaging presentations and partner/customer narratives using modern tools and technologies, including AI.
  • Own your pipeline. Maintain accurate opportunity and pipeline data, track pipeline sufficiency, and provide consistent reporting through Salesforce.
  • Bring the technology to life. Confidently demonstrate Logitech solutions in person and clearly communicate their business value.

  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and training skills, with the executive presence to engage partners and customers at multiple levels.
  • Experience managing complex or long sales cycles.
  • Strong Salesforce/CRM discipline, including pipeline management, forecasting, and reporting.
  • The ability to quickly learn, demonstrate, and articulate technology and business-value propositions.
  • Creativity in how you engage partners, market solutions, and create demand.
  • Comfort using tools such as LinkedIn and Sales Navigator to build relationships and identify opportunities.
  • The ability to balance multiple priorities while effectively leveraging internal resources to expand your reach.
  • A collaborative mindset and proven ability to build strong cross-functional relationships.
  • The energy and adaptability to thrive in a fast-moving, growing business.
  • An innovative, inclusive mindset and a genuine passion for how technology can improve the way people communicate, connect, and collaborate.

Ready to Make an Impact?

If you’re passionate about Sales, Video Collaboration and building collaborative partnerships, and delivering results that matter, we want to hear from you. Apply today and help us create a positive impact in Logitech for Business.

between $ 150K and $ 232K dependent on location and experience. In certain circumstances, higher compensation will be considered based on the business need, candidate experience, and skills.

About the role

Rubrik Professional Services is looking for a high-energy, strategic, and results-driven Senior Project Manager to lead complex, enterprise customer implementations and help shape the future of our delivery practice. In this role, you will be customer-facing, acting as a trusted advisor to ensure deployment success, business value realization, and operational efficiency.

Beyond managing high-stakes client engagements, you will serve as an expert in project management within the organization helping to mentor and coach other Project Managers and actively contributing to the development, refinement, and scaling of our PMO governance model, processes, and delivery frameworks.

What you'll do

As a Senior Project Manager in our PS Organization, you will drive impact across three core areas: Delivery Excellence, Leadership & Mentorship, and Practice Enablement.

1. Project & Client Delivery Excellence

  • Drive Complex Engagements: Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, concurrent, enterprise-level customer projects from kickoff to sign-off within fast-paced environments.
  • Scope & Milestone Management: Prepare enterprise customers for deployment, establish clear success criteria, track deliverables, set targets, manage resources, and ensure project execution adheres to deadlines and budgets.
  • Risk & Issue Governance: Proactively identify, track, and mitigate project risks and technical dependencies.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Serve as the single point of contact and escalation owner for customer executives, cross-functional internal teams (Engineering, Customer Support, Sales, Technical Account Managers), and third-party partners.
  • Quality & Performance: Execute quality control throughout project lifecycles to ensure deliverables meet or exceed Rubrik's standards and customer business objectives.

2. PMO Governance & Process Optimization

  • PMO Governance: Partner with PS leadership to help build, refine, and maintain the PMO governance framework, including standard operating procedures, project methodologies, and key performance indicators.
  • Continuous Improvement: Audit project workflows and delivery tools to identify bottlenecks, driving initiatives that enhance operational efficiency, margins, and customer satisfaction.
  • Resource & Capacity Planning: Assist in establishing best practices for resource allocation, utilization tracking, and project health reporting across the PS portfolio.

3. Leadership & Mentorship

  • Coach & Mentor: Serve as a mentor to associate and mid-level PMs, providing guidance on client management, conflict resolution, scope control, and career growth.
  • Thought Leadership: Share best practices, templates, and lessons learned across the team to foster a culture of continuous learning and high performance.

  • 8+ years of direct Project Management experience delivering customer-facing, enterprise technical projects within a Professional Services or Consulting organization.

  • Proven experience building or scaling PMO governance models supported by AI, standard delivery methodologies, and project health tracking processes.
  • Track record of managing multiple complex, high-visibility client engagements concurrently in a fast-paced technology environment.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring, coaching, and developing junior to mid-level project managers.
  • Expert knowledge of modern project management tools (e.g., Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence, Asana) as well as Google Workspace.
  • Exceptional executive communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills.

Preferred / Plus Qualifications:

Description

TripleTen es una plataforma que empodera a las personas, independientemente de su experiencia previa, para embarcarse en el emocionante y crucial camino de dominar profesiones tecnológicas. Nuestros bootcamps se enfocan en formar estudiantes en Web Development, Data Science, Data Analysis, QA Engineering, UX/UI Design y Cybersecurity, haciendo que estos campos sean accesibles y alcanzables para todos, para que puedan prosperar en una nueva carrera.

Nuestra misión es asegurar que cada estudiante tenga la oportunidad de dominar una profesión tecnológica, encontrar su propósito y convertirse en un valioso contribuidor en la industria tech. Estamos buscando expertos deCiberseguridad apasionados por la seguridad informática, con experiencia práctica y vocación para guiar a principiantes mientras construyen una base sólida en este campo clave. Este rol requiere sólidos conocimientos técnicos en ciberseguridad, habilidades de comunicación claras y empatía para apoyar e inspirar a estudiantes que están dando sus primeros pasos en esta área.

﻿¿Te gustaría ayudar a construir el futuro de otras personas a través de la educación tecnológica?

➡️ Te pedimos amablemente que envíes tu CV en inglés.

What you will do

Como experto en proyectos, liderarás a una cohorte de estudiantes a lo largo de nuestro programa de Cybersecurity, compartiendo tu experiencia e inspirándolos con tu conocimiento de la industria. Apoyarás a los estudiantes respondiendo sus preguntas y brindándoles orientación práctica de las siguientes maneras:

  • Impartiendo webinars quincenales enfocados en proyectos, guiando a los estudiantes en la aplicación práctica de conceptos de ciberseguridad y en escenarios reales.
  • Revisando los proyectos de los estudiantes y proporcionando retroalimentación detallada y constructiva dentro de las 24 horas posteriores a su entrega (esto requiere disponibilidad parcial y flexible durante los fines de semana).
  • Realizando sesiones de mentoría 1:1 bajo demanda, enfocadas en los proyectos, para ayudar a los estudiantes a superar dificultades técnicas y mantenerse motivados durante el programa.
  • Respondiendo preguntas relacionadas con los proyectos en Discord, ayudando a los estudiantes a resolver problemas y profundizar su comprensión de las prácticas de ciberseguridad.
  • Actuando como el experto y mentor de referencia, acompañando a los estudiantes mientras desarrollan sus proyectos y fortalecen sus habilidades en ciberseguridad.

Requirements

Requerimos al menos 3 años de experiencia práctica en ciberseguridad, con conocimientos en las siguientes áreas:

• Network & Architecture: comprensión de redes planas vs. segmentadas, DMZ y estrategias para reducir la superficie de ataque y el blast radius.

• Authentication & Access Abuse: conocimiento de riesgos relacionados con accesos privilegiados, uso de RDP y exportaciones sospechosas de datos.

• Incident Analysis: capacidad para investigar eventos como intentos fallidos de inicio de sesión, restablecimientos de contraseña y actividad sospechosa en cuentas utilizando frameworks como MITRE ATT&CK.

• Log Analysis: experiencia analizando logs de sistemas y seguridad para detectar anomalías o comportamientos sospechosos.

• Python Scripting: capacidad para escribir scripts que procesen logs, cuenten eventos y extraigan información útil.

• Capacidad para explicar conceptos técnicos complejos de manera clara a principiantes.

• Paciencia y empatía al apoyar a estudiantes que están iniciando en ciberseguridad.

• Nivel de inglés B1.

﻿Ventajas adicionales:

• Experiencia previa enseñando o mentoreando.

• Experiencia guiando a principiantes en temas técnicos con explicaciones paso a paso.

What we can offer you

Capacitación en técnicas de mentoría y comunicación.

  • Colaboración flexible, remota y de medio tiempo — trabaja 10-18 horas por semana.
  • Compartir experiencia con desarrolladores dentro de nuestra comunidad.
  • Ingresos promedio de $600 USD al mes por una colaboración flexible de medio tiempo, con gran impacto ¡y un equipo increíble!
  • Experiencia de colaboración intercultural en mentoría y realización de webinars.
  • Cooperación remota con un horario conveniente tanto para ti como para el equipo. No nos enfocamos en la microgestión.
  • Una oficina digital cómoda. Utilizamos herramientas digitales modernas — Miro, Notion, Zoom, etc. — para que el trabajo conjunto sea fluido.
  • Un equipo diverso y unido distribuido entre EE.UU. y América Latina.

¡Estamos emocionados de conocerte y trabajar contigo! ?

Regional Clinical Faculty

Job Summary

Regional Clinical Faculty (RCF) advise, support, educate, and evaluate students. The RCF supports and collaborates with clinical preceptors in keeping with the policies established by the University to ensure an effective clinical experience for students. The RCF provides leadership in establishing relationships within the nurse-midwifery/ nurse-practitioner community to further the goal of increasing and maintaining access to clinical sites for Frontier Nursing University (FNU) and to ensure the larger goal of increasing access to nurse-midwifery/nurse-practitioner care.The RCF participates in the ongoing development, implementation, and evaluation of the curriculum in their area of advanced practice nursing.

Major Tasks, Duties, and Responsibilities

University Related

  • Promotes the mission and philosophy of FNU.

  • Attends University, department, RCF, and faculty meetings

  • Participates in the annual Fall Faculty Meeting and Commencement as stipulated in their current FNU contract

  • Participates in Clinical and/or Frontier Boundas stipulated in their current FNU contract

  • Effectively collaborates with all departments at FNU to ensure student success and site/ preceptor satisfaction.

  • Provide service to the University through activities such as involvement in FNU shared governance (e.g., committees, workgroups), FNU sponsored activities (e.g., charity drives, community outreach activities), and/or service to the profession (e.g., presentations, professional organization committee work).

  • Adhere to the elements of the Culture of Caring

  • Other duties as assigned.

Course Related

  • Orients students to course expectations.

  • Documents student progress in course work and clinical setting at least every term via the university student retention system ( i.e., Dropout Detective).

  • Maintains currency in areas of expertise through clinical practice, literature review, participation in continuing education programs, etc.

  • Assigns grades and maintains course grade book and student records, meeting timeline requirements for grade submission.

Service

  • Participates in course teams

  • Participates in standing and/or ad hoc committees of FNU

  • Participates in professional organizations; acts as a representative of FNU in furthering nurse-midwifery and/or nurse practitioner education and/or practice.

  • Participates in the mentorship of other faculty members.

  • Provides service to the home community.

Student Involvement – Preclinical period

  • Communicates effectively with students, demonstrating respect and professionalism.

  • Respond to student-initiated contact after Frontier Bound to discuss the role of RCF and general plans for clinical practicum.

  • Works collaboratively with the Clinical Outreach and Placement Unit to support students in the clinical site identification process.

  • Conducts Question & Answer sessions to support students’ clinical plan development.

  • Reviews and approves the student’s Clinical Plan approximately four to six months prior to Clinical Bound and as needed.

  • Works collaboratively with the Clinical Credentialing Department to ensure the clinical site and preceptor quality assurance measures are maintained.

  • Assign Clinical Bound dates for the students following the confirmation of a clinical site and completion of the clinical site approval form.

  • Conducts a pre-clinical orientation session prior to the Clinical Bound term to review the clinical course requirements, policies, and processes.

Student Involvement - Clinical period

  • Creates a social, cognitive, and teaching presence during courses through twice-monthly meetings with assigned students.

  • Maintains accessibility to students enrolled in the course through email, forums, phone calls, and other means of communication as outlined in the Faculty Handbook.

  • Reviews and evaluates clinical course assignments, student evaluation tools, and students’ clinical documentation.

  • Completes evaluation of clinical students on-site or virtually.

  • Advises students for course registration for each term following Clinical Bound.

  • Works with students and the Clinical Director to help students maintain Satisfactory Academic Progress.

  • Coordinates and verifies end-of-clinical details.

  • Works with the students and preceptor to identify and find solutions to clinical problems

Clinical Site and Preceptor Evaluation

  • Completes and submits clinical site and preceptor evaluations.

Preceptor Support

  • Provides preceptors with guidance in student interactions.

  • Orients preceptors to FNU clinical policies and processes

  • Provides access to FNU courses and guidebooks for preceptor resources

  • Encourages preceptors to participate in preceptor education and programs related to precepting.

  • Maintains contact with the clinical student’s primary clinical preceptor at least monthly.

Scholarship

  • Participates in scholarly work through publication, grant writing, presentations, Doctor of Nursing Practice (DNP) project participation, scholarly consultation, and/or other scholarly endeavors.

Required Skills/Abilities

  • Skilled in communication, problem-solving, computer literacy, management, and organization preferred.

Education and Experience:

  • Nationally certified in an appropriate advanced practice role.

  • Active in the nurse-midwifery or nurse practitioner community.

  • Doctorate in Nursing (or working toward) or related field.

  • Experience in precepting students is preferred.

  • Unencumbered license to practice

Physical Requirements:

  • Able to travel routinely

  • Sit/stand for long periods

  • Able to lift 40 lbs

Work Location:

  • Remote

  • Must be physically located in one of the following Northeastern U.S. states: Connecticut, Maine, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, or Vermont.

Reporting Relationship

  • The Regional Clinical Faculty reports to the Clinical Director based on specialty areas.

WHO WE ARE:

The National Multiple Sclerosis Society mobilizes people and resources to drive research for a cure and to address the challenges of everyone affected by MS. To fulfill this mission, the Society funds cutting-edge research, drives change through advocacy, facilitates professional education, collaborates with MS organizations around the world, and provides programs and services designed to help people with MS and their families move their lives forward. We partner with volunteers to accomplish our work. Staff members engage volunteers through effective and timely communications, facilitating meaningful opportunities, and continually seeking and providing feedback for reciprocal growth and learning.

Job Summary:

The Assistant Vice President (AVP), Foundation Relations is responsible for building and sustaining a high-performing foundation relations team. This role focuses on building a best-in-class foundation fundraising mechanism at the National MS Society, including developing strategy, processes, guidelines, tools and resources to significantly grow foundation support.

The ideal candidate will support and strength existing foundation relationships and drive the acquisition of new foundation partners aligned with the organization’s mission. The AVP plays a critical role in developing strategic approaches to foundation engagement, ensuring efficient and effective grant management, and contributing to the organization’s overall fundraising growth and sustainability. This is a role for a builder, someone who enjoys taking on a new challenge and working through the complexities of standing up a robust fundraising function, positioned for significant success in the long term.

Location Requirements

  • Remote - Flexible Location

  • ​Work is primarily performed remotely, however, when possible and necessary, teams meet in person to conduct the business of the organization and build team relationships.

  • Ability to travel approximately 20%

Compensation | Benefits:

The estimated hiring compensation range for this role is $120,000 - $140,000. Final offers will be based on the candidate's geographic location, consider career experience, and may vary from this range due to these and other factors.

You will have the opportunity for a highly competitive, comprehensive benefit package that the Society provides to employees.

Your benefits include:

  • Considerable Paid Time Off Plan

  • Paid Holidays

  • 401k Retirement Savings Plan with Society match

  • Commuter Benefit Plan

Comprehensive Health & Welfare benefits including:

  • Medical

  • Dental

  • Vision

  • Flex Spending Accounts

  • Life Insurance

  • Disability Coverage

  • Spring Health Membership offering free therapy and professional coaching, as well as additional voluntary benefit offerings.

Not to mention, you will join an incredible mission focused team of people!

Main Responsibilities:

  • Partner with the VP, Corporate, Industry and Foundation Partnerships to develop, lead, and mentor a national Foundation Relations team to support foundation engagement, grant management, acquisition strategy, and relationship stewardship.

  • Oversee backend operational processes related to foundation fundraising, including proposal development, submission tracking, reporting, compliance management, and managing deadlines.

  • Personally manage a portfolio of grantmaking foundations and government agencies.

  • Develop and execute acquisition strategies for identifying, cultivating, and stewarding new foundation partners to expand the organization’s funding base.

  • Partner with senior leadership to align foundation fundraising strategies with the organization’s strategic priorities and mission goals.

  • Work cross functionally to build new funding opportunities aligned with foundation funding landscape, key priority areas and National MS Society strategic plan and funding pillars.

  • Implement best practices and tools to streamline foundation grant workflows and enhance data tracking and reporting accuracy.

  • Provide guidance and support to cross-functional teams on foundation grant requirements and reporting standards.

  • Use data analytics and market research to identify emerging funding opportunities and philanthropic trends.

  • Ensure compliance with foundation grant terms and conditions, managing risk and maintaining positive funder relationships.

  • Represent the organization externally in foundation networks and at industry conferences to raise profile and foster partnerships.

  • Prepare regular reports and analysis on foundation fundraising performance for senior leadership.

  • At this career level, you are leading by developing the skills of the people reporting to you and helping them be successful in their roles.

What We're Looking for:

  • 8 years of demonstrated and relevant fundraising experience (including 6 years of team leadership and supervision) with advanced understanding of prospect qualification, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.

  • Record of leadership and accomplishment in fundraising including campaign planning and execution, pipeline development, and mid-level revenue generation across multiple markets.

  • Able to assess staff talent, mentor, and train others toward a shared vision, providing strategic guidance to ensure staff meet their designated revenue and activity goals.

  • Proven ability to manage broad and technical fundraising campaigns, collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams to secure grant funding.

  • Demonstrated success in coaching staff to higher levels of gift closure and performance and guiding leadership staff through portfolio management, holding reporting and non-reporting staff accountable to identified revenue and donor targets.

  • Experience developing and monitoring budgets and targets, and assessing and adjusting team portfolios to ensure goals are met

  • Proven nonprofit leadership experience with increasing responsibility, successfully driving 6+ figure partnerships.

  • Familiarity with AI, predictive analytics, and CRM tools to optimize sales pipeline automation, donor journey mapping, and forecasting donor trends to enhance retention and maximize event success.

  • Extensive experience managing geographically dispersed teams, in remote and hybrid environments, overseeing both revenue generation and project execution.

  • Track record of implementing innovative fundraising strategies that drive engagement and revenue growth.

  • Strong ability to perform under pressure, handle criticism professionally, and consistently meet fundraising commitments.

  • Exceptional project management, strategic planning, and negotiation skills to drive effective resource allocation and optimize fundraising outcomes.

  • Advanced CRM expertise, leveraging data analytics to drive decision-making and train teams on data-driven fundraising strategies.

We’re committed to supporting the growth of every employee through a structured and transparent approach to career development. We use Talent Portraits to define clear expectations, development opportunities, and advancement paths — whether you're growing as a people leader or deepening your expertise as an individual contributor. Each role is thoughtfully placed within one of these pathways (Leadership or Partner) to help you understand how it fits into our broader organization and your potential career journey.

This position is classified as Leader - Leading Others.

The National MS Society is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We strive to create a workforce that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. We need you and your unique talents and perspectives to help us write the last chapter on MS.

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS:

We appreciate your consideration of our job opportunities and strive to make it as effortless as possible to apply for our positions. With only a few required sections and the option to use our resume parsing tool, we aim to streamline the application experience, saving you time and effort. Additionally, if you wish to include a cover letter with your application, please feel free to attach it along with your resume, and any other documents required, to the Resume/CV document upload section at the bottom of the My Experience page. We appreciate your interest in joining our team and look forward to receiving your application!

Important: You will not be able to modify your application after you submit it. The "My Experience" page is the only opportunity to add your cover letter and supporting document attachments. If you experience any trouble submitting your materials, please check out our FAQ & Contact Us page.

Job Title: Senior Medical Director, Hematology/Oncology

Job Location: Durham, North Carolina, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Posting Title- Senior Medical Director, Hematology/Oncology

Location: Home-based in the U.S. or Canada

Job Overview

The Senior Medical Director (Hematology/Oncology) is a strategic medical leader who provides scientific, clinical, and operational oversight across global clinical research programs. Acting as Medical Monitor, this role serves as the primary medical interface between IQVIA, sponsors, and investigative sites—ensuring high-quality, compliant, and efficient trial execution.

The role provides hands-on medical oversight, guiding protocol interpretation, eligibility, compliance, and safety, including medical data review and review of critical clinical data (e.g., alert laboratory results) and timely response to urgent medical queries to ensure patient safety and study continuity.

Essential Functions

  • Provides medical and scientific input to clinical research programs including review of new business proposals, preclinical and/or clinical data, study protocols, training materials, informed consent, Investigator Drug Brochures, eCRFs, analysis plan designs, clinical study reports, regulatory approval submissions, serious and non-serious adverse event evaluation and reporting
  • Ensures medical activities run according to GCP and operate with highest efficiency
  • Establishes and maintains a network of medical/scientific consultants, etc.

Clinical Leadership & Study Execution

  • Support site selection, investigator engagement, and patient recruitment/retention strategies
  • Train study teams and investigators on protocol and therapeutic area
  • Develop and oversee medical monitoring plans and serve as the primary medical resource for study teams and sites

Safety & Medical Oversight

  • Ensure medical oversight of patient safety, including ongoing assessment of the study safety profile
  • Review and interpret safety data, including SAEs and critical clinical data, ensuring accuracy and appropriate follow-up
  • Support safety reporting activities and collaborate with sponsors and internal safety teams
  • Manage unblinding procedures when required and contribute to regulatory interactions as needed

Data Review & Reporting

  • Provide medical review of clinical data, including eCRFs, tables, and listings, to ensure accuracy and consistency
  • Contribute to data interpretation and support development of clinical study reports

Business Development & Strategy

  • Support proposal development, feasibility assessments, and client presentations
  • Provide medical expertise to strengthen study design and strategic positioning in new business opportunities

Additional Contributions

  • Support development of internal processes, training, and quality improvement initiatives
  • Contribute to scientific literature review and medical input across projects as needed

Qualifications & Experience

  • MD from an accredited, internationally recognized medical school
  • 5–7+ years of clinical experience as a licensed physician within the relevant specialty (Oncology, Hematology, Surgical Oncology, or Urology with oncologic focus)
  • Board certification or eligibility in the relevant therapeutic area strongly preferred or equivalent experience.
  • Proven experience in clinical research (≥3 years) as a study physician/investigator or within Pharma, CRO, or Biotech environments

Key Competencies

  • Strong ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary and matrixed global teams, driving alignment and consensus
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage complex projects with shifting timelines and requirements
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to translate complex medical concepts into clear, actionable insights

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

STAY AWESOME: Tandem Diabetes Care is proud to manufacture and sell the Tandem Mobi system and t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control-IQ+ technology — an advanced predictive algorithm that automates insulin delivery. But we’re so much more than that. Our company’s human-centered approach to design, development, and support delivers innovative products and services for people who use insulin. Because many of our own team members live with type 1 diabetes, or have a loved one impacted by diabetes, the work is personal, and we are committed to the cause. Learn more at tandemdiabetes.com

A DAY IN THE LIFE:

BP6

As our international business continues to expand across Europe and beyond, we are looking for a highly experienced Senior Corporate Counsel, International to help support our growth, navigate complex legal landscapes, and serve as a trusted advisor to business leaders across multiple markets.

Reporting to the Vice President, International Legal, this role will play a critical part in supporting Tandem's continued expansion, including direct market growth internationally , together with our distributor markets.

This remote or home-based position is preferably located in Switzerland. We will also consider candidates based in the United Kingdom, or possibly other European locations who can effectively support Tandem's broader international business.

Our International Legal team partners closely with commercial, marketing, distribution, regulatory, compliance, privacy, HR, and leadership teams across Europe, the Middle East, and other international markets. This is an opportunity to join a growing, highly visible team where your expertise will directly influence business decisions, manage risk, and support sustainable international growth.

A DAY IN THE LIFE:

As Senior Corporate Counsel, International, you will serve as a strategic legal partner supporting a broad range of international commercial and operational matters. You will independently manage complex legal issues while balancing business objectives, patient needs, and regulatory requirements.

  • Draft, review, negotiate, and interpret a wide range of commercial agreements, including distribution, procurement, supplier, sales, marketing, and commercial partnership contracts.

  • Partner with sales, marketing, distribution, and senior business leaders to provide concise, practical, and risk-based legal advice that enables commercial growth.

  • Support a portfolio of direct and distributor markets across Europe, including Germany, Austria, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Benelux, France, Spain, and Portugal, as well as Scandinavia, Central Europe, the Middle East, and additional international territories. Exact territory ownership will reflect the successful candidate's profile.

  • Advise on commercial, regulatory, product, contractual, privacy, compliance, and operational matters affecting international markets.

  • Support public procurement and tender opportunities, including NHS and European healthcare purchasing processes, by reviewing contractual terms, assessing risk, and advising commercial leaders on practical implications.

  • Collaborate with US-based legal specialists in regulatory and product law, compliance, privacy, cybersecurity, intellectual property, employment law, and other specialist areas.

  • Support HR on complex employment and labor-law matters, particularly during workforce expansion into new countries, and manage external counsel where specialist advice is required.

  • Monitor evolving developments in medical device regulation, healthcare reimbursement, digital health, artificial intelligence, data privacy, and related international legal frameworks.

  • Contribute to legal process improvements, training, knowledge sharing, and horizon-scanning initiatives that prepare the business for future legal, regulatory, and compliance risks.

  • Operate independently, prioritize a diverse workload, and help stakeholders distinguish material risks from manageable issues while identifying workable business solutions.

EXTRA AWESOME:

We are excited to meet candidates who bring:

  • A law degree and qualification as a lawyer, solicitor, barrister, or equivalent legal professional in England and Wales, Switzerland, Germany, or another major European jurisdiction.

  • 12+ years of post-qualification legal experience, including at least 5 years in an in-house commercial legal role.

  • Significant experience in medical devices, diagnostics, healthcare technology, life sciences, or a closely related regulated industry. Candidates with a pharmaceutical background should also bring relevant MedTech or diagnostics exposure.

  • Strong commercial contract drafting, negotiation, interpretation, and risk management expertise.

  • Experience advising sales, marketing, distribution, procurement, and senior business stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions and cultures.

  • Knowledge of medical device regulation, healthcare reimbursement systems, public procurement and tender processes, data privacy, and emerging digital health regulation.

  • A pragmatic, solutions-oriented approach, sound judgment, high integrity, and the confidence to operate independently with senior stakeholders.

  • Fluent English and German language. French language skills are beneficial but not essential.

  • Some experience with employment law, contentious matters, intellectual property, or healthcare marketing and promotion would be advantageous.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

  • The opportunity to support a rapidly growing international MedTech business at an exciting stage of expansion.

  • High visibility and direct partnership with senior business and legal leaders.

  • A high-tech environment, excellent working conditions, meaningful autonomy, and stimulating work in an innovative field.

  • Exposure to varied legal challenges spanning commercial, regulatory, compliance, digital health, privacy, employment, procurement, and international market development.

  • The ability to influence strategic business decisions across multiple international markets while working with experienced and motivated teams.

  • A flexible remote or home-based working model. Switzerland is the preferred location, with strong consideration for candidates based the United Kingdom, or other European countries.

  • The chance to support healthcare technologies that make a meaningful difference in people's lives every day.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE:
At Tandem, we believe joy fuels excellence. That's why we've built a workplace that celebrates your achievements and supports your well-being. Our team thrives on pushing boundaries and fostering growth, all while maintaining a spirit of fun and camaraderie. This is just one of the ways we stay awesome!

BE YOU, WITH US!

We embrace the value that every single one of us brings to the table. But sometimes we forget that when we don’t meet 100% of a job description’s criteria – maybe you’re feeling that way right now? We encourage you to apply anyway. Because we want you to be you, with us.

Tandem is firmly committed to being an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender identity or expression, marriage/civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity, or sexual orientation. We are an inclusive organization, and we welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. Selection for roles will be based on individual merit alone.

REFERRALS:
We love a good referral! If you know someone who would be a great fit for this position, please share!

Make a move that matters. Join Tandem Diabetes Care, where we're turning challenges into triumphs every day and where your talents will help shape a healthier, happier tomorrow.

Summary:

Goldschmitt & Associates is seeking an Enterprise Data/ CRM Architect to provide senior architecture leadership across Federal Student Aid's enterprise data environment, Common Data Model, customer-service platforms, integrations, analytics, and downstream data consumers.

The Enterprise Data / CRM Architect will help FSA create a coherent architecture for how borrower, loan, servicing, operational, and customer-interaction data is defined, governed, shared, and consumed across enterprise systems.

This role operates above individual pipelines or applications. The architect will define how the Common Data Model, Business Needs Layer, APIs, integration services, CRM/customer-care platforms, NSLDS, analytics environments, and other FSA systems work together while maintaining consistent data meaning, ownership, security, lineage, quality, and lifecycle controls.

The Enterprise Data/ CRM Architect must combine strong enterprise data architecture with enough application and integration knowledge to understand how data is created and used across business processes. The architect will work closely with the Senior Data Engineer, Enterprise Integration Architect, CDM Platform Engineer, Analytics Engineer, product leadership, and FSA enterprise architecture teams.

FSA's modernization requires a governed enterprise data capability that normalizes heterogeneous servicer data, improves quality and timeliness, and supports analytics, integrations, and future borrower-facing capabilities.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Lead enterprise data architecture across FSA's Common Data Model, Business Needs Layer, CRM/customer-service platforms, servicer integrations, NSLDS, analytics environments, and downstream consumers
  • Define the target-state architecture for how borrower, loan, servicing, customer-interaction, and operational data flows through the enterprise
  • Establish architecture principles for authoritative data sources, canonical data structures, shared definitions, data ownership, and system-of-record responsibilities
  • Define relationships between source-system models, the CDM, semantic/business layers, CRM structures, APIs, analytical models, and downstream applications
  • Guide development and evolution of canonical enterprise data models
  • Define approaches for schema versioning, compatibility, data lifecycle management, and controlled evolution of enterprise data structures
  • Review proposed source-to-CDM mappings and ensure transformations preserve business meaning and support enterprise reuse
  • Partner with the Senior Data Engineer on schema design, conformance rules, validation strategies, and complex source-data decisions
  • Define how customer and borrower information should be represented consistently across CRM, servicing, analytical, and digital-service environments
  • Identify duplicate, conflicting, or overlapping data definitions across platforms and recommend a target enterprise model
  • Establish patterns for data mastered in one system but consumed or enriched in another
  • Define architecture for data synchronization, event-driven data exchange, APIs, data products, and other enterprise access patterns
  • Partner with the Enterprise Integration Architect to ensure interface and integration patterns support the enterprise data model
  • Establish requirements for data contracts between producers and consumers
  • Define architecture standards for data quality, lineage, metadata, cataloging, stewardship, and governance
  • Ensure architecture supports traceability from source through transformation to downstream consumption
  • Define appropriate controls for sensitive borrower and financial information, including access, security, privacy, auditability, and least-privilege use
  • Evaluate the architecture impacts of read-only near-real-time servicer integration and future bi-directional exchange
  • Assess the impact of proposed UBP and customer-service capabilities on enterprise data structures and data services without defining out-of-scope UBP features
  • Identify technical debt, redundant data movement, tightly coupled integrations, and other architecture patterns that limit reuse or product agility
  • Develop architecture decision records, reference architectures, data-flow diagrams, data lifecycle plans, interface patterns, and phased modernization roadmaps
  • Evaluate alternative architectures and clearly document tradeoffs involving cost, complexity, scalability, reliability, security, data quality, and maintainability
  • Support architecture reviews and provide independent technical recommendations to FSA leadership
  • Work with product leaders to ensure data architecture decisions support measurable business and borrower outcomes
  • Work with analytics and HCD teams to ensure enterprise data structures are understandable and useful to business consumers
  • Help establish an architecture that allows FSA to evolve data products and services without repeatedly rebuilding point-to-point transformations
  • Mentor engineers and architects on enterprise data architecture practices and promote consistent standards across teams and contractors
Necessary Skills and Knowledge:
  • Significant experience designing enterprise data architectures across multiple applications and organizational domains
  • Strong experience with canonical data models, enterprise data models, or Common Data Models
  • Experience designing data integration patterns across transactional systems, APIs, event streams, analytical platforms, and enterprise applications
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, relational and analytical data structures, schema design, metadata, lineage, and data quality
  • Experience defining systems of record, authoritative data sources, data ownership, and enterprise data domains
  • Strong understanding of APIs, integration architecture, event-driven systems, and distributed application environments
  • Experience with enterprise CRM or customer-service platforms and the customer/borrower data models that support them
  • Experience designing data architecture for complex legacy modernization efforts
  • Ability to understand both logical business models and physical implementation constraints
  • Experience developing architecture roadmaps, reference architectures, architecture decision records, and phased migration strategies
  • Strong understanding of security, privacy, access control, and audit requirements for sensitive enterprise data
  • Ability to evaluate technical alternatives and explain architecture decisions to both technical and executive audiences
  • Strong collaboration skills across application, integration, data, cloud, security, analytics, product, and business teams
Minimum Qualifications:
  • Possess at least 12 years of experience in enterprise architecture, data architecture, solution architecture, CRM architecture, or related technical roles
  • Possess the ability to pass a 6C Public Trust investigation, including US citizenship
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Federal Government enterprise architecture experience
  • Department of Education or Federal Student Aid experience
  • Financial services, lending, loan servicing, or other highly regulated transactional data experience
  • Experience with borrower, customer, account, transaction, or servicing data models
  • Experience with Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, ServiceNow CSM, or another large enterprise CRM/customer-service platform
  • Experience with Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, or comparable modern data-platform technologies
  • Experience with cloud-based enterprise data architecture
  • Experience with REST APIs, event streaming, API gateways, and data contracts
  • Experience implementing master/reference data management or enterprise data-governance capabilities
  • Familiarity with Zero Trust, FISMA, FedRAMP, and federal privacy/security requirements
  • Experience supporting enterprise analytics, semantic layers, data catalogs, and governed self-service data environments

It is intended to describe the general nature and work responsibilities of the position. Do you enjoy consultative selling, uncovering customer needs, and delivering solutions that create meaningful impact?

About the Role

As an Inside Account Manager, you will manage a portfolio of academic and government customers, serving as a trusted advisor throughout the customer lifecycle. You will be responsible for driving customer engagement, subscription renewals, adoption of Elsevier solutions, and strategic growth opportunities across a defined territory.

Working collaboratively with field account managers, product specialists, customer consultants, and internal business partners, you will develop long-term relationships with library leaders, researchers, faculty, administrators, and government stakeholders to support their research, teaching, and learning objectives while contributing to Elsevier's business growth.

Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of academic and government accounts, building long-term relationships with customers and serving as their primary inside sales contact.

  • Drive customer retention by managing subscription renewals, identifying risks, and developing strategies that maximize customer value and long-term partnerships.

  • Conduct proactive customer outreach through phone, email, virtual meetings, and digital engagement to strengthen relationships, increase product adoption, and uncover expansion opportunities.

  • Understand institutional priorities, research initiatives, funding environments, and collection development needs to recommend solutions aligned with customer objectives.

  • Identify opportunities to expand Elsevier's portfolio, including journal subscriptions, eBooks, databases, research intelligence solutions, AI-enabled products, and workflow tools.

  • Develop pricing proposals, renewal strategies, and business cases while negotiating within established pricing and commercial guidelines.

  • Manage the complete sales process from opportunity identification through forecasting, proposal development, contract execution, and post-sale follow-up.

  • Partner closely with Field Account Managers to execute strategic account plans and coordinate customer engagement across complex accounts.

  • Collaborate with Product Specialists, Customer Consultants, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences.

  • Maintain accurate account plans, opportunity pipelines, forecasts, and customer activity within Salesforce and other CRM systems.

  • Monitor market trends, competitive activity, higher education funding, and government research priorities to identify new growth opportunities.

  • Meet or exceed assigned renewal, revenue, and growth objectives while maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

  • Experience in account management, inside sales, customer success, or consultative B2B sales.

  • Experience working with academic institutions, libraries, government agencies, research organizations, or other knowledge-based customers is preferred.

  • Strong consultative selling, relationship management, and customer engagement skills.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to interact effectively with librarians, faculty, researchers, procurement professionals, and institutional leaders.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple customer relationships and prioritize competing demands in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms to manage pipelines, forecasts, and customer engagement.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret customer usage, trends, and business needs to develop strategic recommendations.

  • Proven ability to negotiate and manage subscription renewals while identifying opportunities for revenue growth.

  • Highly collaborative with the ability to work across cross-functional teams to deliver customer-focused solutions.

Work in a Way That Works for You

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

Working Pattern

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

About the Business

A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world's grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.

Join a mission-driven team that's transforming global compliance.

Registrar Corp’s mission is to promote consumer health and safety by providing over 32,000 food, cosmetic, medical device, and drug clients in 180 countries with compliance software and services. We're a fast growing team spanning 21 offices worldwide and always looking for talented and dedicated professionals to join us.

The Global Sales team plays a crucial role in educating both prospective and current international and US clients on U.S. Food and Drug Administration requirements for drugs and cosmetics. As an account executive within our team, you will be a pivotal regulatory resource, responsible for selling Registrar Corp’s solutions and services. In this role, you will manage the full sale cycle and actively engage with new businesses and clients through outbound calls while also managing tradeshow and webinar contacts.

If you are a motivated and ambitious individual with a passion for sales, regulatory compliance, and customer success, then we want to hear from you!

Position Summary:

The Account Executive is responsible for driving new business growth by managing the full sales cycle for our cosmetic and drug services and solutions. This role focuses on prospecting and engaging internal and domestic clients, generating opportunities through proactive outbound sales activities, and developing strong client relationships. The Account Executive identifies customer needs, delivers tailored solutions, negotiates contracts, and closes business while collaborating cross-functionally to ensure exceptional client experiences and successful project execution. Success in this role requires strong consultative selling skills, business development expertise, and the ability to consistently achieve revenue and activity goals in a fast-paced, regulated services environment.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Manage the entire sales cycle, which includes lead qualification (BANT), identifying key decision makers and initiating new sales opportunities, securing meetings with prospects, delivering sales presentations, communicating value propositions, and negotiating contracts

  • Develop and maintain a working knowledge of U.S. FDA requirements for cosmetics and drugs to best assist prospective and current clients

  • Expand international and US sales in existing accounts by introducing new products and services while finding customer solutions

  • Communicate cross culturally with business executives, managers, and supervisory-level contacts

  • 100% quota attainment through self-generated, webinar, and trade show leads

Required Qualifications:

  • 1-2 years of experience in an outbound sales role managing the full sales cycle, including prospecting, lead generation, opportunity development, and closing new business.

  • Demonstrated passion for identifying, sourcing, and developing new business opportunities through proactive outreach and market research.

  • Experience performing product demonstrations and utilizing a consultative sales approach to diagnose client needs, build relationships, and deliver tailored solutions.

  • Skilled in conducting outbound prospecting activities while effectively managing inbound leads to maximize pipeline growth, customer engagement, and revenue generation.

  • Strong technical and computer skills, including proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and CRM systems.

  • Ability to travel up to 40% domestically and internationally for trade shows, conferences, client meetings, and company headquarters in Hampton, VA.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Foreign language skills (particularly Spanish or Korean) highly desired

  • Knowledge of U.S. Food and Drug Administration requirements for drugs and cosmetics

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Business Administration, Marketing, or Public Relations preferred

Why Join Registrar Corp?

  • Remote eligible position

  • Base salary of $55,000 per year with performance-based commission paid monthly for an OTE of 103k

  • Healthy life/work balance

  • Paid time-off and holiday pay

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with company match

  • Fast paced, collaborative work environment

raw.excerpt: Kyverna Therapeutics is a patient-centered, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing cell therapies for patients suffering from autoimmune diseases.
raw.description:
Kyverna Therapeutics is a patient-centered, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing cell therapies for patients suffering from autoimmune diseases. Guided by our core values, Stay True to Why, Collaborate to Accelerate, Lead with Clarity, Boldly Innovative, and Own the Outcome, we are committed to transforming the future of treatment for autoimmune disease. Join us at the forefront of cell therapy innovation and help redefine what’s possible.

Position Overview

Kyverna is seeking Medical Science Liaison (MSL)/Senior Medical Science Liaison (MSL) to join the Medical Affairs organization. The MSL will serve as a field-based scientific expert supporting external engagement with healthcare professionals, investigators, treatment centers, and key opinion leaders (KOLs) focused on autoimmune diseases and cell therapy.

The ideal candidate will bring strong scientific expertise, exceptional relationship-building skills, and experience supporting complex specialty therapies within biotechnology or pharmaceutical environments. This individual will play a critical role in communicating scientific and clinical data, gathering field insights, and supporting the continued development of Kyverna’s CAR-T therapy programs.

Location: Remote ideally based NM, TX, OK, KS, Missouri

Travel: Approximately 50-70%

Responsibilities

  • Scientific Engagement & KOL Management
    • Identify, establish, and maintain high‑quality scientific relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs), investigators, academic medical centers, community physicians, pharmacists, nurses, and treatment centers within the assigned territory.
    • Serve as a trusted scientific partner by providing fair‑balanced, accurate, and compliant scientific exchange related to disease state, treatment landscape, Kyverna’s CAR‑T programs, and emerging clinical data.
    • Act as a primary scientific liaison to investigators interested in clinical research collaborations and investigator‑initiated research discussions, in alignment with company policies.
    • Territory Strategy & Field Medical Planning
      • Develop and execute geography‑specific Medical Affairs and KOL engagement plans aligned with therapeutic area objectives, investigator needs, and Kyverna’s medical strategy.
      • Demonstrate ownership of the assigned territory through stakeholder mapping, prioritization, and proactive planning to influence the patient journey and support optimal therapeutic decision‑making.
      • Partner with other Kyverna field medical colleagues to share insights and coordinate external engagement approaches where appropriate.
      • Clinical Development & Trial Support
        • Collaborate with Clinical Development and Clinical Operations colleagues to support Kyverna‑sponsored clinical trials, including:
        • Identification of potential trial sites
        • Engagement with participating investigators
        • Support of trial awareness and scientific dialogue
        • Contribute to efforts aimed at enhancing trial feasibility and enrollment through appropriate scientific engagement with investigators and treatment centers.
        • Medical Insights & Internal Collaboration
          • Capture and communicate timely, high‑quality medical insights related to the autoimmune and cell therapy landscape to internal stakeholders to support strategy and evidence planning.
          • Translate external scientific perspectives into actionable insights that inform medical, clinical, and development decision‑making.
          • Collaborate cross‑functionally with Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Commercial, Market Access, and Patient Services teams while maintaining strict non‑promotional boundaries.
          • Scientific Representation & Compliance
            • Provide scientific support at national, regional, and local congresses, advisory boards, investigator meetings, and medical education forums.
            • Respond compliantly to unsolicited medical information requests and serve as an internal and external scientific resource.
            • Maintain current knowledge of therapeutic areas, treatment guidelines, clinical research processes, and cell therapy operational considerations, including treatment center workflows where applicable.
            • Ensure timely completion of CRM documentation, administrative tasks, required training, and pharmacovigilance responsibilities, including adverse event and product complaint reporting.
            • Conduct all activities in full compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies.

Qualifications

    • Advanced scientific or clinical degree required (MD, PharmD, PhD, DNP, NP, PA, or equivalent).
    • Medical Science Liaison (MSL) requires Doctorate degree OR Master’s degree & 3 years of Medical Affairs experience
    • Senior Medical Science Liaison (Senior MSL) requires Doctorate degree & 2 years of Medical Affairs experience OR Master’s degree & 6 years of Medical Affairs experience
    • Prior experience in cell therapy, CAR-T, immunology, rheumatology, nephrology, neurology, hematology/oncology, or rare diseases strongly preferred.
    • Strong understanding of clinical trial design, clinical development, and medical affairs functions.
    • Experience engaging with academic medical centers, specialty treatment centers, and/or infusion centers preferred.
    • Ability to interpret and communicate complex scientific and clinical information to diverse audiences.
    • Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills.

About Us:

Datacor is the leading provider of software solutions, including ERP, CRM, Asset Tracking, Simulation and Formulation, to the process manufacturing space. We are on a mission to better equip the industry with software solutions and move it forward by building thoughtful, intuitive products that solve our customers’ most difficult problems.

We are passionate about serving our customers and helping them use data as a competitive advantage. Our customers make products that extend and sustain lives by sanitizing, fertilizing, beautifying, cleaning, and recycling the world we live in. We at Datacor help our customers make those products you use every day more safely, cost effectively and more efficiently through our technology platforms and applications.

The Role:

We are seeking a Lead Salesforce Architect to own both the architecture of our Salesforce platform and the team that builds on it. Salesforce is the system of record for how Datacor sells, services, and renews across a growing portfolio of business units. You will set the architectural direction, define the standards, and make the design decisions that ensure the platform scales with the business and doesn’t constrain.

This is a hands-on leadership role reporting to the VP of IT & CISO. You will lead a team of internal administrators and external partners, growing the internal team as the platform does. This role will partner with leaders across Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, Finance, and Operations to translate business strategy into a platform roadmap and holding the teams accountable for delivering it. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable defending an architectural decision to an executive audience and reviewing a colleague’s solution design before it ships.

Our platform includes Salesforce CPQ running subscription pricing for enterprise SaaS, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud portals for customers and partners, Agentforce, and a significant body of custom development.

Strategic and Architectural Leadership:

  • Own the architecture and delivery of the migration to Revenue Cloud, including target-state revenue process design, product and pricing model, data migration, and a phasing plan that does not disrupt the business mid-quarter.
  • Own the multi-year Salesforce platform roadmap, aligning platform investment to business outcomes and sequencing work against company strategy.
  • Make and defend build-versus-buy and build-versus-configure recommendations, including the evaluation and selection of AppExchange solutions and implementation partners.
  • Own the integrations and data architecture connecting upstream/downstream systems, including integration patterns, middleware strategy, master data management, and data governance.
  • Lead the architectural onboarding of acquisitions and new business units onto the platform, assessing the acquired environment, defining the target state, and planning the migration, consolidation, and data conversion.
  • Establish and enforce architectural standards, design patterns, and a governance model that keeps decisions consistent as the number of stakeholders grows.
  • Serve as the design authority for significant changes, reviewing solution designs before build and maintaining an explicit, prioritized technical debt backlog.
  • Own the release and DevOps strategy, including source control, environment and sandbox management, and the deployment pipelines.
  • Translate the Salesforce roadmap – new releases, retiring features, and licensing model changes into a plan for the business, and advise leadership on the cost, risk, and opportunity in each.
  • Partner closely with Information Security on platform security architecture, access model design, and audit and compliance requirements.

Team Leadership:

  • Lead, develop, and retain a team of administrators, and make the case for the additional capacity the platform needs as the business grows.
  • Manage the team directly, including regular one-on-ones, goal setting, performance reviews, and individual career development plans.
  • Accountable for reliable operation of the platform: production incidents, integration failure triage, scheduled job and Flow error monitoring, and the lifecycle of certificates, credentials, and Connected Apps.
  • Set the team’s ways of working: intake, prioritization, estimation, documentation, peer review, and definition of done.
  • Own capacity planning and prioritization, negotiating scope and sequencing with stakeholders across departments and making the trade-offs explicit.
  • Mentor the team on Salesforce architecture and craft, raising the technical bar through design review and pairing rather than by absorbing the work yourself.
  • Manage relationships with implementation partners, contractors, and Salesforce account and support teams, holding external delivery to the same standards as internal work.
  • Represent the Salesforce team to executive stakeholders, communicating roadmap, progress, risk, and resourcing needs.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Mathematics, a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience on the Salesforce platform, including time in an architecture or lead solution design capacity.
  • Minimum of 2 years of leading a team, managing direct reports, or similar.
  • Experience integrating acquired companies or new business units onto an existing Salesforce instance.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ internals (amendment and renewal logic, subscription pricing, the quote-to-order data model) and with Revenue Cloud (RLM / Revenue Cloud Advanced).
  • Proven experience architecting and administering complex Salesforce environments with multiple integrations.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, from end user to executive.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Salesforce Application Architect or System Architect credentials, or demonstrable progress toward them.
  • Experience leading a migration or replatform of an existing quoting, pricing, or revenue system.

EOE Statement:

Datacor is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis or race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Use of AI During Interviews:

At Datacor, we value thoughtful problem-solving and authentic perspectives. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation process, we ask that candidates do not use generative AI tools or outside assistance during live interviews unless explicitly stated otherwise. We're interested in hearing your experience, your approach, and how you think through challenges.
