Jabil is a product solutions company providing comprehensive design, manufacturing, supply chain and product management services. Operating from over 100 facilities in 29 countries, Jabil delivers innovative, integrated and tailored solutions to customers across a broad range of industries and end-markets, such as automotive, consumer lifestyle and wearable tech, defense and aerospace, connected home and building, industrial and energy, enterprise and infrastructure, healthcare, mobility, packaging and printing.

What Will You Do?

Cybersecurity & Network Security Leadership

  • Serve as the principal technical expert for cybersecurity, firewall technologies, network architecture, and security operations.

  • Design, implement, and maintain secure network infrastructures supporting factory test environments, server validation systems, and rack-level test operations.

  • Develop and enforce cybersecurity standards, firewall policies, network segmentation strategies, and access control frameworks.

  • Lead vulnerability management, threat detection, incident response, and remediation activities to minimize operational risk.

  • Drive compliance initiatives and ensure adherence to corporate, customer, regulatory, and industry security requirements.

  • Implement infrastructure hardening and Zero Trust security principles across manufacturing and engineering environments.

Infrastructure & Site Reliability Engineering

  • Provide sustaining engineering support for manufacturing server (L10) and rack (L11) test software and infrastructure, including configuration management and deployment of new product introductions.

  • Architect, Administer, support, and optimize Fortinet security solutions, including firewall policy management, intrusion prevention, and advanced threat protection.

  • Manage Arista network environments, including switching, routing, segmentation, and high-availability network designs.

  • Administer VMware virtualization platforms, including ESXi, vCenter, virtual networking, and lifecycle management.

  • Support enterprise server infrastructure, preferably HPE ProLiant platforms and associated management technologies.

  • Manage SAN storage environments, preferably NetApp, including provisioning, performance optimization, monitoring, and capacity planning.

  • Support backup, recovery, and disaster recovery solutions to ensure business continuity and data protection objectives are achieved.

  • Monitor infrastructure health, performance, capacity, and availability using enterprise monitoring and alerting platforms.

Operational Excellence

  • Perform advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis across network, security, storage, virtualization, and server technologies.

  • Develop and maintain network diagrams, infrastructure documentation, security standards, operating procedures, and knowledge articles.

  • Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and process improvements that enhance security, reliability, and operational efficiency.

  • Collaborate with manufacturing, engineering, customer, and global IT teams to support production schedules and infrastructure requirements.

  • Provide escalation support for business-critical production incidents.

  • Ensure security compliance with company security policies, procedures, and departmental operational requirements.

Leadership & Mentorship

  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and knowledge transfer to engineers and technical team members.

  • Promote engineering best practices and support skill development across the Site Reliability Engineering organization.

  • Act as a trusted advisor for infrastructure security architecture, reliability, and operational strategy.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent experience may be considered.

Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, Systems Administration, Network Engineering, Cybersecurity, or related enterprise technology environments.

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience managing Fortinet security platforms and Arista networking technologies in enterprise environments.

  • Proven experience securing manufacturing, engineering, laboratory, test-development, or industrial environments.

  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity frameworks, risk management, threat mitigation, and security operations.

  • Experience leading cybersecurity compliance programs and implementing security policies, standards, and controls.

  • Demonstrated expertise in network segmentation, access controls, vulnerability management, incident response, and infrastructure hardening.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills in complex production environments.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Fortinet certifications (NSE, FCSS, FCX) or equivalent cybersecurity certifications.

  • Experience with Zero Trust architecture and industrial/manufacturing cybersecurity practices.

  • Familiarity with NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, SOC 2, or similar standards.

  • Experience with SIEM platforms, vulnerability assessment tools, and security auditing solutions.

  • Experience supporting hyperscale, cloud, AI infrastructure, or high-volume manufacturing operations.

  • Experience working in global, multi-site, and multicultural environments.

Travel

  • Domestic and international travel up to 25% may be required

Sponsorship

  • This position is not eligible for immigration and/or visa sponsorship.

  • Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship by Jabil.

  • Applicants requiring sponsorship will not be considered.

  • 401K Match

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

  • Paid Time Off

  • Tuition Reimbursement

  • Life, AD&D, and Disability Insurance

  • Commuter Benefits

  • Employee Assistance Program

  • Pet Insurance

  • Adoption Assistance

  • Annual Merit Increases

  • Community Volunteer Opportunities

Job Description Summary

Our work is essential to helping Nationwide build future capability to serve customer needs. Keeping existing products relevant and marketable and building new products takes research, critical thinking, practicality and collaboration. If you enjoy gathering input and information, working independently and on a team and creating innovative solutions for customers, we want to know more about you!

The State Manager creates multi-year state-specific business strategy to drive our Personal Lines Portfolio of products to meet or exceed top and bottom-line performance aligning to enterprise goals and strategy. This position is responsible for driving strategic alignment through the launch and refinement of product offerings (pricing, underwriting appetite and product structure and enhancements) and distribution strategy. This includes developing and implementing plans and processes related to financial planning, rate reviews, market development and communication of state management. Working directly with PL business stakeholders, the State Manager aggressively collaborates in the development, execution and monitoring of operating plans resulting in P&L objectives, including the areas of combined ratio, revenue growth, regulatory management, and legal compliance. The State Manager is responsible for building winning strategies to address complex business issues such as maximizing the opportunity of assigned state markets. Your work will support regional and corporate objectives through ongoing analysis and monitoring of results and communicating results with leadership, distribution and underwriting partners. Keeping existing state strategic direction relevant, competitive, and profitable requires research, critical thinking, practicality and collaboration.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in insurance, actuarial science, mathematics, risk management, economics, finance, accounting, business administration or related subject area or Master of Business Administration degree preferred.

License/Certification/Designation: Progress toward or completion of CPCU, AU CIC, INS ARM, actuarial exams or similar designations preferred.

Experience: Eight years of experience in underwriting or product preferred. Cross-functional experience from other areas and experience with data analysis preferred.

Solid understanding of financials, trend analysis and competitor data. Proficiency in analytical tools, relational databases, data visualization techniques, query-based language and/or statistical software experience preferred. Excellent verbal and written communication skills to present information, communicate and influence internal and external partners at all levels. Ability to drive for results, deal with ambiguity, solve problems, learn on the job, make quality decisions, see trends and patterns within data. Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Vibecode specialists to join the Tendem project () and drive specialized data scraping workflows for real-world use cases. Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Senior Python Data Scraping Engineers to join the Tendem project and drive specialized data scraping workflows for real-world applications. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in web scraping, data extraction, and data processing to deliver accurate, reliable, and high-quality results. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for technical professionals with hands-on experience in web scraping, data extraction and processing.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Senior Python Data Scraping Engineer, you'll handle data scraping tasks requiring technical precision for web extraction and processing, utilizing tools such as Apify, OpenRouter, and other technologies, alongside your own technical expertise and approaches.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end data extraction workflows across complex websites, ensuring complete coverage, accuracy, and reliable delivery of structured datasets.
  • Leverage available tools and custom workflows to accelerate data collection, validation, and task execution while meeting defined requirement.
  • Ensure reliable extraction from dynamic and interactive web sources, adapting approaches as needed to handle JavaScript-rendered content and changing site behavior.
  • Enforce data quality standards through validation checks, cross-source consistency controls, adherence to formatting specifications, and systematic verification prior to delivery.
  • Scale scraping operations for large datasets using efficient batching or parallelization, monitor failures, and maintain stability against minor site structure changes.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 5+ years of relevant experience in data engineering, web scraping, automation, or software development (required).
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong technical foundation and practical experience with scripting, automation, and data extraction workflows. We are looking for specialists who can solve non-trivial problems, work confidently with modern development tools and technologies, and systematically collect, structure, and validate data from diverse sources. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Strong experience in Python web scraping (BeautifulSoup, Selenium or similar), including dynamic content (JS, AJAX, infinite scroll) and APIs via proxies
  • Proven ability to extract data from complex structures (hierarchies, archived pages, inconsistent HTML)
  • Solid background in data cleaning, normalization, and validation, delivering structured datasets (CSV, JSON, Google Sheets)

Additional requirements

  • Demonstrated experience handling anti-bot mechanisms and dynamic site structures at scale
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent) and containerization (Docker) as part of real workflows
  • Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks (LangChain, OpenRouter, or similar) applied to automation tasks
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
  • Self-directed work ethic with ability to troubleshoot independently
  • A link to GitHub is a plus
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $40 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution. Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Transformez votre passion pour l'industrie du luxe en une opportunité de carrière. Explorez le monde des marques haut de gamme et ayez un impact durable sur les secteurs de la mode, de la beauté, de la joaillerie ou encore de l'automobile.

À propos du poste :

En tant qu'évaluateur/évaluatrice de marques de luxe, vous entrerez dans l'univers du luxe pour évaluer discrètement l'expérience client en donnant un avis essentiel qui aidera les marques à affiner leurs services. Qu'il s'agisse de visiter des boutiques, d'acheter en ligne ou de retourner un produit, votre voix façonne l'avenir de l'industrie du luxe.

- Flexibilité : chaque visite en boutique dure environ 20 minutes, ce qui vous donne la flexibilité d'effectuer plusieurs missions.

- Opportunités fréquentes : effectuez plusieurs missions par mois et collaborez avec certaines des marques les plus prestigieuses au monde.

Ce que vous ferez :

1. Choisissez vos missions : adaptez vos missions à vos préférences personnelles et à votre profil.

2. Visitez des boutiques de luxe ou évaluez en ligne : dialoguez avec les Conseillers dans les boutiques ou en ligne depuis le confort de votre domicile.

3. Observez attentivement : examinez l'ambiance, la qualité du service et l'expérience globale du client.

4. Donnez un avis honnête : utilisez notre plateforme pour partager vos observations à l'aide de questionnaires.

Avantages du poste :

•Une collaboration avec des marques emblématiques dans tous les secteurs d'activité.

•Des missions flexibles adaptées à vos intérêts.

•Une rémunération pour votre temps et votre contribution, avec la possibilité d'un remboursement sur les achats.

•Une plateforme conviviale pour gérer les missions et les avis.

Comment rejoindre la communauté CXG :

1. Inscrivez-vous : inscrivez-vous sur live.cxg.com et confirmez votre adresse e-mail.

2. Complétez votre profil : remplissez vos informations à 100 % et attendez que votre profil soit vérifié.

3. Obtenez la certification : validez la Certification Générale pour accéder aux missions.

4. Postulez pour des missions : explorez des missions avec des marques qui vous intéressent.

5. Commencez à évaluer : commencez à faire la différence sur le marché du luxe.

Rémunération :

- Évaluations sans achat : Gagnez une rémunération basée sur la complexité de la mission.

- Évaluations avec achat : Remboursement des articles approuvés conformément aux instructions de la mission.

À propos de CXG

Chez CXG, nous mettons en relation des marques haut de gamme avec plus de 80 000 évaluateurs et évaluatrices dans 70 pays. Avec 12 bureaux dans le monde et près de deux décennies d'expertise dans le domaine de l'expérience client dans la vente au détail, nous nous engageons à redéfinir l'expérience client pour les géants du luxe.

Rejoignez-nous et profitez de la flexibilité du travail en déplacement grâce à notre plateforme mobile, CXG Live. Sur cette plateforme, vous pouvez gérer en toute transparence les missions, les certifications et les avis.

Requirements

  • Vous avez 18 ans ou plus.
  • Vous êtes déjà client(e) de marques haut de gamme ou de luxe.
  • Vous n'êtes pas engagé(e) contractuellement avec des marques de vente au détail, afin de préserver l'intégrité.
  • Vous êtes ponctuel(le), organisé(e), soucieux/soucieuse du détail et fiable.
  • Vous êtes attentif/ve à et passionné(e) par l'expérience client.
  • Aucune expérience antérieure n'est requise, nous accordons de l'importance aux commentaires honnêtes de la part de clients authentiques.

raw.excerpt: Appen's Go to Market team sits at the center of the company's growth strategy, partnering with the world's most ambitious AI programs to deliver the data that makes models work.
raw.description:
Appen's Go to Market team sits at the center of the company's growth strategy, partnering with the world's most ambitious AI programs to deliver the data that makes models work. This role is responsible for acquiring net-new strategic logos and expanding high-value accounts across Big Tech, AI Labs, and Enterprise AI adopters. It's a high-visibility commercial role operating across Global and Americas markets.

Your Impact

    You'll own end-to-end enterprise sales cycles, from discovery and qualification through commercial negotiation and contract execution, working from well-developed territory and account plans.

    You'll stay multi-threaded across buying, technical, and operational stakeholders, positioning Appen's portfolio as the partner of choice by mapping capabilities directly to each client's AI program priorities. Expect to craft compelling business cases and proposals, and to run regular Executive Business Reviews to keep clients aligned on strategic goals and surface new partnership opportunities.

    Pipeline comes from outbound account-based strategies run in partnership with Marketing, backed by strong CRM discipline and accurate, timely forecasts. You'll also orchestrate internal teams across Client Partners, Delivery, Legal, and Finance to shape the solution and pricing behind each bid.

    Success in this role looks like year-on-year growth in the accounts you own, and enough standing inside them to influence how those programs are scoped and resourced.

What You Bring

  • A proven track record of closing complex enterprise deals gained selling directly into frontier AI labs in the AI training data, RLHF, or model evaluation space.
  • Exceptional communication skills with enough technical credibility to influence engineering and research stakeholders, and C-suite.
  • The ability to lead complex RFP responses and negotiate MSAs, SOWs, DPAs, and other enterprise agreements.
  • A creative approach to problem solving, and the competitive drive to keep moving opportunities forward.

Why You'll Love Working Here

    At Appen, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We value curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to delivering the highest quality AI solutions for frontier models. You'll work on complex challenges that shape the future of AI across industries and geographies, alongside talented people in a culture that values humility over ego. You'll have the flexibility to deliver in a way that works for you and your team, supported by tools, resources, and development opportunities to continue to build your capability over time.

About Appen

    Appen has been a leader in AI training data for over 30 years. We specialise in human generated data to train, fine tune, and evaluate models across generative AI, large language models, computer vision, and speech recognition. Our AI assisted data annotation platform and global crowd of more than 1 million contributors in over 200 countries support model pre training, supervised fine tuning, evaluation and benchmarking, safety and red teaming, and multilingual global expansion.

Base Salary: $150,000 – $200,000 USD. This range reflects the good faith estimate of starting base pay for a new hire in this role as of the posting date.

On-Target Earnings (OTE): Structured as a 50/50 split between base and commission.

raw.title: Director, Contact Center – Thrivent Bank
raw.excerpt: The Director, Contact Center is responsible for leading a team of Contact Center Managers and Client Care Professionals (CCPs) within the Thrivent Bank Contact Center.
raw.description:
The Director, Contact Center is responsible for leading a team of Contact Center Managers and Client Care Professionals (CCPs) within the Thrivent Bank Contact Center. This role provides overall leadership for the development and execution of operating processes, performance management, and metrics that align with the strategic objectives of Thrivent Bank. The position also holds accountability for talent development, team performance, and overall engagement, including the establishment of effective change management practices to support the successful implementation and adoption of key initiatives.

The Director operates the business with discipline and a strong risk management mindset to ensure the contact center consistently delivers efficient, well-controlled, and high-quality service. This includes advancing a scalable operating model that supports growth, while aligning the contact center with the bank’s digital strategy and preserving a human-centered service experience. The role requires deep expertise across core contact center disciplines, including workforce management, quality assurance, Voice of the Customer (VOC), training, and call routing effectiveness. In addition, the Director identifies and executes opportunities to leverage scale and capabilities across Thrivent’s broader contact center ecosystem.

As a key member of the Bank Leadership Team, the Director, Contact Center reports directly to the Vice President and Chief Operating Officer.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILTIES

  • Develop and execute the strategic vision for the Thrivent Bank contact center, aligning with business goals and customer experience objectives.

  • Oversee all aspects of contact center operations, including staffing, training, quality assurance, technology utilization, and performance metrics.

  • Recruit, train, mentor, and manage a high-performing team of contact center professionals, fostering a culture of excellence, continuous improvement, and customer-centricity.

  • Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level agreements (SLAs), implementing corrective actions as needed to achieve target results.

  • Analyze contact center data and trends to identify opportunities for process improvement, cost reduction, and enhanced customer satisfaction.

  • Collaborate with other departments (e.g., IT, Marketing, Product Development, Compliance) to ensure seamless customer journeys and integrated service delivery.

  • Manage contact center budget, ensuring efficient resource allocation and cost control.

  • Stay abreast of industry best practices, emerging technologies, and regulatory changes relevant to contact center operations within the banking sector.

  • Develop and implement contingency plans to ensure business continuity and resilience during unforeseen events.

  • Ensure compliance with all relevant banking regulations, internal policies, and data security standards.

Describe below the audience this role will interact with and level of influence they will have on those roles.

  • Engages senior leaders across Thrivent Bank (including the Bank Leadership Team) and influences strategic alignment of contact center operations with enterprise priorities.

  • Partners with cross-functional stakeholders (Digital, Operations, Risk/Compliance, Product, Technology) to drive enterprise initiatives, improve customer experience, and optimize operational performance.

  • Directly leads Contact Center Managers and indirectly influences Client Care Professionals, shaping performance, culture, and service delivery outcomes.

  • Influences external vendors and service partners through performance expectations, contract oversight, and alignment to service, risk, and regulatory standards.

  • Serves as a key voice of the contact center, elevating Voice of the Customer insights and frontline perspectives to inform decision-making and continuous improvement.

QULIFICATIONS & SKILLS

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, or a related field; Master's degree preferred.

  • Minimum of 8-10 years of progressive leadership experience in contact center management, with at least 5 years specifically within the banking or financial services industry.

  • Proven track record of successfully leading large teams and managing complex contact center operations.

  • Deep understanding of contact center technologies, including CRM systems, ACD, IVR, WFM, and omnichannel platforms.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.

  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to drive operational efficiency and improve customer satisfaction.

  • Knowledge of banking regulations and compliance requirements (e.g., Reg E, BSA/AML, GLBA).

  • Strategic thinker with the ability to translate vision into actionable plans.

  • Project management experience is a plus.

Pay TransparencyThrivent’s long-term growth depends on attracting, rewarding, and retaining people who are committed to helping others thrive with purpose. We accomplish this by offering a wide variety of market competitive compensation programs to attract, reward, and retain top talent. The applicable salary or hourly wage range for this full-time role is $132,814.00 - $179,690.00 per year, which factors in various geographic regions. The base pay actually offered will be determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to, location, relevant experience, skills, and knowledge, business needs, market demand, and other factors Thrivent deems important.Thrivent is unique in our commitment to helping people to be wise with money and live balanced and generous lives. That extends to our benefits.The following benefits may be offered: various bonuses (including, for example, annual or long-term incentives); medical, dental, and vision insurance; health savings account; flexible spending account; 401k; pension; life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance; disability insurance; supplemental protection insurance; 20 days of Paid Time Off each year; Sick and Safe Time; 10 paid company holidays; Volunteer Time Off; paid parental leave; EAP; well-being benefits, and other employee benefits. Eligibility for receipt of these benefits is subject to the applicable plan/policy documents. Thrivent’s plans/policies are subject to change at any time at Thrivent’s discretion.

Thrivent provides Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status,genetic information, or any otherstatus protected by applicable local, state, or federal law. This policy applies to all employees and job applicants.

Thrivent is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation, please let us know by sending an email to or call 800-847-4836 and request Human Resources.

Personal Lines Insurance Sales Agent – U.S. Market

★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★

Location: Remote – Latin America
Work Arrangement: This is a remote/telecommute position.
Employment Type: Full-Time
Industry: Insurance / Property & Casualty / Personal Lines
Compensation:$1,500 – $2,500 USD/month base + performance-based commissions
English Proficiency: Advanced English required (C1/C2 preferred)
Travel: Must have a valid U.S. visa and be able to travel to Houston, Texas for initial training

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Personal Lines Insurance Sales Agent to support a growing U.S.-based insurance agency serving customers in the United States.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance sales, particularly Auto and Homeowners Insurance, and is confident working directly with U.S. customers in a sales-driven environment.

Candidates who already hold an active Texas General Lines – Property and Casualty license are highly preferred. However, we also welcome experienced insurance professionals who are willing and eligible to complete the appropriate Texas licensing process.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced insurance professional based in Latin America to build a long-term career supporting the U.S. insurance market.

Why This Opportunity?

  • Work remotely from Latin America with a growing U.S. insurance organization
  • Focus on the U.S. Personal Lines insurance market
  • Earn $1,500 – $2,500 USD/month base plus performance-based commissions
  • Work directly with U.S.-based customers
  • Leverage your existing insurance sales and P&C experience
  • Receive initial training in Houston, Texas
  • Join a performance-driven environment with long-term growth potential

What You’ll Do

  • Sell Personal Lines Property & Casualty insurance to U.S.-based customers
  • Focus primarily on Auto and Homeowners Insurance, along with other personal insurance products as needed
  • Communicate with prospective customers by phone, email, and other digital channels
  • Understand customer needs and recommend appropriate insurance solutions
  • Prepare and explain insurance quotes, coverage options, deductibles, and policy details
  • Guide customers through the sales and policy-binding process
  • Consistently follow up with leads and prospective customers
  • Build strong customer relationships and provide a professional sales experience
  • Maintain accurate customer, quote, and sales information in agency systems
  • Meet individual sales, conversion, activity, and production goals
  • Follow applicable insurance regulations, licensing requirements, and agency procedures
  • Complete required Texas insurance licensing requirements if not already appropriately licensed

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of insurance sales experience
  • Strong experience with Personal Lines Insurance
  • Hands-on experience with Auto and/or Homeowners Insurance
  • Proven ability to sell, close, and communicate effectively with customers
  • Strong understanding of insurance concepts including coverage, premiums, deductibles, limits, and policy options
  • Advanced spoken and written English
  • Comfortable communicating and selling to U.S.-based customers
  • Strong phone presence and consultative sales skills
  • Results-oriented and comfortable working toward sales targets
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Willing and able to obtain the appropriate Texas insurance license, if not already licensed
  • Valid U.S. visa
  • Ability and willingness to travel to Houston, Texas for initial training

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active Texas General Lines – Property and Casualty license
  • Active Texas Personal Lines Property and Casualty license
  • Current or previous Property & Casualty license from another U.S. state
  • Previous experience selling insurance directly to customers in the United States
  • Experience working with U.S. Personal Lines carriers
  • Strong track record selling Auto and Homeowners Insurance
  • Experience working in a high-volume insurance sales environment
  • Previous experience with a U.S. independent insurance agency or brokerage
  • Previous experience with Goosehead Insurance is a major plus
  • Previous experience living or working professionally in the United States is a plus

Ideal Candidate

You are an experienced insurance salesperson who knows how to build trust, identify customer needs, and close business.

You are comfortable discussing Auto, Homeowners, and other Personal Lines products with U.S. customers and can confidently explain insurance concepts in English.

You may already hold an active Texas P&C license, have previously held a U.S. insurance license, or have strong insurance experience and be prepared to complete the necessary licensing requirements.

Most importantly, you are competitive, accountable, customer-focused, and motivated by sales performance.

How Success Is Measured

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Sales production and policies written
  • Quote-to-bind conversion
  • Lead follow-up and response time
  • Customer experience and communication quality
  • Achievement of individual sales goals
  • Accuracy and compliance throughout the sales process
  • Consistent pipeline management and follow-through

Why Join Us

This role offers the opportunity to combine your insurance expertise, English proficiency, and sales ability while working remotely from Latin America for the U.S. market.

You will join a growth-oriented environment where strong performers can directly impact results and increase their earning potential through performance-based compensation.

Important Notes

  • This position supports customers in the United States
  • This is a sales-focused position, not solely a customer service or administrative insurance role
  • Candidates must have previous professional insurance experience
  • Candidates must have a valid U.S. visa and be able to travel to Houston, Texas for initial training
  • An active Texas General Lines – Property and Casualty license is highly preferred but is not required to apply
  • Candidates without an active Texas license must be willing and eligible to complete the appropriate licensing process
  • Candidates with current or previous U.S. P&C licenses are strongly encouraged to apply

This is a remote/telecommute position.

What You Will Need to Succeed

raw.excerpt: Who We Are Agility PR Solutions is a global leader in media intelligence and PR technology.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Agility PR Solutions is a global leader in media intelligence and PR technology. Founded in 2003, we help communications teams around the world drive awareness, make smarter decisions, and protect their reputation when it matters most. Our enterprise-grade platform unifies media relations, media monitoring, social listening, AI visibility, and media intelligence into a single seamless system—turning overwhelming streams of coverage and conversation into decision-ready intelligence. Recognized for ease of use, results, and customer support, Agility is one of the most trusted names in media intelligence. Our mission is to empower the voices that shape the world's narratives, and we're looking for people who want to help us do it.

About the Role

Reporting to the VP of Marketing, the Associate Director, Demand Generation is the architect of the demand strategy that will drive 80–90% of marketing-qualified leads for the entire business.

This is a strategy and leadership seat, not a hands-on-keyboard role. You design the full-funnel architecture of every demand campaign: mapping the buyer journey for each of our customer segments — Enterprise & Government, In-house PR Teams, and PR Agencies — defining the thought leadership required at the top of the funnel, choosing the products each campaign drives toward in the middle, and architecting every channel the campaign will use, from paid search and paid ads to paid and organic social, webinarsand virtual events, in-person tradeshows, and outbound email.

You lead the team that controls 75–80% of our MQL levers: the SEO & AI Visibility & Social Media Manager and the Field/Event Marketing & Community Relations Manager report to you, and you hold results oversight of our paid search and paid ads program. Through the field marketing line, you own end-to-end event engagement — what happens before and after everywebinarand every tradeshow, not just the event itself.

You will partner closely with the Rev/Marketing Operations Manager, who builds and launches your campaigns in HubSpot: youset the priorities and the briefs;they ownbuild quality and measurement truth. You will also shape the content agenda, since much of what our communications and content organization produces is in service of your campaigns, and you will run our cross-sell and upsell motion — roughly 10–15% of marketing effort — jointly with the Product & Customer Marketing Manager.

The mandate is direct: help double to triple MQLs within one year while proving that quality holds. You will treat paid versus organic as a blended-CAC optimization — sponsoringorganic'sgrowth in MQL share while holding paidaccountable forresults.

What Success Looks Like

  • MQL volume doubles totripleswithin 12 months, with conversion quality (MQL to opportunity toclosed-won) holding or improving.
  • The operating scorecard's leading indicators — outbound reply rate and meetings booked — trend upward quarter over quarter.
  • Multiple campaigns run concurrently, each witha documentedfull-funnel architecture, channel plan, and test plan.
  • Team results compound:organic'sshare of MQLs grows quarter over quarter, event programs deliver measurable pipeline, and paid efficiency improves on a blended-CAC basis.
  • Cross-sell and upsell campaigns into the customer base contribute measurable expansion pipeline.
  • A/B testing is systematic, and learnings from every campaignarecaptured and reapplied.

What You'll Do

Campaign & Funnel Architecture

  • Design the end-to-end architecture of every demand generation campaign: buyer journey by segment, funnel-stage content requirements, product destinations, offers, and sequencing.
  • Define the top-of-funnel thought leadership each campaign requires — webinars, reports, blog series, infographics — and brief the content organization accordingly.
  • Architect the channel mix per campaign across paid search and ads, paid social, organic social, webinars, in-person events, and outbound email.
  • Own outbound email program strategy: jurisdiction-aware market sequencing across opt-out and opt-in consent regimes, a sending architecture that keeps true cold outbound on dedicated infrastructure separate from the marketing platform, and the scaling gates that protect deliverability.
  • Design the workflows that act on buyer intent signals captured from ZoomInfo and G2, feeding them into campaign targeting, audience segmentation, and outbound prioritization.
  • Collaborate efficiently with design and web: clear briefs and clean handoffs for campaign asset requests, with timelines that respect ashared-servicesqueue.

Team Leadership & Channel Portfolio

  • Manage and develop the SEO & AI Visibility & Social Media Manager and the Field/Event Marketing & Community Relations Manager; hold results oversight of paid search and paid ads.
  • Hold each channel accountable for campaign-level outcomes on a daily and weeklycadence.
  • Design end-to-end event engagement: pre- and post-webinar journeys, pre- and post-tradeshow journeys.
  • Balance the portfolio: sponsor organic MQL share growth while managing paid on blended CAC.

Measurement & Optimization

  • Live in the numbers daily and weekly; run a disciplined A/B test-and-learn cadence across offers, audiences, creative, and channels.
  • Own the demand generation operating scorecard, including outbound reply rate and meetings booked.
  • Pressure-test, adopt, and evangelize the attribution model built by Rev/Marketing Operations.
  • Hold outbound to realistic benchmarks — reply rate, meetings booked per send, inbox placement, complaint rates — and gate scale-up on hitting them.

Cross-Functional Orchestration

  • Brief and influence the communications and content organization so campaign content lands on strategy and on time.
  • Run the cross-sell and upsell motion jointly with the Product & Customer Marketing Manager: they own the what-to-whom; you own the campaign machinery.
  • Partner with sales on lead-quality feedback loops, SLAs, and meetings-booked follow-through.

What You Bring

  • 7+ years in B2B demand generation, including experience leading multi-channel campaign strategy in B2B SaaS (media intelligence,martech, or communications technologyan asset).
  • People-managementexperience, with a record of developing channel specialists into strong performers.
  • Proven full-funnel campaign architecture: you can walk us through campaigns you designed end to end — journey, contentplan, channel mix, and results.
  • HubSpot Marketing Hub fluency:youbrief, review, and QA work in it credibly, even when you are not the one building.
  • Proven cold outbound program experience on dedicated sending infrastructure — secondary domains, mailbox rotation, warmup, deliverability management — run deliberately outside the marketing automation platform, and the judgment to know whypurchasedlists never touch the marketing platform's bulk email tools.
  • Jurisdiction-aware outbound strategy: you haveoperatedacross opt-out (CAN-SPAM) and opt-in (CASL, GDPR/PECR)regimes,you know which markets are consent-only, and you sequence market entry accordingly.
  • Fluency in the post-2024 deliverability regime — authentication requirements, bulk-sender thresholds, complaint-rate ceilings — and honest subject-line discipline treated as both a legal and a deliverability matter.
  • Clear-eyed judgment on outbound tooling, including AI SDR platforms: youpilot against cost per qualified meeting rather than buying the demo.
  • A deep analytical habit: daily and weeklynumbersreview, systematic A/B testing, and decisions made from data.
  • Influence without authority: you get the best from partners you do not manage — paid specialists, content teams, operations, and sales.
  • Calm under concurrency: you plan and run multiple campaigns at different lifecycle stages simultaneously.

Why You'll Love It Here

  • Fully remote work environment
  • Collaborative culture – and key tools enabling it
  • Competitive compensation package
  • Health, Dental & Vision benefits
  • RRSP matching
  • Life Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Career Development & Progression opportunities
  • Paid Vacation, Personal Days and Sick days
  • Flex Fridays in Summer, Week off between Christmas and New Years'
  • No Internal Meetings Fridays

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is C$115,000–C$140,000 annually, plus a 15% target bonus.Final compensation will reflect the successful candidate's experience, skills, and internal equity.

This is for a vacant position.

AI Usage

We use technology to make hiring smarter, faster, and more personal, never less human. Artificial intelligence (AI) tools help us manage applications efficiently and highlight qualifications that align with each role, allowing our recruiters to focus more on meaningful conversations with candidates. AI does not make hiring decisions at Agility. Every decision is made by people, our hiring managers and recruitment professionals, who are trained to apply sound judgment andequitablepractices at every stage.We believe technology exists to amplify human insight, not replace it. That belief shapes how we build relationships, tell stories, and grow our teams.

At Agility, we strive every day to build a more inclusive work environment and introduce tools that enable it. We strongly encourage applications from all people regardless of race, religion, gender, age,disabilitystatusor sexual orientation.

Even if you find yourself not checking all the boxes of our listedrequirementsbut you are excited about this opportunity,we'dlove to hear from you anyway. Our Talent Acquisition team will review your application for this role, and other potential role matches open now or in the future.

If, at any stage of the application process, you require accommodation owing to disability ora medical need, please let us know at for us to makeappropriate arrangements.

raw.title: Remote Executive Assistant - Business Operations & BD Support
raw.excerpt: FreedUp is seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Executive Assistant (EA) to support the Founder of a remote-first company building innovative geospatial and open-source software systems.
raw.description:
FreedUp is seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Executive Assistant (EA) to support the Founder of a remote-first company building innovative geospatial and open-source software systems. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on structure, accountability, and operational clarity — a professional who can turn complex processes into seamless execution without needing heavy hand-holding.

We're looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Executive Assistant to directly support the Founder — helping streamline both business operations and day-to-day logistics so they can stay focused on building and growing the company. Because the team is fully remote and distributed, this EA needs to be comfortable operating async, communicating clearly in writing, and managing priorities independently.

Above all, the Founder is looking for consistency and proactive follow-through. She'd rather have someone who handles a recurring task the same way every time and reports back without being asked, than someone who is occasionally brilliant but unpredictable.

Location: Fully Remote Job Type:
Full-Time Salary: $1,000 - $1,800 per month (based on experience)

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Operations Coordinator, or similar role supporting senior leadership, ideally in a technical or startup environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills — with a track record of proactive, consistent communication rather than waiting to be asked for updates.
  • Tech-savvy and comfortable working in digital ecosystems (Slack, Gmail, Google Workspace, CRM/project management tools). Comfortable learning new tools independently and setting up better ways of working with them (e.g., automations), rather than expecting mastery to be handed to you.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization abilities — able to work independently in an async, distributed team.
  • Proven ability to manage sensitive information with sound judgment about who should see what, not just tool-level confidentiality.
  • Proactive, self-directed, and thrives in an environment with evolving needs; comfortable operating with minimal oversight.
  • Reliable when it comes to calendar commitments — once something is confirmed, it's honored; changes are communicated and explained rather than simply missed.
  • Comfortable owning deadlines proactively — including spotting dates buried inside documents (like a procurement RFP) rather than waiting for them to be called out.
  • Experience supporting business development, CRM upkeep, or sales pipeline coordination is a plus.
  • Experience coordinating (not necessarily authoring) proposals or bid documents is a plus.
  • Basic knowledge of expense reporting, reconciliation, or bookkeeping preferred.
  • Technical Requirements: Reliable high-speed internet and a modern home office setup.

Strong Differentiators (not required, but a plus)

  • Prior experience supporting an executive or leadership team, especially exposure to how executive meeting agendas are structured — useful as the Founder restructures her own this quarter.
  • Comfortable giving and receiving direct feedback — willing to flag it if asked to take on too much, or if something was quietly handled solo after being delegated, rather than just executing silently.

Nice to Haves

  • Comfortable navigating dense procurement documents (e.g., project-managing a 100+ page RFP — extracting pricing instructions, page counts, and formatting rules scattered across the document and its amendments).
  • Openness to eventually taking on full email/inbox triage once a high-trust working relationship is established (not expected at launch).
  • Basic comfort with technical writing (e.g., drafting a short passage on a technical topic like an API) — a bonus, not an expectation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Inbox & Communications Management: Maintain Inbox Zero across email and calls/texts. Triage and respond on behalf of the Founder where appropriate, flag priorities, and keep communications moving without letting things fall through the cracks.
  • Calendar Management & Time Protection: Own and optimize the Founder's calendar, protecting focus time, coordinating meeting scheduling, and confirming, preparing, and taking notes for meetings. Once a meeting is confirmed, it's treated as a firm commitment — no missed RSVPs.
  • Business Development Admin & CRM Upkeep: Maintain and update the CRM and BD pipeline, support prospecting of potential clients, and track business development activity end to end.
  • Proposal & Bid Coordination: Coordinate the preparation of proposals and bids (including government bids covering technical and policy topics), managing timelines, formatting, and inputs from relevant contributors — including proactively surfacing deadlines that are buried in the source documents rather than clearly stated.
  • Travel & Event Coordination With Judgment: Plan and manage business travel logistics, including flights, accommodations, and detailed itineraries. Pre-screen the high volume of event/conference invites that come in, flag genuine conflicts (e.g., "you've got three events in two weeks — we think this one, want me to book it?"), and apply the Founder's known personal preferences without needing to ask each time.
  • Expense Reporting & Reconciliation: Handle recurring expense reporting and reconciliation processes, keeping records accurate and organized.
  • Conference Research & Coordination: Research relevant industry conferences and coordinate attendance logistics.
  • Internal Communications & Team Coordination: Serve as a communication link between the Founder and the internal team, keeping updates clear and timely across channels.
  • Personal & Life Admin Support: Manage doctor appointment scheduling and other personal logistics as needed.
  • Reporting: Compile a company scorecard and provide structured, proactive updates on priorities, progress, and deadlines — without being asked.
  • Social Media: Support publishing of social media content as needed.
  • Event Planning (future scope): Support event planning and coordination as this responsibility area develops.

Benefits

  • International experience
  • Opportunity to work remotely from anywhere
  • Supportive and collaborative team environment
  • Learning and development opportunities
  • Potential Performance Bonuses
  • PTO
  • HMO after 3 months

raw.description:
Lyntris is a defense technology company that connects sensing to action across the connected battlespace. Lyntris brings together the talents of Accelint and Vitesse teams under one mission, with each contributing deep expertise within their domain. Combining differentiated hardware, software and mission expertise, Lyntris helps customers sense threats, make sense of complex conditions and act with greater speed, precision and confidence in contested environments.

Lyntris supports U.S. and allied defense organizations across every branch — including Navy, Army, Air Force, Space Force and allied partners — spanning strategic, operational and tactical missions and every domain: Space, Air, Land, Sea and Cyber. With more than 200 active defense programs, Lyntris works at every level of the mission, from national command authority to the tactical edge.

Solutions are designed by operators who understand the mission, engineered for the conditions that degrade or defeat standard systems, and built on an open, modular architecture that integrates into existing programs without requiring them to start over. Lyntris moves faster than the traditional defense cycle — with integrated design, build and test capabilities in-house — and delivers systems that sustain and endure long after initial fielding.

As a Subject Matter Expert (SME), you will design and develop Navy-focused Interactive Multimedia Instruction (IMI) that supports fleet-ready training aligned to NAVEDTRA standards. You will collaborate with highly skilled delivery teams made up of ISDs, Software Engineers, 3D Artists, Graphic Designers, and Technical Leads to analyze, design, develop, test, and deliver Navy training products — and have a great time doing meaningful work that directly supports the warfighter.

Our ideal SME contributes to every phase of the instructional systems design process, validating design decisions with Creative Leadership, the Program Team, and other contributors throughout development. You will ensure accurate implementation of learning objectives, assessments, scenarios, and media elements within Captivate-based IMI, Unity-based simulations, and related digital training solutions.

Our ideal candidate actively participates in weekly design reviews, collaborates with the Creative Operations team, and works closely with engineering and art teams to ensure instructional intent is realized in the final product.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Conduct front-end analysis, including task analysis, gap analysis, learner analysis, and content reviews based on Navy operational requirements.
  • Develop learning objectives, storyboards, scripts, branching scenarios, assessments, and IMI design specifications following NAVEDTRA guidelines.
  • Transform complex technical information, manuals into clear, instructionally sound digital learning content.
  • Assist Instructional Designers design, structure, and sequence IMI modules delivered through Captivate, Unity, or other training pipelines.
  • Collaborate with Software Engineers, Graphic Designers, and 3D Artists to ensure instructional design is accurately implemented in the final product.
  • Develop mockups, flowcharts, and prototypes to communicate instructional concepts to stakeholders.
  • Ensure alignment with Navy training standards, course control documents (CCDs), TLO/ELO frameworks, and SCORM/xAPI requirements.
  • Participate in design reviews with Creative Leadership, Program Managers, and Navy customer stakeholders.
  • Evaluate IMI effectiveness and recommend improvements based on learner data, SME feedback, and usability principles.
  • Apply design thinking, questioning techniques, and performance-based instructional strategies where pathways may not be fully defined.
  • Ensure training products meet accessibility, usability, and quality standards during development and testing.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications:

  • Associate’s Degree. Additional years of relevant experience may substitute for a degree.
  • Understanding of instructional design methodologies (ADDIE, SAM, task-based analysis, scenario-based learning).
  • Ability to interpret and apply NAVEDTRA standards and Navy training system requirements.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex concepts into clear instructional strategies.
  • Ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to implement instructional content.
  • Excellent organization, attention to detail, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Department of Defense (DOD) Security Clearance.

Preferred Skills (Not Required):

  • Experience developing or supporting Navy or DoD training programs.
  • Experience in the USN serving as a FC, ET, AT, IC, or any other DoD Service Branch/USN Rating with a thorough background in electronics.
  • Familiarity with SCORM, xAPI, and Navy Learning Management Systems.
  • Experience working with software engineers or art teams in multimedia development.
  • Understanding of accessibility standards and user experience principles in digital training.
  • Working knowledge of Adobe Captivate, Unity, Storyline, XD, or related design tools.
  • Experience writing or reviewing learning assessments aligned to performance outcomes.
  • Familiarity with TLO/ELO alignment, CCDs, and Navy courseware development processes.

Physical Requirements:

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.

Clearance Requirements

Some positions will require access to U.S. National Security information. Positions that require this access will be required to receive and maintain a U.S. government personnel security clearance (PCL). In order to qualify for this position, the candidate must be a US Citizen and either currently possess this National Security eligibility or be able to complete the investigation application process with a favorable determination and maintain that eligibility throughout their employment. To learn more about the security clearance process please access this link.

EEOC & Know Your Rights

Lyntris companies are Equal Opportunity Employers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, and local law. We ensure that all employment decisions, including hiring, promotion, compensation, and other terms and conditions of employment, are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. For more information about your rights, please review the "Know Your Rights" poster from the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC). Know your Rights: EnglishSpanish

Pay Scales & Benefits

The listed pay scale reflects the broad, minimum to maximum, pay scale for this position for the location for which it has been posted and is not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Other compensation considerations may include, but are not limited to, job responsibilities, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, or other applicable factors.

Benefits include…

  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Company Holidays
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Optional HSA and FSA
  • Base and Voluntary Life Insurance
  • Short Term & Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • 401k Matching
  • Employee Assistance Program

What you can expect

We're looking for an integrated marketing expert to build and implement demand generation campaigns that drive online Find, Try, Buy motions for Zoom's digital-first product portfolio.


About the Team

This position will lead the digital buyer journey strategy across owned, earned, and paid channels to drive online product discovery, trial activations, and self-serve purchases. Success requires expertise in eCommerce demand generation, data-driven optimization, and building high-performing cross-functional partnerships to deliver measurable business outcomes.


Responsibilities

  • Designing and executing integrated campaigns across digital channels to drive product awareness, trial sign-ups, and online conversions with measurable impact on traffic, engagement, and revenue
  • Building full-funnel demand generation programs using marketing automation, personalization, and account-based tactics to move prospects through awareness, consideration, and purchase stages
  • Partnering with product, growth, and revenue teams to align on business objectives and orchestrate omni-channel campaigns that accelerate the digital buyer journey
  • Developing conversion-focused content including landing pages, email nurtures, product demos, and comparison guides that optimize user experience and drive self-serve purchases
  • Implementing measurement frameworks with clear metrics across the funnel; conducting ongoing testing, analysis, and optimization to improve campaign performance and return on investment

What we’re looking for

  • Demonstrate 8+ years of experience in integrated marketing with a focus on eCommerce demandvgeneration and digital-first go-to-market strategies
  • Show proven track record driving measurable results across the full funnel, from brand awareness and lead generation to trial activations and online revenue
  • Apply deep expertise in digital marketing channels including paid search, paid social, programmatic display, web, email marketing, and content marketing
  • Use data and analytics tools (Google Analytics, attribution platforms, business intelligence tools) to measure performance, derive insights, and optimize campaigns
  • Demonstrate experience with product-led growth motions, self-serve purchase models, and

conversion rate optimization best practices

  • Work effectively across functions in matrixed organizations with global teams and diverse stakeholder groups
  • Possess bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
  • Bring experience creating scalable campaign frameworks and playbooks that enable regional marketing teams to localize programs

Salary Range or On Target Earnings:

Minimum:

$97,600.00

Maximum:

$225,700.00

We also have a location based compensation structure; there may be a different range for candidates in this and other locations

09/04/26

Our structured hybrid approach is centered around our offices and remote work environments. The work style of each role, Hybrid, Remote, or In-Person is indicated in the job description/posting.


Benefits
As part of our award-winning workplace culture and commitment to delivering happiness, our benefits program offers a variety of perks, benefits, and options to help employees maintain their physical, mental, emotional, and financial health; support work-life balance; and contribute to their community in meaningful ways. Click Learnfor more information.

Zoomies help people stay connected so they can get more done together. We set out to build the best collaboration platform for the enterprise, and today help people communicate better with products like Zoom Contact Center, Zoom Phone, Zoom Events, Zoom Apps, Zoom Rooms, and Zoom Webinars.
We’re problem-solvers, working at a fast pace to design solutions with our customers and users in mind. Find room to grow with opportunities to stretch your skills and advance your career in a collaborative, growth-focused environment.

At Zoom, we believe great work happens when people feel supported and empowered. raw.description:
Location: Pakistan or India (Remote)

We are seeking professionals with experience in Operational Finance & Assurance (FP&A), including budgeting and forecasting, financial reporting, variance analysis, reconciliations, month-end close, project financials, financial controls, KPI reporting, and business performance analysis. In this role, you will apply your expertise to evaluate AI-generated financial analyses, identify inaccuracies, and help improve the quality, accuracy, and reasoning of advanced AI models.

Help Shape the Future of AI in Finance

Volga Partners is seeking experienced finance professionals to join a specialized AI initiative supporting the development, training, and evaluation of next-generation financial reasoning models.

If you have a strong background in Investment Banking, Operational Finance & Assurance, Fixed Income Research, FP&A, or Quantitative Finance and enjoy solving complex business problems, this opportunity allows you to apply your expertise in a unique and innovative way while working remotely and earning competitive project-based compensation.

This is an excellent opportunity for finance professionals seeking flexible contract work, supplemental income, consulting experience, or exposure to cutting-edge AI technologies.

Employment Type

Temporary Contract Assignment

This is a temporary, project-based contract opportunity supporting an active AI training and evaluation initiative.

While project timelines may vary based on client demand and business needs, candidates selected for the project will have the opportunity to contribute meaningful financial expertise to a growing global AI program.

Please note that this is not a permanent employment position and does not include company-sponsored benefits, paid leave, holiday pay, or guaranteed long-term employment. Continued engagement will depend on project requirements, quality of work, and business needs.


Project Timeline & Duration

Based on the information currently provided by the client, this is anticipated to be a short-term project lasting approximately 7–10 days, with a tentative start date of August 31, 2026, and completion date depends on project progress, task completion, and client requirements.

Please note that project timelines are subject to change. The start date may be delayed if additional time is needed to reach required participant numbers prior to project kickoff. Likewise, the project duration and end date may be adjusted based on client needs, workload volume, quality requirements, and overall project demand.

What You Will Do

  • Create and review finance-related prompts, scenarios, and analytical tasks.
  • Evaluate AI-generated responses for financial accuracy, reasoning quality, and business relevance.
  • Apply subject matter expertise to improve model performance and financial understanding.
  • Review financial analyses, assumptions, calculations, and recommendations.
  • Identify inaccuracies, inconsistencies, and areas for improvement.
  • Provide structured feedback and quality assessments.
  • Collaborate with project teams to maintain high-quality deliverables.
  • Meet established project timelines and productivity goals.

Areas of Expertise

We are currently seeking professionals with experience in one or more of the following disciplines:

Investment Banking

  • Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A)
  • Valuation
  • Financial Modeling
  • Corporate Finance
  • Capital Markets

Operational Finance & Assurance (FP&A)

  • Budgeting & Forecasting
  • Financial Reporting
  • Variance Analysis
  • Reconciliations
  • Month-End Close
  • Project Financials
  • Business Performance Analysis
  • Financial Controls
  • KPI Reporting

Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)

  • Budgeting & Forecasting
  • Variance Analysis
  • Strategic Planning
  • Financial Reporting
  • Business Finance

Quantitative Finance

  • Quantitative Modeling
  • Risk Analytics
  • Statistical Analysis
  • Financial Engineering
  • Derivatives

Fixed Income Research

  • Fixed income security analysis
  • Credit research and issuer evaluation
  • Interest rate and yield curve analysis
  • Bond valuation
  • Macro and market research
  • Investment recommendations
  • Portfolio monitoring

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Business, or a related field.
  • Minimum 4 years of professional experience in one of the listed financial disciplines.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
  • Excellent written English communication skills.
  • Ability to evaluate complex financial concepts and explain reasoning clearly.
  • Reliable internet connection and ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Preferred

  • CFA Charterholder or CFA Candidate.
  • ACCA, ACA, CMA, MBA Finance, M.Com, or similar credentials.
  • Experience in financial modeling, valuation, forecasting, budgeting, investment analysis, or quantitative research.
  • Experience reviewing technical content, research, or analytical reports.
  • Exposure to AI, machine learning, data annotation, or model evaluation projects is a plus.

Compensation & Engagement

  • $5.00-$9.00 USD per hour
  • Fully Remote
  • Flexible Schedule
  • No fixed hours per day—based on tasks available
  • Immediate Start Available
  • Part-time

Why Join This Project?

  • Work on innovative AI and financial reasoning initiatives.
  • Apply your professional expertise in a new and rapidly growing industry.
  • Flexible remote work arrangement.
  • Collaborate with a global team of professionals.
  • Gain exposure to emerging AI technologies and financial model evaluation.
  • Opportunity to participate in future projects based on performance and business needs.

We encourage qualified finance professionals who are detail-oriented, analytical, and passionate about financial problem-solving to apply.

MCI is one of the fastest-growing tech-enabled business services companies in the USA, with a strong call center footprint and operations that extend across multiple countries. Our contact centers are powered by both on-site and remote agents, leveraging advanced technologies to enhance customer journeys, drive scalability and reduce costs.

At MCI we are committed to fostering an environment where professionals can build meaningful careers, access continuous learning and development opportunities and contribute to the success of a globally expanding, industry-leading organization.

raw.description:
Job Title: Sr. People Operations Specialist
Location: India (Remote)
Shift: 9:30AM - 6:30PM IST
About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Who You Are

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Sr. People Operations Specialist to join our growing People Operations team. This role is responsible for owning key People Operations processes and ensuring accurate, timely, and consistent delivery across the employee lifecycle.

The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on People Operations experience, is comfortable independently managing complex operational matters, and can identify opportunities to improve processes and employee experience. You are organized, comfortable working with systems and data, and able to collaborate effectively across teams while navigating a fast-paced and ambiguous environment.

You will also contribute to improving operational efficiency, adopting automation and AI-enabled solutions, and driving consistent People Operations practices across the team.

What You’ll Be Doing

People Operations

  • Own key employee lifecycle processes including offboarding, role transitions, promotions, transfers, and other internal movements.

Salesforce Solution Architect

Phoenix Team | Remote (U.S.-based) | Full-Time

Overview

The Salesforce Solution Architect supports projects that define requirements and technical solutions for standing up and enhancing Salesforce environments in support of coordinated, multi-product release and regression testing. This role owns the Salesforce side of the solution design — solution architecture, metadata configuration, sandbox strategy, and integration design — spanning both declarative and programmatic (Apex and Lightning Components) Salesforce customization.

The Salesforce Solution Architect works as part of a team to define requirements, produce solution designs, and establish the operating model needed to bring new or updated environments online. Typical activities include determining sandbox type and sizing; defining metadata configuration and environment refresh approaches; sequencing onboarding of in-scope product groups; evaluating and recommending Salesforce integration approaches; and applying Salesforce data sharing and visibility models to the solution design.

The Salesforce Solution Architect will participate in technical discovery sessions with product, testing, and infrastructure stakeholders. Success in this role requires strong, hands-on Salesforce expertise — the ability to work across both flows/configuration and code — along with the ability to take a holistic view of a project's full scope and translate requirements into a solution design that aligns with VA governance, security, and federal compliance standards.

Key Functions

  • Produce the solution design for the Salesforce (and, in coordination with the team, AWS) components of the environment.
  • Determine sandbox type and sizing needed to support regression testing and performance testing requirements.
  • Define the metadata configuration approach for the environment.
  • Define the Salesforce refresh approach through the VA Salesforce governance group (DTC), including how refresh requests against production are structured and executed.
  • Define the onboarding sequence for product groups being brought into a shared environment.
  • Serve as the technical interface with DTC on sandbox provisioning and sandbox control.
  • Support determination of the environment's designation and naming, and how it fits within the broader Salesforce Org.
  • Support determination of the sandbox control model, including whether the environment operates under program control or DTC control.
  • Confirm the test data approach for the environment and the restrictions that apply, including data representativeness, use of production data, and PII handling.
  • Design Salesforce integration approaches for the environment, evaluating the available integration patterns and recommending the appropriate approach for each interface.
  • Apply Salesforce data sharing and visibility models appropriately within the environment design.
  • Troubleshoot Salesforce performance issues and metadata conflicts, and resolve them as part of the solution design.
  • Support development of Salesforce test data factories and updates to automated test cases needed to support the environment.
  • Take a holistic view of the full scope of the effort, including downstream and cross-product impacts, when designing new sandbox functionality.
  • Maintain compliance with VA security standards and federal requirements, including differences between commercial and GovCloud/FedRAMP configurations.
  • Maintain positive working relationships with federal clients, delivery teams, and technical stakeholders while supporting mission-critical systems.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree and 6 years of relevant experience.
  • An additional 2 years of experience (8 years total) with an Associate's Degree in lieu of a Bachelor's Degree.
  • An additional 4 years of experience (10 years total) with a High School Diploma in lieu of a Bachelor's Degree.
  • Hands-on Salesforce development experience, including Apex and other programmatic customizations, in addition to declarative (flows, configuration) experience.
  • Experience producing Salesforce solution designs, including metadata configuration and sandbox strategy.
  • Experience evaluating and recommending Salesforce integration approaches from among multiple available patterns.
  • Experience with Salesforce data sharing and visibility models.
  • Experience troubleshooting Salesforce performance issues and resolving metadata conflicts.
  • Experience building or maintaining Salesforce test data factories and updating automated test cases to support environment or release changes.
  • Understanding of federal compliance considerations affecting Salesforce solutions, including differences between commercial and GovCloud/FedRAMP environments.
  • Ability to take a holistic view of a project's full scope, including downstream and cross-product impacts, when designing solutions.
  • Strong, hands-on orientation — able to directly configure, build, and troubleshoot rather than operate in a purely advisory capacity.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across technical and operational teams.
  • Ability to shift focus between competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications or Skills

  • Salesforce certification(s) such as Application Architect, System Architect, or Platform Developer II.
  • Experience supporting multi-product Salesforce Orgs where multiple teams release independently.
  • Experience supporting federal government Salesforce implementations, including FedRAMP or GovCloud environments.
  • Experience supporting regression testing or performance testing environment design.
  • Experience using Jira and Confluence.
  • Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies.
  • Experience coordinating sandbox refresh processes through a third-party governance or release management function.

Position Details

  • Employment type: Full-Time, W2
  • Location: 100% Remote (US-based)
  • Hours: 40 hours/week with availability during core business hours of 8am–5pm ET
  • Start date: On or around October 1, 2026
  • Eligibility: Must be eligible to obtain a Public Trust clearance
  • Salary: $144,000–$192,000 annually, commensurate with experience
Salary: $144,000 - $192,000
