raw.description:
Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

**We support 100% remote, in-office, or hybrid work styles for anyone legally eligible to work in the U.S.

A day in the life:

The Group Director, Core is Power Digital's senior client relationship and revenue leader for a portfolio of primarily small business, founder-led clients. Your clients are often making their first serious investment in outside marketing help — the founder is usually the client, the budget is real money out of their own pocket, and a single underperforming month can feel existential in a way it rarely does at the enterprise level. You manage a higher-volume portfolio than almost any other Group Director role, and you run it the way a disciplined fund manager runs a broad, diversified book: fewer swings for the fences on any single account, more rigor in the system that keeps every account healthy. You are the executive a founder calls directly — there's no committee and no VP layer between you and the person who built the business — and the leader an Account Director never wants to let down. The roles you consistently play day-to-day are: portfolio growth owner, talent multiplier, tech forward leader and AI systems thinker.

At Power, retention is the floor, not the job. You are commercially driven first: you personally own executive relationships and expansion revenue for the top of your portfolio, and you hold your team to the same standard. In Core, that means running a scalable, standardized system — foundational packages, repeatable playbooks, and efficient triage — rather than bespoke strategy for every account, because the portfolio is wider and the margin for one-off customization is thinner than at any other tier. You coach Account Directors and their teams to operate as AI-Native Growth Directors — faster, sharper, and less buried in manual work than the role has ever required before. You decide which AI tools and workflows the division adopts. Your influence runs beyond Client Experience: you shape your Division's go-to-market position, you're a thought partner to your Managing Director and VP, and you represent Power Digital in market on how small, founder-led businesses can grow with limited resources.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own net revenue retention and expansion MRR for the division; treat expansion as the primary commercial lever of the role and own the division's monthly service expansion target
  • Personally own executive relationships across the top 10-20% of the portfolio by MRR — direct relationship, not delegated
  • Run quarterly, relationship-focused executive check-ins with top-tier accounts and 1x1 check-ins with every priority account
  • Maintain an accurate, self-owned retention forecast on a weekly basis — accountable for the accuracy of the division's retention data
  • Track vertical-specific signal such as founder engagement and responsiveness, service package utilization, and time-to-first-win on foundational packages, since a disengaged founder or a stalled quick win is often the earliest warning sign of churn at this tier
  • Diagnose risk early and install fixes, not just responses; lead or co-lead quarterly plans for the top 10% of the portfolio, weighted toward strategic outcomes over metrics recaps
  • Partner with Account Directors to build value-based, consultative business cases — expansion should drive value, not be sold
  • Identify and lead common Core expansion paths, including upsell from foundational packages into additional service lines, and efficient, template-driven expansion offers built for speed rather than custom-built proposals
  • Work with Account Directors to keep the Salesforce pipeline current and accurate — stages, forecast, and next steps updated weekly
  • Serve as the frontline for product and vertical innovation, feeding client signal into Power Circuit
  • Build and evolve vertical-relevant reporting frameworks for Core, including metrics such as time-to-first-win, founder engagement/response rate, and package-level utilization, built to work at scale across a high-volume portfolio
  • Play a key leadership role in final-round pitches for prospective clients where support is needed
  • Bring vertical point of view and executive credibility to new business
  • Partner with Sales to sharpen positioning, collateral, and win rate for the division's go-to-market
  • Directly manage Account Directors and oversee the pod that supports them
  • Coach every direct report to operate as an AI-Native Growth Director, not a task manager — faster diagnosis, more client-facing time, less manual reporting
  • Evaluate the team on Pulse sentiment, health scores, and expansion weekly — not just activity
  • Raise the floor on AI adoption — no one on the team operates the old way
  • Own hiring, staffing, capacity, and career pathing for the division; facilitate DAPs and career progression conversations
  • Practice radical candor; deliver timely, actionable feedback that accelerates careers
  • Identify and develop key talent for future Sr. Account Director & Group Director roles
  • Lead training on vertical-specific and AI-native tools, processes, and strategies
  • Vibe-codes prototypes to automate repeatable tasks, surface better insights, and test hypotheses quickly
  • Designs AI workflows for the team — builds the system, not just uses the tools; models AI-forward behavior
  • Runs Omega and Iris across the full portfolio and acts on the patterns they surface
  • Decides which AI tools and workflows get adopted, when, and how across the division
  • Owns division-level AI quality tradeoffs — where AI accelerates output, and where it must never touch client-facing work unreviewed
  • Builds and evolves Power Circuit solutions specific to the division with AI-assisted research; runs a monthly audit to confirm adoption
  • Collaborates with the innovation team on enhancements and optimizations that better serve the division's clients
  • Consulted on the division P&L and accountable for the profitability of the portfolio
  • Forecast the four pillars — Churn, Service Expansion, New Business, Efficiency — in partnership with the MD and VP
  • Use the P&L and strategic growth bets to build the business case for headcount and investment; drive efficiency through technology, AI, and process improvement
  • Own resolution of every escalation in the direct portfolio
  • Partner with Data Intelligence, Media Planning, and Activation teams to keep strategy and execution connected
  • Represent Power Digital in market — speaking, content, and client-facing points of view
  • Become the internal knowledge hub other leaders turn to for vertical and division expertise

Role Requirements

  • Department leadership and management experience required — has led Account Directors or senior marketers as direct reports
  • 10+ years of leadership experience in a digital marketing agency, with small business or founder-led client work at the AD level or above
  • Experience managing a P&L for profitable growth
  • Deep marketing fluency across a high-volume, standardized-service portfolio — foundational packages, repeatable playbooks, and time-to-value; understands where a scaled service model breaks down for an individual account and how to fix it without abandoning the system
  • Channel and program strategy expertise across a standardized service catalog — has built or overseen scalable, template-driven marketing programs, not bespoke enterprise strategy, without sacrificing quality
  • Measurement expertise: keeping reporting simple, fast, and founder-legible — time-to-value and quick-win ROI — and how to translate marketing performance into terms a first-time marketing buyer can act on, without over-engineering the analysis
  • Familiarity with the realities of founder-led decision-making — budget sensitivity tied to personal cash flow, fast decision cycles, and low tolerance for jargon or delay
  • Has presented to and pushed back on a founder or owner when the data supported it — can hold a direct, plain-language conversation about performance and expectations without an intermediary layer
  • Expertise in contract negotiation, client retention, and client growth
  • Proven track record delivering high NPS and retention metrics across a high-volume portfolio
  • Extensive knowledge of owned, earned, and paid marketing channels appropriate for small business budgets — content, SEO, paid search, paid social, and programmatic
  • Familiarity with Core-specific platforms and tools: standardized reporting and dashboarding tools built for scale, CRM systems, and lightweight marketing automation suited to small business budgets
  • Operational discipline — able to run a consistent, efficient system across many accounts rather than reinventing the approach for each one
  • Entrepreneurial spirit — energized by building, not just operating; contributes to product and go-to-market strategy, not just client management

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Primary: Meet or exceed a 60% Expansion-to-Churn Ratio (ETCR) on a trailing 3-month average

Secondary Expectations:

  • 103% net revenue retention (trailing 6-month average)
  • 100% MRR (Monthly Recurring Revenue) Growth target achievement (set annually)
  • $125K in monthly service expansion pipeline creation across the division
  • +90% employee retention rate
  • Portfolio NPS at or above 8 (trailing 12 months)

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Division Business & Team Leadership
  • New Business & Service Expansion Leadership
  • Product Quality, AI & Systems Development
  • Client Portfolio Ownership

Benefits & Perks:

  • Base salary + commission opportunities
  • Robust Medical, Dental, Vision insurance plans with up to 100% employer contribution towards employee monthly premium
  • 401(k) plan - 4% employer contribution matching
  • Unlimited Time Off available on day one
  • Up to 4 hours per quarter for paid Volunteer Time Off (VTO) towards philanthropic endeavors
  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
  • A one time $100 USD Work From Home (WFH) stipend automatically added to your first paycheck
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • 12 observed United States national holidays + 2 mental health recharge days per year
  • Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
  • Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)
  • Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance
  • Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

These engagements may be an attempt to obtain private information, or to induce you to pay a fee for services related to recruitment or training. Power Digital does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fee at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process. All genuine job openings will be posted on our careers page at . We put our long-term personal relationships with clients at the heart of everything we do, so each person feels the esteem and confidence that comes from feeling consistently loved, supported, and valued. We’re not a tech giant, directory service, or gig-work platform. We're a collaborative mental health practice that marries the best of traditional and innovative approaches to pursue the best possible outcomes for our clinicians and our clients.
Unlike other online providers, our clinical therapists are one member of a team, collaborating with peers and a Clinical Director who is responsible for developing and guiding their team. Our clinicians enjoy the full support of a treatment team and the security of W-2 employment, while our patients benefit from the full attention of a robust clinical organization.
Our practice is rapidly growing, and we owe our success to a team-oriented culture that puts people first. As a new provider, expect to feel loved, appreciated, and supported in a way that’s truly unique to WellQor.
How You’ll Make an Impact:
At WellQor, you’ll help your clients overcome mental health challenges, forge better relationships, and be the best versions of themselves. You’ll make a real, tangible difference and feel good about the way you bring joy to the lives of others.
And you won’t have to do it alone. We follow a care-team treatment model, which means clinicians are assigned to teams which they can connect with and consult for advice, institutional knowledge, and continued feedback to help advance you in your career.
In this role you’ll get to:
  • Develop meaningful relationships with patients via tele-therapy.
  • Define your own availability, make your own schedules, and work according to your lifestyle. Some WellQor therapists work part time, and others carry full caseloads. Whatever your lifestyle demands, we’re here to meet you where you’re at.
  • Consult with your clinical director and your regional team on a regular basis for support and feedback.
  • Connect with therapists across the country using our Clinician Connect platform.
  • Allow WellQor to handle credentialing, billing, client intake, marketing, customer service, and other administrative services on your behalf.
  • Participate in company events and receive opportunities for CEU sponsorship.
What we’re looking for:
  • Friendly, professional, and compassionate people.
  • LPCC, LMFT, LMHC, LICSW, LCSW, LCP or equivalent licensed to practice independently.
  • Experience using electronic health record (EHR) systems to document sessions.
  • Comfort using technology in everyday work.
  • A willingness to learn.
What we offer:
  • Medical, dental, and 401k benefits.
  • Competitive compensation paid by the billable hour.
  • PTO and paid holidays.
  • Connection to responsive, professional, and empathetic coworkers and leadership.
  • Schedule flexibility.
  • Full administrative support.
  • An EHR system customized to be easy to use.
Compensation details:
WellQor Therapists are paid by the billable hour and have the flexibility to take on the caseload that they’re interested in carrying at any given time. Hourly compensation is competitive and varies based on license level, relevant experience, and caseload requirements.
Join the WellQor team and connect with your best self today!

We are currently seeking to hire a Product Management Specialist. This role owns the full product lifecycle — from setting strategy, vision, and roadmap to driving delivery across one or more digital domains.

The Product Management Specialist works cross-functionally with engineering, architecture, and business stakeholders to translate complex problems into clear product requirements and ship solutions in Agile environments. They measure and grow product impact through KPIs, analytics, and continuous discovery, while identifying opportunities for new digital offerings and market expansion.

Other responsibilities include:

  • Discovery & Stakeholder Engagement Lead product discovery sessions, stakeholder workshops, and requirements gathering to surface and align on customer needs and business priorities.

  • Requirements Definition Define and prioritize product requirements; translate business problems into detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and product specifications.

  • Technical Collaboration Partner with architecture and engineering teams to assess technical feasibility and evaluate solution options.

  • Agile Delivery & Launch Drive product development from concept through deployment in Agile environments; support releases and adoption activities to ensure successful go-to-market execution.

  • Performance & Continuous Improvement Measure product success through business, customer, and operational KPIs; leverage user feedback, experimentation, and analytics to drive ongoing iteration and improvement.

Success in This Role:

Success will be evaluated based on product delivery, launch execution, customer adoption, business impact, stakeholder satisfaction, and contribution to the broader product portfolio.

The Work:

ICF is seeking an experienced Systems Engineer to support the design, implementation, operation, and maintenance of enterprise network infrastructure supporting critical federal programs. The Systems Engineer will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability, performance, and security of network hardware, operating systems, and communication infrastructure. This role requires strong technical expertise in network engineering, systems administration, troubleshooting, and infrastructure modernization within complex enterprise environments.

Job Location:

This position is remote and requires that the job be performed in the United States. If you accept this position, you should note that ICF monitors employee work locations and blocks access from foreign locations/foreign IP addresses and prohibits personal VPN connections.

  • Our core work hours are 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM Eastern Time, with flexibility to start earlier or work later depending on your time zone. Please note that project meetings may occasionally begin before 10:00 AM Eastern to accommodate client requirements.

  • Limited travel may be required for customer meetings, infrastructure deployments, or team collaboration.

What You Will Do:

The selected candidate will support the administration, maintenance, and enhancement of enterprise network infrastructure while ensuring high availability and operational performance. The Systems Engineer will perform systems engineering activities across network hardware, operating systems, and communication technologies while providing technical support, troubleshooting complex issues, and assisting with infrastructure modernization initiatives. This individual will work closely with network engineers, system administrators, cybersecurity personnel, and project leadership to maintain secure and reliable IT operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Supervise, coordinate, and perform additions, upgrades, and changes to enterprise network hardware, operating systems, and connected devices.

  • Investigate, analyze, recommend, configure, install, and test new network hardware, software, and infrastructure components.

  • Provide day-to-day operational support for enterprise network infrastructure and operating systems.

  • Monitor system utilization, network performance, and response times to ensure optimal system availability.

  • Diagnose and resolve complex network, communications, and infrastructure issues.

  • Troubleshoot network connectivity at both the physical and logical layers using network measurement tools and diagnostic software.

  • Perform hardware testing, configuration validation, and communication protocol analysis.

  • Participate in the planning, design, technical review, implementation, and deployment of new network infrastructure and operating systems.

  • Support voice and data communication networks, ensuring reliable and secure network services.

  • Maintain network infrastructure standards, configurations, and documentation.

  • Configure, monitor, and support TCP/IP networking and other enterprise communication protocols.

  • Collaborate with cybersecurity, systems administration, and engineering teams to ensure secure network operations.

  • Provide technical consultation, mentoring, training, and operational support to IT staff as directed.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, network diagrams, standard operating procedures, and system configurations.

  • Support infrastructure modernization, performance optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • 8+ years of experience supporting enterprise network infrastructure and systems engineering.

  • US citizenship is required by government agency.

  • Candidate must be able to obtain and maintain the required government security clearance.

  • Candidate must reside in the U.S., be authorized to work in the U.S., and all work must be performed in the U.S.

What We Would Like You to Bring with You:

  • Experience configuring, administering, and troubleshooting network hardware and operating systems.

  • Experience supporting enterprise voice and data communication networks.

  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP networking, routing, switching, and network communication protocols.

  • Experience diagnosing and resolving complex infrastructure and communication issues.

  • Experience supporting infrastructure implementation, upgrades, and technology refresh initiatives.

  • Hands-on experience with:

    • Enterprise network infrastructure design and administration

    • TCP/IP networking and communication protocols

    • Routing and switching technologies

    • Windows Server and Linux operating systems

    • Network monitoring and performance management tools

    • Network diagnostic and troubleshooting tools

    • DNS, DHCP, VPN, and firewall technologies

    • Virtualization technologies (VMware, Hyper-V, or similar)

    • Cloud networking (AWS, Microsoft Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform)

    • Infrastructure automation and scripting (PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar)

    • Network security best practices and system hardening

  • Experience supporting Federal Government IT infrastructure is preferred.

  • Industry certifications such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP, CompTIA Network+, Security+, Microsoft, VMware, or equivalent certifications are highly desirable.

  • Experience supporting highly available, mission-critical enterprise environments.

  • Familiarity with ITIL processes and infrastructure lifecycle management.

  • Experience participating in disaster recovery, business continuity, and infrastructure resilience planning.

Professional Skills:

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and support critical operational environments.

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary technical teams.

  • Commitment to delivering reliable, secure, and high-performing enterprise infrastructure.

  • Experience supporting remote or hybrid operational teams is preferred.

Job Title

Account Director (Lead)

Job Summary

This position serves as the primary contact and liaison to external customer on behalf of Noridian. The position works with the Noridian staff to ensure that the contract is optimizing performance, meeting metrics/deliverables and operating on-budget. Account Director also works with contractors, vendors, associations, and providers in the communities associated with these contracts. This position as the main responsibility of providing account management guidance, strategic leadership, planning, and reporting to and from the affected personnel.

Essential Functions

Key Duties/Responsibilities/Accountabilities

  • Ensures the organization meets all contractual and performance expectations in regards to quality, timeliness and change management implementation
  • Cultivates a positive working relationship with the both internal and external customers. Internal customers are the Noridian staff. External customers are the state/federal/commercial entity associated with our contracts
  • Manages the financial performance of our contracts
  • Provides support to the bid and marketing team on growth initiatives
  • Achieves contract expectations for the state contract and attains established Service Level Agreement (SLA) criteria
  • Participates in change management process and reviews to manage contract scope changes.
  • Coordinates budget management for contract
  • Ensures necessary internal controls are established, documented, and adhered to
  • Serves as liaison and primary contact for prime or subcontractors regarding contract performance
  • Supports contract’s technical direction and assures compliance with all Health Insurance Portability & Accountability Act of 1996 (HIPAA) and other legislative mandates
  • Determines and develops the technical/operational needs for program stakeholders
  • Initiates innovative recommendations to customer(s) and prime contractor
  • Recruits, develops, motivates, directs and provides leadership and performance management to professional staff
  • Establishes strategic goals, monitors and reports progress
  • Initiates disciplinary action when performance does not meet expectations
  • Leads by example by promoting team work, recognition, and leadership while demonstrating company values
  • Responds to and implements changes in a flexible, positive manner
  • Coordinates special projects as needed

Non-Essential Duties and Functions

  • Other duties as assigned

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications or related field
  • Masters’ degree in Business, Communications or related field; or additional years of equivalent experience in lieu of Master’s degree
  • 10 or more years of professional experience
  • 7 years’ healthcare experience
  • 5 years’ management experience
  • 3 years’ Medicare/Medicaid experience
  • 3 years managing complex medical review systems and workflow.
  • Public relations, interpersonal, and presentation skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Management and organization skills
  • Excellent MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint skills
  • Problem solving and analytical skills
  • Conflict resolution and negotiation skills
  • Ability to read and comprehend technical documents
  • Ability to define, lead, and manage projects

Preferred Qualifications

Above requirements and the following:

  • Master’s degree in Business Administration or related field
  • 10 years’ healthcare experience
  • 8 years’ management experience
  • 6 years’ specified experience for which the account in which they are leading
  • Experience leading technology projects and teams, preferably in a state or federal public healthcare environment
  • Customer service experience
  • Experience with contracting – terms and negotiations
  • Performance management of subcontractors

Environment and Cognitive/Physical Demands

  • Office Environment
  • Ability to read, hear, speak, keyboard, reason, communicate effectively and problem solve
  • Requires prolonged sitting and telephone use
  • Requires the use of office equipment such as computer, telephones, copiers and printers
  • Infrequent lifting to 15 pounds
  • Infrequent stooping
  • Travel up to 25%

Segregation of Duties

Every employee is responsible to perform their duties and responsibilities in accordance with Noridian values, policies and procedures, including but not limited to: Segregation of Duties Principles, HIPAA, Security and Privacy, CMS requirements, the Noridian Compliance Program and any other applicable laws, rules and regulations.

Statement of Other Duties

This document describes the essential functions, requirements, and responsibilities of this job, and is not intended to be a complete list of all tasks and functions. Employees may be requested to perform job related tasks other than those specifically listed in this description and may be required to perform any task requested by the supervisor or management.

Total Rewards Package:

Health, Dental and Vision Insurance, Voluntary Insurance Plans, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, 401k and Company Match, Company-paid Life Insurance, Education Assistance Program, Paid Sick Leave, Paid Holidays, Increasing PTO Accrual Plan, Medical/Parental/Disability Leave, Workers Compensation, Retiree Benefits, Severance Package, Employee Assistance Program, Financial and Health Wellness Benefits, Casual Dress, Open Office Setting, and Online Learning System.

CMS Access Compliance and Regulation Contingency Statement

Some positions require compliance with (i) federal and agency specific regulations and related clauses included in Noridian's prime contracts with the Government, (ii) background checks, and (iii) eligibility for a government-issued identification card.

An employee in this position may be required to possess a “Federal Identification Card” (Federal ID) as a condition of employment. Federal ID’s may include one of the following: Personal Identity Verification (PIV) card, Personal Identity Verification-Interoperable (PIV-I) card, a Local-Based Physical Access Card issued by CMS, or a Local-Based Physical Access Card issued by another Federal agency and approved by CMS. Obtaining a Federal ID and continued eligibility for this position may require the successful completion of a Federal Background Investigation performed by the Federal Government and a residency requirement that you have lived in the United States at least three out of the last five years. Failure to obtain a Federal ID may result in the removal from the position or termination of employment.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by state or federal law.

The pay range for this position is $104,831 - $158,627 per year. However, the base pay offered may vary depending on geographic region, internal equity, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors.

raw.description:
Collinson is the global, privately-owned company dedicated to helping the world to travel with ease and confidence. The group offers a unique blend of industry and sector specialists who together provide market-leading airport experiences, loyalty and customer engagement, and insurance solutions for over 400 million consumers.

Collinson is the operator of Priority Pass, the world’s original and leading airport experiences programme. Travellers can access a network of 1,500+ lounges and travel experiences, including dining, retail, sleep and spa, in over 650 airports in 148 countries, helping to elevate the journey into something special. We work with the world’s leading payment networks, over 1,400 banks, 90 airlines and 20 hotel groups worldwide.

We have been bringing innovation to the market since inception – from launching the first independent global VIP lounge access Programme, Priority Pass to being the first to sell direct travel insurance in the UK through Columbus Direct and creating the first loyalty agency of its kind in the travel sector with ICLP. Today we still invest heavily in innovation to ensure that we continue to deliver superior customer experiences.

Key clients include Mastercard, American Express, Cathay Pacific, British Airways, LATAM, Flying Blue, Accor, EasyJet, HSBC, Chase, HDFC.

Our mission is focused on doing good beyond profit, which for us means we seek out opportunities for our people to share in our success and that we give back to the communities and people within which we work.

Never short of ambition, the success of our business is delivered through the diverse and talented team of over 2,200 global colleagues.

We're growing our team in Poland and want to be upfront about how this role is structured. As we don't yet have a legal entity in Poland, we work with an Employer of Record (EOR) or umbrella company to onboard talent in the region. This means the role is offered on a fixed term basis via an international contractor agreement — and is fully remote.

Purpose of the job:

The Senior Android Developer at Collinson's Travel Experience division will be at the forefront of

bringing our visionary roadmap to life, focusing on delivering globally appealing, customer centric

solutions. Acknowledging the importance of regional nuances, the chosen candidate will guarantee

that our digital offerings strike a chord at both the universal and localized levels. This role is pivotal in

architecting and developing Android applications that offer a smooth, user-friendly travel experience

for our global clientele.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and build advanced applications for the Android platform.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.

  • Maintain and enhance the existing codebase, with a strong focus on continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD).

  • Identify, fix, and resolve bugs while continuously improving application performance.

  • Ensure optimal performance, quality, and responsiveness of the application.

  • Integrate and maintain third-party libraries and APIs to ensure seamless functionality.

  • Continuously evaluate, adopt, and implement new technologies to improve development efficiency.

  • Work closely with the design team to ensure UI/UX best practices and Material Design guidelines are followed.

  • Identify and address security vulnerabilities to ensure a secure application environment.

  • Stay up to date with the latest Android trends, architectures, and emerging technologies.

Knowledge, skills and experience required:

  • 4 - 8 years of overall software development experience, with 4+ years in mobile application development.

  • Hands-on experience building Android applications, with a strong understanding of Android app architecture, lifecycle, and best practices.

  • Strong focus on user interaction, usability, and visual design, with an eye for detail.

  • Solid knowledge of architectural design patterns such as MVVM, MVP, and Clean

  • Architecture, with proven experience building scalable and modular applications.

  • Proven experience integrating AI-assisted development tools into daily workflows (e.g., code generation, testing, debugging, performance analysis, or automation).

  • Experience with Gradle and dependency management tools such as Maven Central and Version Catalogs.

  • Commitment to writing clean, maintainable code, with experience in testing strategies including unit tests, UI tests (Espresso), and snapshot testing.

  • Good understanding of common mobile design patterns such as dependency injection, observers, and reactive programming.

  • Passion for coding and continuous improvement across frameworks, languages, and development processes.

  • Ability to take ownership and drive the development of impactful features and products end to end.

  • A genuine passion for writing well-structured, readable, and maintainable code.

  • Thrives in a collaborative team environment, eager to learn new technologies, tackle technical challenges, and grow together as a team.

Interview Process:

We want our process to be fair and transparent, so it's only right that we tell you what the various interview stages are:

Stage 1 - We'll do a short call with one of our Engineering Managers for around 30 minutes, who will

tell you more about the team, our products, technology and ask questions about your career history

and suitability for the role.

Stage 2 - You will do a technical test (at home) and we'll review your solution and approach to it

Stage 3 - We'll meet you for 60-90 minutes and you'll get to spend time with different members of

the engineering team (Engineering Manager/Lead). through your technical test and ask

questions on some of your decisions and implementation.

Stage 4 - 30-60 minute discussion with Head of Architecture & Engineering

Collinson is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes differences in all their forms including: colour, race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, neurodivergence, family status, age, individuals with disabilities and people from all backgrounds, cultures and experiences as we strongly believe this contributes to our on-going success.

We are focused on continually evolving our purpose driven, high performing culture, providing an environment where our people have the opportunity to achieve their full potential and do interesting and meaningful work. Our company values are: Take Action, Do the right thing, One team and Be insight led. These help guide everything we do internally in terms of how we think, act and interact, right through to how we deliver value to our customers and clients.

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example - she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

If you need any extra support throughout the interview process, then please email us

raw.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide. Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit .

C3 Presents creates music festival experiences for millions of fans across the globe, setting the new standard each year for events that are as memorable as they are spectacular, including Austin City Limits Music Festival in Texas, Lollapalooza in Chicago (and seven other countries), and Bonnaroo in Manchester, Tennessee.

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

THE JOB

The Financial Analyst supports financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and operational analysis across C3 Presents' festivals, events, and business operations. This role partners with Finance, Accounting, Sponsorship, Legal, Operations, and other business teams to provide accurate financial reporting, insightful analysis, and decision support.

The Financial Analyst is responsible for maintaining financial models, preparing forecasts and reports, analyzing business performance, and supporting budgeting processes. This position plays an important role in ensuring the accuracy of financial information while identifying trends, risks, and opportunities that support sound business decisions.

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

Financial Planning & Analysis

  • Assist with the preparation of monthly forecasts, annual operating budgets, long-range planning, and Capital Expenditure Requests (CERs).
  • Prepare financial reports and analyze variances between actual results, forecasts, budgets, and prior periods.
  • Maintain financial models, forecasting schedules, dashboards, and management reporting.
  • Monitor forecast accuracy and recommend improvements to planning assumptions.
  • Analyze revenue and expense activity to identify trends and investigate reporting discrepancies.
  • Maintain financial tracking schedules and supporting business reports.

Process Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve financial reporting processes, forecasting accuracy, and operational efficiency.
  • Support implementation of reporting enhancements and process improvements.
  • Assist with audit requests, reporting requirements, and financial documentation.

Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare recurring and ad hoc financial analyses for management.
  • Develop reporting packages and dashboards that support departmental decision-making.
  • Support additional finance projects and responsibilities as assigned.
  • Perform additional duties and projects as assigned

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), financial analysis, business analytics, or corporate finance.
  • Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including financial modeling and data analysis.
  • Experience with Oracle, SAP, Hyperion, Adaptive Planning, or similar ERP and forecasting systems preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across multiple departments.

C3 CORE COMPETENCIES

  • Demonstrate integrity in the way you operate in day-to-day business and the way you deal with people
  • Communicate effectively with various audiences by organizing and delivering information appropriately and listening actively to others
  • Proactively seek solutions to problems. Be enthusiastic and energetic in your approach to your job. Commit to putting in extra effort with a positive attitude.
  • Be flexible in handling change, able to juggle multiple demands, and adaptable to new situations with fresh ideas or innovative approaches
  • Stay composed, confident, optimistic, and in problem-solving mode when the going gets tough
  • Possess the skills needed to perform your job well, paying close attention to detail, accuracy, and completeness

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)

YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days

WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program

FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support

CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment

OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.

Live Nation strongly supports equal employment opportunity for all applicants regardless of age (40 and over), ancestry, color, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), family and medical care leave or the denial of family and medical care leave, mental or physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), marital status, domestic partner status, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, military and veteran status, political affiliation, national origin (including language use restrictions), citizenship, race, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, and gender expression, sexual orientation, intersectionality, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law, rule, ordinance or regulation.

We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Los Angeles Fair Chance Ordinance, San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act and consistent with other similar and / or applicable laws in other areas.

We also afford equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with a disability. For this reason, Live Nation will make reasonable accommodations for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual with a disability who is an applicant consistent with its legal obligations to do so, including reasonable accommodations related to pregnancy in accordance with applicable local, state and / or federal law. As part of its commitment to make reasonable accommodations, Live Nation also wishes to participate in a timely, good faith, interactive process with a disabled applicant to determine effective reasonable accommodations, if any, which can be made in response to a request for accommodations. Applicants are invited to identify reasonable accommodations that can be made to assist them to perform the essential functions of the position they seek. Any applicant who requires an accommodation in order to perform the essential functions of the job should contact a Human Resources Representative to request the opportunity to participate in a timely interactive process. Live Nation will also provide reasonable religious accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

HIRING PRACTICES
The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.

Live Nation recruitment policies are designed to place the most highly qualified persons available in a timely and efficient manner. Live Nation may pursue all avenues available, including promotion from within, employee referrals, outside advertising, employment agencies, internet recruiting, job fairs, college recruiting and search firms. Live Nation may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support application screening and assessment. All hiring decisions are made with human review.

Live Nation Entertainment will never request payment or equipment purchases as part of the hiring process. Recruiters will only contact candidates from official Live Nation or affiliated brand email domains.

Sales Development Representative (SDR) / BDR – Outbound Sales & Appointment Setting

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Sales Development Representative (SDR) / Business Development Representative (BDR) / Appointment Setter to generate qualified sales opportunities through outbound prospecting and appointment setting.

This is a hands-on outbound sales role focused on cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn prospecting, lead qualification, follow-up, and meeting generation.

You’ll research prospective companies and decision-makers, start conversations with potential customers, communicate the company’s value proposition, qualify interest, handle objections, and book qualified meetings for the sales team.

If you’re comfortable with outbound outreach, motivated by targets, and enjoy turning cold prospects into sales conversations, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Outbound Prospecting & Lead Generation

  • Conduct outbound prospecting through cold calls, email, LinkedIn, and other channels
  • Research prospective companies, accounts, and decision-makers
  • Identify relevant prospects based on established targeting criteria
  • Personalize outreach based on prospect needs and business context
  • Maintain consistent outbound activity to generate new sales opportunities

Cold Calling & Prospect Engagement

  • Make outbound calls to prospective customers
  • Clearly communicate the company’s value proposition
  • Build rapport and generate interest with cold prospects
  • Handle common objections confidently and professionally
  • Ask effective questions to understand prospect needs
  • Move interested prospects toward a qualified sales conversation

Lead Qualification & Appointment Setting

  • Qualify prospects based on established criteria
  • Determine whether opportunities are appropriate for the sales team
  • Schedule qualified meetings, discovery calls, or demos
  • Ensure Account Executives receive relevant context before meetings
  • Maintain appointment quality, not just meeting volume

Follow-Up & Pipeline Management

  • Follow up consistently with prospects across multiple touchpoints
  • Keep leads engaged until they are ready for the next step
  • Maintain accurate prospect and activity records in the CRM
  • Update lead statuses, notes, follow-ups, and meeting outcomes
  • Ensure qualified opportunities do not fall through the cracks

Performance & KPI Management

  • Work toward defined prospecting and appointment-setting targets
  • Track outbound activity and meeting generation
  • Maintain consistent outreach volume and follow-up discipline
  • Monitor response and conversion performance
  • Continuously improve messaging and objection handling based on results

Requirements

  • 1+ years of experience in SDR, BDR, appointment setting, telemarketing, outbound sales, or a similar role
  • Hands-on experience with outbound prospecting
  • Comfortable making cold calls and speaking with prospective customers
  • Strong spoken and written English
  • Strong communication and objection-handling skills
  • Ability to qualify prospects and book sales meetings
  • Experience with CRM and prospecting tools preferred
  • Strong organization and follow-through
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working toward activity and performance KPIs
  • Reliable internet connection and professional remote-work setup
  • Ability to work U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • B2B sales or business development experience
  • Experience with LinkedIn prospecting and cold email
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce
  • Experience using sales prospecting or lead-generation tools
  • Previous experience booking meetings for Account Executives
  • Experience working in a KPI-driven remote sales environment

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Are confident starting conversations with cold prospects
  • Are comfortable making outbound calls consistently
  • Handle rejection and objections professionally
  • Communicate clearly and persuasively
  • Follow up consistently instead of giving up after one attempt
  • Are motivated by measurable targets and results
  • Stay organized while managing multiple prospects
  • Take ownership of your activity and appointment-setting performance

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent generation of qualified sales meetings
  • Strong outbound prospecting activity
  • High-quality prospect conversations
  • Effective objection handling
  • Consistent and timely prospect follow-up
  • Strong lead-to-meeting conversion
  • Accurate and organized CRM records
  • Achievement of activity and appointment-setting KPIs

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have experience in outbound sales, cold calling, lead generation, appointment setting, or business development and enjoy turning prospects into qualified sales conversations, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help build a strong, consistent sales pipeline.

Turn complex client needs into confident, connected solutions! You will own strategic relationships with property management companies and multifamily property owners, bringing together client priorities, operational performance, product solutions, and internal expertise to deliver meaningful outcomes for clients and their residents.

Overview of the Position
As a Strategic Client Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted partner to a portfolio of Renters Solutions clients. Depending on account size and complexity, your portfolio may include a small number of large, high-touch relationships or a broader group of accounts. You will guide day-to-day service, resolve escalations, lead complex implementations, and connect clients with the right teams and solutions. This is an opportunity to combine strategic thinking with hands-on client leadership in a growing rental market. You will have the autonomy to manage your relationships, the backing of a knowledgeable and tenured team, and exposure to a business investing in new products and AI-enabled growth.

What Makes Us Different?
• Own high-value client relationships and become a trusted advisor to property management companies and multifamily property owners.
• Work across Operations, Product, Sales, Legal, Finance, Compliance, and leadership to solve complex client needs.
• Help shape solutions in a rental market that has delivered more than two years of double-digit growth.
• Join an experienced, collaborative team where colleagues share knowledge and help new team members succeed.
• Thrive with supportive, direct leadership that values openness, coaching, autonomy, and work-life balance.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?
• Lead day-to-day relationships with assigned clients, providing responsive support, clear communication, and proactive guidance.
• Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders at multiple levels, including senior and executive leaders.
• Coordinate reporting, service requests, claims escalations, and other client needs from intake through resolution.
• Monitor service performance, contractual commitments, key business metrics, and revenue goals; identify risks and mobilize action plans when needed.
• Prepare and lead annual and quarterly business reviews, translating performance data into recommendations, decisions, and next steps.
• Guide new client installations, software integrations, product launches, and program enhancements in partnership with internal teams.
• Research and resolve moderate to complex issues by connecting the right stakeholders, clarifying root causes, and communicating remediation plans.
• Identify opportunities to strengthen client outcomes, support retention and growth, and improve how programs operate.
• Partner with Sales, Legal, Product, Finance, Compliance, and executive leadership on contracts, renewals, audits, regulatory matters, and client commitments.
• Maintain the accuracy and integrity of client business arrangements from proposal and implementation through ongoing changes.

What are the requirements needed for this position? 
• 3+ years of executive or strategic level support or account management to high-value clients.
• Bachelor's degree (or equivalent work experience)
• Excellent organization and prioritization skills to manage multiple client needs and competing priorities.
• Exceptional relationship-building skills to establish rapport and guide client conversations.

What Other Skills / Experience Is Helpful to Have?
• Experience in P&C Insurance, property management, or housing industry is highly valuable.

How Much Should I Expect to Travel?
• Remote role based in the United States.
• Approximately 20% travel annually for client meetings, annual and quarterly business reviews, and other business or team meetings.

Pay Range:

$74,600.00 - $124,700.00

Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

raw.title: Senior Backend Developer (freelance)
raw.excerpt: In shortIf you're a backend engineer who doesn't just build what's asked, but shapes how it's built, we want to talk.
raw.description:
In short

If you're a backend engineer who doesn't just build what's asked, but shapes how it's built, we want to talk. We're looking for someone who can own the technical direction of a project end to end: architecture, infrastructure, trade-offs, and the conversations that come with them. You'd join us on a freelance, time & material basis: you're paid for the hours you actually work on real client projects. Full capacity from the start. The first three months are about figuring out if we're a good match. When things work out, and that depends on the work itself, the project pipeline, and business timing, there's a real path to our core team with a permanent contract and full benefits.

Why intent?

We've been designing and co-creating connected devices since 2008. Wearables, smart audio, health-tech hardware for clients like Oura and BOSE, backed by investors like a16z and Founders Fund. We're 60+ people, fully remote, and AI-native since before LinkedIn influencers discovered the term. We use AI every day, in actual work, not just in company decks. Our backend isn't generic CRUD: it's the cloud spine of physical devices, the layer where firmware meets data pipelines, and where one bad architectural call shows up in a sensor reading six months later.

Who this role is NOT for

If your comfort zone is a well-defined Jira board, clear specs, and someone else making the architectural calls, this isn't going to work. We're not hiring a senior developer who executes well. We're hiring someone who decides what gets built, how it gets built, and why. Someone who walks into a room full of ambiguity and starts creating structure, not waiting for it. If you need a ticket to start moving, if "that's not in the requirements" is a sentence you use often, or if you'd rather not be the one explaining a technical trade-off to a client, we're probably not your people. We're AI-native and we expect you to treat AI tools as a daily multiplier, not a gimmick.

What you'll do

  • Own and evolve the backend architecture for IoT projects: data ingestion pipelines, API design, infrastructure decisions

  • Make technical trade-off calls and defend them clearly to the team and to clients

  • Design and maintain cloud infrastructure on AWS (EKS, Aurora, DynamoDB, Timestream, S3) with production-grade reliability

  • Lead technical discussions: RFCs, architecture reviews, post-mortems, because you see the need, not because someone asked

  • Mentor other backend engineers, raise the bar on code quality, and set patterns others can follow

  • Work side by side with firmware engineers, mobile developers, QA, PMs, and clients

  • Use AI tools as part of your daily workflow, not as a party trick

  • Challenge product and technical assumptions when something doesn't add up, even when it means a harder conversation

How we work

Fully remote. We have a pet-friendly office in Warsaw and a coworking space in Gdansk if walls and coffee machines motivate you, but nobody will ask why you're not there. Working hours are flexible: most of the team operates between 10:00 and 18:00 CET, and that's when most meetings happen. Evening calls with US-based clients (up to ~20:00) are part of the rhythm, sometimes a couple of times a week, always planned ahead. You'll be part of the Mobile chapter (which covers backend/cloud too) for knowledge-sharing, and at the same time on a project squad led by a PM for day-to-day delivery.

What you'll get

  • 90-180 PLN/h net B2B, depending on your experience

  • Truly flexible hours: you organize your day

  • Fully remote, with pet-friendly Warsaw office + Gdansk cowork if you want them

  • Access to our internal knowledge-sharing: tech talks, experiments, side projects

  • When the first 3 months work out, and that depends on the work, the project pipeline, and business timing, there's a real path to a permanent contract with a fixed monthly salary, 26 days paid leave, 10 sick days, Saltus medical care, and a training budget

No sugarcoating: during the freelance period there's no paid leave or medical benefits. Those come with the permanent contract, and we're transparent about that upfront.

Your first weeks

We aim to give you space to ramp up before jumping into live project work, but this is a real company with real deadlines: if the project needs you sooner, we'll make sure you have the support to hit the ground running. You'll get paired with a technical buddy and tackle progressively bigger tasks, so both sides can see how the collaboration feels. Feedback comes early and often, no one waits three months to tell you something isn't working. If it's great, you'll know. If something needs adjusting, you'll hear about it while there's still time to adjust.

Recruitment process

The entire process is in English. All interviews are recorded for internal evaluation purposes.

  1. Application with a few screening questions

  2. HR call, ~45 min, casual

  3. Technical meeting, ~90 min, with the technical team

  4. Final feedback within a few days

Once we're in touch, you'll hear from us fast. We don't ghost and we don't drag.

One more thing

intent is an equal opportunity employer. We care about what you can do, not where you come from. Send us your CV and a few words about why this caught your eye. Bonus points if you share something you've built that made you proud, ideally something where the architecture mattered.

  • English at B2+, written and spoken: you'll be in rooms with US-based clients and you need to hold your own

  • The ability to translate business needs into technical decisions and explain those decisions to non-technical stakeholders

Nice to have

raw.excerpt: Product Operations Lead, Insurance PlatformCounterpart is an insurtech platform reimagining management and professional liability for the modern workplace.
raw.description:
Product Operations Lead, Insurance Platform

Counterpart is an insurtech platform reimagining management and professional liability for the modern workplace. We believe that when businesses lead with clarity and confidence, they become more resilient, more innovative, and better prepared for what's ahead. That's why we built the first Agentic Insurance™ system, where advanced AI and deep insurance expertise come together to proactively assess, mitigate, and manage risk. Backed by A rated carriers and trusted by brokers nationwide, our platform helps small businesses grow with confidence.

You'll build the systems and conditions that let a small team run a national platform: hunting bottlenecks, removing them, and making sure they don't come back, so product, underwriting, and engineering can move at the pace the company needs.

This role touches every part of how an insurance product works (coverage language, pricing, filings, distribution) and every part of how an AI native company runs. What we're looking for is operational rigor: relentless follow through, quick learning, and the judgment to keep a cross functional team on track and moving efficiently, no matter how complex the surface area gets.

HOW YOU OPERATE

  • Find the biggest bottleneck in a function, fix it, then move to the next one. You'll be judged on how many you clear, not how many you document.
  • Remove unnecessary steps before adding new ones.
  • Use AI daily in your own work. You should be one of the heaviest AI users in the company.

Own New Product Launches, End to End

  • Lead new product launches from kickoff to the point where they run on their own, without you day to day.
  • Translate product strategy into clear specifications for pricing, data, and engineering, so requirements don't get lost or reinterpreted.
  • Set the build order with engineering and data, and hold that order when priorities compete.

Turn Expert Judgment Into Systems

  • Build a simple way for underwriting and pricing experts to enter their own rules and judgment into our systems, so they don't need to route through you.
  • Keep terminology consistent across every system, model, and team, and update it as the business grows.
  • Set up fast, accurate feedback from policies, claims, and lost deals, so we know quickly what's working and what needs to change.

Own Change Control and Quality

  • Create and run one clear process for any change to what we sell (coverage, rules, pricing), so changes don't happen ad hoc.
  • Catch problems in testing before they reach a customer.
  • Move existing programs onto shared infrastructure instead of maintaining separate one off setups.

YOU HAVE

  • 7+ years solving complex problems through process and product development, or a clear track record of taking on more scope and responsibility over time.
  • A systems thinker who obsesses over problems and builds solutions that scale, rather than one off fixes.
  • Exceptional project management and documentation skills, with the ability to run multiple workstreams at once without dropping detail.
  • A self starter mindset: comfortable rolling up your sleeves in a lean, fast moving environment.
  • Real, daily comfort working with AI agents (delegating to them, checking their work, improving them). You automate a task the second time you do it, not the tenth.
  • Evidence of grit: something you've pushed through more than once, even when it would have been easier to stop.
  • Insurance background is a plus, not a requirement. If you have exposure to policy forms, rate and rule filings, or systems like SERFF, that's a bonus, not a prerequisite.

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH:

  • Tobias Schuler, Chief Underwriting Officer: After becoming a Fellow of the Casualty Actuarial Society & working as a consultant actuary at EY for several years, Tobias went on to drive the actuarial data & systems teams at QBE. He further leveraged his deep insurance & technical expertise at Munich Re Digital Partners in North America, where he headed data & analytics & oversaw the data infrastructure behind some of their largest programs.
  • Dave Lin, Head of Product and Engineering: Dave has built and scaled B2B platforms at Yext, Apple, Amazon, and Hookit. He received his MS and BS in Electrical Engineering from University of California, San Diego
  • Stanley Wang, Senior Director, Pricing Analytics: Before joining Counterpart, Stanley worked as an actuary within the pricing solutions and methods team at USAA to combine actuarial pricing with data science models. Before that, he was a leading data scientist for Digital Partners, a Munich Re Company where he specialized in building data science models and insights for leading insurtech companies. He has had many other relevant roles such as capital modeling, risk management etc. He lives in New York with his growing family.
  • Chris Shafer, Chief of Staff: Chris is a published scientific author, having studied the neural correlates of gratitude at the lauded Brain and Creativity Institute. He has since helped to launch numerous businesses in which he held a variety of critical roles from product management to business operations to strategic partnerships. Chris received his bachelor’s degree in Biological Sciences from the University of Southern California.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Unlimited Vacation: We offer flexible time off, allowing you to take time when you need it.
  • Work from Anywhere: Counterpart is a fully distributed company, meaning there is no office. We allow employees to work from wherever they do their best work, and invite the team to meet in person a couple times per year.
  • Stock Options
  • Health, Dental, and Vision Coverage
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Parental Leave
  • Home Office Allowance: to set up your home office with the necessary equipment and accessories.
  • Book stipend
  • Wellness stipend
  • Professional Development Reimbursement
  • No working birthdays: Take your birthday off, giving you the opportunity to relax, enjoy your special day, and spend time with loved ones.
  • Charitable Contribution Matching

COUNTERPART'S VALUES

  • Conjoin Expectations - it is the cornerstone of autonomy. Ensure you are aware of what is expected of you and clearly articulate what you expect of others.
  • Speak Boldly & Honestly - the only failure is not learning from mistakes. Don’t cheat yourself and your colleagues of the feedback needed when expectations aren’t being met.
  • Be Entrepreneurial - control your own destiny. Embrace action over perfection while navigating any obstacles that stand in the way of your ultimate goal.
  • Practice Omotenashi (“selfless hospitality”) - trust will follow. Consider every interaction with internal and external partners an opportunity to develop trust by going above and beyond what is expected.
  • Hold Nothing As Sacred - create routines but modify them routinely.Take the time to reflect on where the business is today, where it needs to go, and what you have to change in order to get there.
  • Prioritize Wellness - some things should never be sacrificed. We create an environment that stretches everyone to grow and improve, which is fulfilling, but is only one part of a meaningful life.

Our estimated pay range for this role is $170,000 to $200,000. Base salary is determined by a variety of factors, including but not limited to, market data, location, internal equitability, and experience.

We are committed to being a welcoming and inclusive workplace for everyone, and we are intentional about making sure people feel respected, supported and connected at work—regardless of who you are or where you come from. We value and celebrate our differences and we believe being open about who we are allows us to do the best work of our lives.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate against qualified applicants or employees on the basis of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual preference, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law, rule, or regulation.

The Web Implementation Specialist builds, configures, and reviews WordPress websites for foreUP customers. This role organizes and implements customer-provided content and assets while using WordPress, HTML, CSS, and technical troubleshooting skills to create responsive, accessible, and search-friendly websites. The specialist also completes pre-launch quality assurance, resolves website issues, applies SEO and WCAG best practices, documents findings, and collaborates with internal teams to deliver high-quality websites on schedule.

Some of the things you'll do:

  • Build and update WordPress websites using approved designs, templates, content, and brand standards.
  • Create responsive page layouts, navigation, forms, and reusable components using WordPress, HTML, CSS, and working knowledge of JavaScript.
  • Work with themes, child themes, page builders, custom fields, plugins, and WordPress settings beyond basic drag-and-drop tools.
  • Migrate and organize website content while improving formatting, usability, SEO, internal linking, metadata, and accessibility.
  • Troubleshoot website layout, styling, plugin, browser, mobile, hosting, performance, and integration issues.
  • Complete website quality assurance across devices and browsers, including links, forms, navigation, redirects, tracking, and responsive layouts.
  • Identify and correct common ADA/WCAG accessibility issues using automated scanning and manual testing.
  • Apply SEO and GEO best practices, including page titles, headings, meta descriptions, image optimization, schema, redirects, and internal linking.
  • Support the configuration and validation of GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, conversion tracking, and approved integrations.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to resolve issues, improve website performance, and deliver projects on schedule.

Working arrangements:

Fully Remote in United States of America: You can work fully remote in this position, provided you have eligible working rights in United States of America and do not require sponsorship.

Qualifications

What would make me a good candidate?

We are looking for curious and empathetic people. We also love to hear from people who are motivated by meaningful work, resonate with our core values, have a positive outlook, are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive working in an ever-evolving and complex environment. We are inspired by meeting big-picture thinkers and doers, people who can be both tactical and strategic, aim high and put people first in everything they do.

You'll need:

  • 3+ years of hands-on WordPress development, implementation, or technical website operations experience.
  • A portfoliodemonstratingcomplete WordPress websites and technical customization beyond basic content entry or page-builder use.
  • Strong knowledge of HTML5 and CSS3, with working knowledge of JavaScript, responsive design, browser compatibility, and code inspection.
  • Experience configuring and troubleshooting WordPress themes, plugins, templates, and site settings.
  • Practical knowledge of website accessibility and WCAG best practices, including experience resolving ADA-related accessibility issues.
  • Working knowledge of SEO and GEO/AI search optimization, including metadata, schema, internal linking, page speed, and mobile usability.
  • Experience with website QA, responsive and browser testing, launch checklists, DNS, SSL, redirects, caching, backups, and deployments.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills with the ability to manage multiple website projects and deadlines.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Bachelor's degree in web development, Information Technology, Digital Media, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

It would be great if you also have:

  • Experience with PHP, the WordPress template hierarchy, hooks, filters, and safe customization practices.
  • Experience with WP Engine or another managed WordPress host, including staging, backups, caching, redirects, domains, and deployments.
  • Experience using accessibility testing tools and familiarity with ADA, Section 508, and VPAT/ACR documentation.
