About Presence

Presence is the leading provider of teletherapy solutions for children with diverse needs. Our award-winning technology connects speech-language pathologists, school psychologists, occupational therapists, and mental health specialists to K-12 school districts nationwide. With a growing network of over 2,000 clinicians and more than 8 million teletherapy sessions delivered, we’re dedicated to ensuring every child has access to the support they need.

At Presence, we embrace the benefits of being a remote-first company while recognizing the importance of in-person connection to advance our mission. We place a high value on “cameras on” engagement, schedule coordination, and cross-functional communication to stay connected while working in different places. Travel is also an important part of many roles, helping us build stronger relationships with our teams, clinicians, and school partners. The frequency will vary by role and responsibilities, but may include activities such as department offsites, team gatherings, and school or industry events.

About the role:

We’re looking for a Marketing Web Developer to join our team. Reporting to the Marketing Director and working closely with our Marketing and Creative teams, you’ll own the management and optimization of our website, keeping it secure, accessible, and user-friendly while growing our visibility across search and emerging AI search channels. You’ll own the full lifecycle of web pages and projects, from brief to launch, formulating web solutions that meet business goals and create engaging, user-friendly experiences. This role is perfect for someone who thrives at the intersection of technical execution and creative strategy, and offers the opportunity to leverage your technical expertise, creative insight, and strategic thinking to drive the success of our digital presence - all while contributing to a mission-driven organization that helps children with special needs.

To stay connected, all employees commit to being available on-camera during our Core Working Hours (Monday - Friday, 12 - 5 p.m. ET) with standard business hours of 9 a.m. - 6 p.m. in your local time zone. For this role, up to 10% travel may be required to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

What will you do at Presence:

Website Management & Development

    • Own our WordPress website, including day-to-day operations, technical troubleshooting, and monthly maintenance
    • Use website analytics to identify opportunities and implement UI/UX improvements that enhance accessibility, performance, and engagement.
    • Work closely with the creative team during design discussions, offering technical guidance on feasibility, best practices, and adherence to global systems and standards.
    • Translate Figma design systems and prototypes into responsive, production-ready builds
    • Implement responsive design to ensure consistency and usability across devices and screen sizes.
    • Integrate third-party tools, APIs, and analytics tracking in partnership with cross-functional teams.

Website Project Management

    • Own website projects end-to-end, from brief support through launch, with clear success metrics, stakeholder alignment, and QA along the way.
    • Support larger project-based initiatives such as website migrations or redesigns, in collaboration with the Marketing Director and other stakeholders.

AEO / SEO / GEO & Reporting Strategy

    • Drive AEO / SEO / GEO strategy, expanding search and AI citation presence across channels, closing content gaps through research and audits, and implementing on-page best practices such as meta tags, headings, and structured data markup.
    • Conduct keyword research and analysis to improve website visibility and search rankings.
    • Partner with the content team to provide insights and recommendations for website content aligned with optimization strategies.
    • Build automated reporting on web and search performance, monitor key metrics, and present insights and recommendations

What we are looking for:

  • 5+ years building and maintaining production websites, with substantial WordPress experience
  • Strong hands-on Elementor (or comparable page builder) skill, plus solid HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  • PHP and custom WordPress theme or plugin development
  • Git and modern development workflows, ideally on WP Engine
  • REST APIs and third-party integrations
  • GA4 and Google Tag Manager (including event and data layer configuration) or similar tools for measuring and improving web and marketing performance
  • Ability to build reports and dashboards, and clearly communicate findings and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders
  • In-depth SEO knowledge and a track record of successful strategies, including AEO/GEO and AI search visibility
  • Practical WCAG 2.2 knowledge and sound judgment about handling sensitive data
  • Experience owning a production system as the responsible party, with clear patching and access practices
  • Strong eye for design detail and consistency, with the ability to translate a Figma design file or system into a polished, on-brand page
  • Self-directed, with strong prioritization across multiple projects
  • Clear, proactive communication, comfortable taking remote direction from the Marketing Director and collaborating across teams
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to technical challenges

What else you might bring:

  • K-12, healthcare, or another regulated environment
  • A migration or replatform under your belt
  • CI/CD, A/B testing and experimentation

What will help you succeed here:

  • Our team is committed to shared principles of inclusivity. We engage with all stakeholders in a spirit of listening, learning, and broadening our perspectives.
  • We commit to a growth mindset. We don’t use energy to explain why something can’t be done; we figure out how to make it happen.
  • We are mission-driven. Our work helps more children with special needs receive the necessary support. We believe that our work is essential, meaningful, and urgent.
  • We believe in data-driven decision-making, measuring outcomes, and iterative improvement.
  • You seek creative, effective solutions and persist beyond the first answer to find what truly works
  • You deliver high-quality work on time, and you proactively seek support or guidance when challenges arise

How we support you:

  • Comprehensive benefit plans, including medical with a High Deductible Plan and generous HSA contribution, plus dental and vision coverage
  • In addition to 11 observed holidays, salaried team members have flexible paid time off and hourly team members accrue 15 days paid time off starting
  • 401K savings plan with a discretionary company match
  • $500 home office stipend
  • Benefits package including company-paid life insurance, AD&D, Employee Assistance Program, and disability benefits
  • Wellness programs with Headspace, Peloton and One Medical
  • Paid parental and caregiving leave
  • Professional Development opportunities - eligibility to apply for our scholarship program
  • Collaborative, inclusive, and fun culture that is recognized as Great Place to Work certified
  • Employee Resource Groups to promote shared community and belonging
  • A meaningful and fulfilling opportunity to join a mission-driven team and help thousands of students unlock their full potential through access to high-quality special education services
  • Opportunities to give back to your community, including volunteer time off and donation matching

An employee’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, and market conditions. We aim to pay competitively for our size and industry.

The annual base salary range for this role is $115,000.00 - $135,000.00

raw.excerpt: Form Health is a virtual obesity medicine clinic delivering physician-led, evidence-based care for obesity and related cardiometabolic conditions.
raw.description:
Form Health is a virtual obesity medicine clinic delivering physician-led, evidence-based care for obesity and related cardiometabolic conditions. Obesity affects more than 40% of U.S. adults, and as GLP-1 medications reshape the field, Obesity and Cardiometabolic Medicine is in a period of rapid growth and opportunity. Form Health is at the forefront of that shift, building a clinical model that combines rigorous, personalized medical care with the technology to make it accessible at scale.

Every Form Health patient works closely with a dedicated multidisciplinary Care Team, including board-certified physicians (many ABOM-certified, and endocrinologists), advanced practice providers, and Registered Dietitians who together deliver comprehensive, one-on-one treatment that includes nutrition, behavioral health, physical activity, and FDA-approved medication, if appropriate. Through our mobile app, patients engage in regular video visits along with text messaging, photo journaling, and personalized educational content. We hold ourselves to the highest standards of clinical care and to treating every individual with empathy and respect.

Founded in 2019, Form Health is a venture-backed, mission-driven company partnering with leading employers and health plans to expand access to high-quality, guideline-based obesity and cardiometabolic care nationwide. We're deeply invested in our core value of putting patients first, and equally committed to building a culture where every employee is valued and we learn and grow together.

About the Role:

The Care Delivery team builds the tools that let our clinical team run a high-performing virtual practice — from prescribing and prior authorizations to the day-to-day workflows clinicians rely on to do their best work with patients. This role is highly visible within Form Health: the tools you ship directly shape how our clinical team practices and, downstream, how our patients experience care. We're looking for someone who's genuinely energized by hard, regulated, multi-stakeholder problems — with clinical, patient, payer, and operational constraints — as well as someone who uses AI as a real part of supercharging their work, rather than a buzzword on a resume.

This role will report to our Lead Product Manager for Care Delivery, with significant ownership from day one and plenty of room to help shape how the practice scales as the team grows. This role is fully remote and can be located anywhere in the U.S. (Note: while not required, it is beneficial to be in or close to the Eastern Time zone given frequent collaboration with our Boston-based clinical and operations leaders)

What You Will Do:

  • Deeply understand Form Health's clinical and business needs: identify and prioritize jobs-to-be-done using research and user feedback
  • Own key care delivery capabilities end-to-end — e.g., prescribing, prior authorizations, virtual visit workflows
  • Partner with clinical leadership to triage and prioritize incoming product requests, balancing clinical needs against broader roadmap priorities
  • Translate business and user needs into clear product requirements, including user stories, use cases, and functional specs
  • Partner with engineering, design, operations, and clinical teams to ship best-in-class tools for our clinical practice
  • Track key program and product metrics for your area, and report on progress and health to Form Health's leadership team
  • Facilitate sprint planning, standups, backlog grooming, and retrospectives to keep the team aligned and shipping
  • Partner with clinical education and enablement to roll out new features smoothly — change management, communications, and training
  • Identify where AI and automation can responsibly reduce clinical or administrative burden (e.g., documentation, prior-auth workflows, care coordination), and partner with engineering to evaluate and ship those capabilities thoughtfully

About You:

  • 5+ years building enterprise experiences with complex workflows
  • Comfortable diving into technical problems — APIs, workflows spanning homegrown and third-party systems
  • Clear communicator cross-functionally in a remote-first environment
  • A track record that includes:
    • Evaluating third-party vendors and driving coordination across multiple systems
    • Defining where a product should go, rallying a team behind it, and delivering results iteratively
    • Owning a product area end-to-end — strategy and prioritization through rollout and adoption
  • Fluent in using AI as part of your own PM craft — drafting specs, synthesizing research, prototyping — and curious about where AI can responsibly augment clinical operations
  • Proactive ownership over your area of responsibility, with a strong sense of accountability and an execution-oriented mindset — comfortable applying structure to ambiguous situations in a fast-growing startup
  • Genuinely excited to make compassionate, evidence-based healthcare accessible — and energized, not deterred, by the complexity of a regulated, high-stakes domain

Preferred:

  • Understanding of healthcare, virtual care delivery, or health insurance
  • Experience shipping AI-powered features, ideally within a tech-enabled services organization
  • Prior experience in a startup and/or high growth environment

More about Form Health’s benefits:

  • Competitive salary and equity in a high growth start-up
  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)
  • 401k program
  • Flexible work schedules and paid time off
  • Paid parental leave

Form Health’s commitment to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive work environment:

Form Health is committed to creating a culture and environment that celebrates diversity and inclusion, while fostering safety and belonging. This extends from our remote patient care to our corporate offices and everywhere in between. We are looking for team members who want to help us further our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) efforts and who share our attitudes for creating an inclusive, safe, and positive work environment.

Base Annual Salary
$150,000—$180,000 USD

raw.description:
About us

Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.

Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.

About the role

The Senior Security Analyst helps protect Coalition policyholders from cyber loss by assessing security risk, investigating incidents and claims, and translating technical findings into practical recommendations. The role sits within Coalition’s Security team, working across threat intelligence, cyber risk management, and defensive security controls.

This role connects security analysis to business and product execution. In addition to advising customers and security leaders, the analyst partners with Product and internal stakeholders to codify security best practices into underwriting algorithms, rating models, risk-management applications, and internal processes.

Responsibilities

  • Assess the security posture of insureds and prospective insureds across programs, technologies, controls, and business environments.
  • Investigate incidents and cyber insurance claims to identify root cause, attack vectors, control gaps, and opportunities for prevention.
  • Advise customers and security leaders on practical, prioritized improvements across architecture, cloud security, data protection, and compliance.
  • Translate threat intelligence and observed attacker behavior into detection tradecraft and actionable security recommendations.
  • Partner with Product and cross-functional teams to improve risk models, underwriting approaches, and security-focused applications.
  • Track emerging practices, regulatory developments, and industry trends to inform Coalition’s customers, processes, and products.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Background & Domain
    • 2–4 years of experience in security analysis, defensive or blue-team operations, penetration testing, red-team work, incident response, or cyber risk consulting.
    • Experience assessing security programs, investigating incidents, or analyzing control effectiveness in complex business environments.
    • Exposure to cloud security, security architecture, data protection, threat intelligence, or cyber insurance is particularly relevant.
  • Technical & Regulatory
    • Strong understanding of network threats, attack vectors, exploitation methods, and intrusion-set tactics, techniques, and procedures.
    • Practical knowledge of TCP/IP, network analysis, security technologies, logs, and network traffic captures.
    • Familiarity with NIST, ISO, HIPAA, and PCI frameworks, and the ability to connect requirements to real-world controls.
  • Collaboration & Influence
    • Able to turn ambiguous technical evidence into clear conclusions and prioritized business recommendations.
    • Comfortable communicating with security practitioners, business stakeholders, customers, and executive audiences, including CISOs.
    • Collaborative and self-directed, with the judgment and initiative expected at the P4 level.
    • Effective in a fast-paced, evolving environment where they can help improve processes and products.

Skills and Qualifications

  • 2–4 years of experience in security analysis, blue-team or defensive security, penetration testing, red-team operations, incident response, or a related discipline.
  • Expert understanding of network threat lifecycles, attack vectors, exploitation methods, and attacker TTPs.
  • Knowledge of TCP/IP protocols, network analysis, and network and security applications, including log analysis and network traffic capture analysis.
  • Ability to investigate incidents and claims, determine root cause, and recommend effective preventive or detective controls.
  • Familiarity with NIST, ISO, HIPAA, and PCI frameworks and their practical application.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide clear recommendations to technical and executive audiences.

Bonus Points

  • Experience analyzing cyber insurance claims or translating security findings into underwriting, rating, or risk-scoring inputs.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud security, security architecture, data protection, or security control assessments.
  • Background in threat intelligence and developing detection tradecraft from observed attacker behavior.
  • Experience advising CISOs or customers on prioritizing security improvements based on risk, feasibility, and business context.
  • Demonstrated ability to create or improve internal security processes, products, or analytical methodologies.

Compensation

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. The US base salary for this position ranges from $94,000/year in our lowest geographic market up to $140,000/year in our highest geographic market. Consistent with applicable laws, an employee's pay within this range is based on a number of factors, which include but are not limited to relevant education, skills, job-related knowledge, qualifications, work experience, credentials, and/or geographic location. Your recruiter can share more on target salary for your location during the interview process. Coalition, Inc. reserves the right to modify this range as needed.

Perks

  • 100% medical, dental and vision coverage
  • Flexible PTO policy
  • Annual home office stipend and WeWork access
  • Mental & physical health wellness programs (One Medical, Headspace, Wellhub, and more)!
  • Competitive compensation and opportunity for advancement

Why Coalition?

Work at Coalition is centered on the joint mission to Protect the Unprotected. We have built a remote-first, highly inclusive culture that welcomes people from diverse backgrounds. We trust each other to take responsibility, share ownership of outcomes, and put in the work together to protect businesses from digital risk. Coalition’s exceptional growth stems from its ability to address real-world problems for organizations of all sizes while remaining true to our founding values of character, humility, responsibility, purpose, authenticity, and inclusion.

We’re always looking for collaborative, inquisitive individuals to join #OurCoalition.

Visit our Newsroom >

Privacy Notice

Coalition is committed to protecting your privacy and handling your personal information responsibly. We collect, use, and store personal information as necessary for the recruitment process and in compliance with applicable privacy laws and regulations in all regions where we operate. We want you to understand what personal information we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding access, correction, and deletion of your data where applicable. Information submitted, collected, and processed as part of your application is subject to Coalition's Privacy Policy. For further details, please review our full Privacy Policy or contact us with any questions regarding how your information is handled.

Our Privacy Policy >

Safe Hiring Notice

All legitimate communication from Coalition comes from @coalitioninc.com emails, and open roles are listed only on our Careers page. We never ask for payment, banking details, or personal identification before an offer is accepted through our secure systems. If you believe you’ve been a victim of fraudulent recruiting, follow guidance from the Federal Trade Commission (FTC).

Anti-Discrimination Notice

Coalition is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Our policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all individuals, without discrimination or harassment on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable laws in each country where we operate. This commitment includes, but is not limited to, ensuring equal treatment in recruitment, selection, training, promotion, transfer, compensation, and all other aspects of employment. Coalition does not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, and we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace.

Accommodations

Coalition is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, including applicants and employees, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations in each country where we operate. Our policy is to support equal opportunity in the hiring process by considering qualified applicants regardless of disability or other protected characteristics, unless providing accommodation would impose an undue hardship or disproportionate burden. If you require accommodation to complete an application, interview, pre-employment testing, or participate in the selection process, please contact us at . Meet the Team

Cisco Security Business Group (SBG) is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer in a customer-facing role that focuses on technical leadership, two-way advocacy, and expertise across our Security Service Edge (SSE) portfolio.

This role combines deep SWG/SSE, networking and security expertise with the opportunity to influence product direction, solve critically important customer challenges, and serve as the technical link between product, engineering and our most strategic enterprise customers.

Cisco SSE offers a comprehensive end-to-end zero trust access security portfolio including VPN, zero trust access, web inspection in the cloud, firewall as a service, CASB, DLP and more. Cisco SSE deployment flexibility allows customers to select solutions tailored to their needs and transition seamlessly as requirements evolve.

You work globally across regions and time zones in support of our largest and most strategic SSE customers, coordinating with globally distributed engineering teams! Expect participation in a follow-the-sun escalation model and significant travel to customer sites and engineering hubs.

Your Impact

Serve as the technical liaison between Cisco SSE product management and engineering and our largest, most strategic enterprise SSE customers! Represent the product organization to customers by clearly recommending deployment best practices, issue findings, root causes, workarounds, product constraints, and delivery timelines. Represent the customer within the product organization by bringing production context, business impact, operational constraints, and technical requirements into build and prioritization discussions. Own sophisticated escalations, balancing realistic customer expectations with accurate, reproducible technical evidence while advocating for outcomes that protect customer environments. Translate requirements, RCAs, and technical decisions between customer and engineering contexts without losing fidelity on either side.

Key responsibilities:

  • Lead the technical relationship on a named set of large and/or strategic SSE accounts, including critical issues end to end.

  • Drive proactive account health by improving deployment and rollout planning, configuration and policy consistency.

  • Build clean escalations for engineering - timeline, impact, repro, logs, pcaps, redacted configs - and translate outcomes back to the customer.

  • Feed recurring customer patterns back into product and engineering roadmaps as concrete requirements.

  • Build and support the CX-driven runbooks and documentation from lessons learned and for future SSE deployments.

  • Script (Bash/Python) for diagnostics, health checks, automations, and lab reproduction.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field with 10+ years of professional experience in networking, security, or cloud infrastructure; or a Master's degree with 7+ years of experience.

  • 7+ years in networking/security with direct customer ownership.

  • Experience with DNS, routing, IPsec tunnels, TLS, SAML, SWG/Web Proxy, and cloud networking.

  • Experience across zero trust access, VPN, web inspection in the cloud, CASB, DLP, and firewall policy.

  • 5+ years of experience with identity and SSO integrations (SAML/OIDC, SCIM) in enterprise deployments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience handling on-premises and cloud security/networking products in production customer environments.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence customer expectations and recommend successful SaaS deployment and adoption strategies.

  • Experience supporting large multinational enterprise accounts with global SSE or SASE rollouts.

  • Ability to work effectively across time zones and cultures in a distributed engineering organization.

  • Coding experience with Bash, Python, or similar.

  • Ability to advocate for both viewpoints—customer urgency and engineering feasibility—without distorting either.

  • Ability to communicate engineering updates to executive and technical customer audiences, and customer context to engineering.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

raw.excerpt: Position OverviewWe are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Operations Coordinator to own the job pipeline from intake through invoice — tracking every active job, driving progress at each stage, and making sure nothing sits without action.
raw.description:
Position Overview

We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Operations Coordinator to own the job pipeline from intake through invoice — tracking every active job, driving progress at each stage, and making sure nothing sits without action. This role is the operational engine that keeps jobs moving, keeps the team informed, and keeps the insurance process on track.

A significant portion of this role involves direct communication with insurance companies — calling adjusters, following up on claims, tracking appraisal status, and pushing for updates that allow the team to move forward. This is not a passive role. You flag stalled jobs, escalate when needed, and take initiative to get answers without being asked. If you are organized, persistent, and comfortable on the phone with insurance representatives, this role is built for you.

How the Job Pipeline Works

Understanding the full workflow is essential to succeeding in this role:

  • A new job comes in — you verify it meets the intake requirements and track it in the system
  • You ping the sales representative to confirm the inspection date has been set
  • Once the inspection date is confirmed, the job moves to the next stage and a claim number is assigned
  • You monitor all active jobs — if a job has been sitting without progress for too long, you bring it to the Operations Manager's attention immediately
  • You contact the insurance company by phone and email to obtain required claim documents, following up weekly until received
  • Field technicians go out, take photos, and capture data — that data is entered into the platform to generate the inspection report
  • You use the report to write the estimate and submit it to the insurance company
  • Once submitted, you follow up with the insurance company on the appraisal status — calling and emailing until you have an update
  • You communicate appraisal updates clearly to the internal team
  • Once approved, the information is sent to invoicing and the job moves forward to completion

Key Responsibilities

Job Intake & Pipeline Tracking

  • Receive and log incoming jobs, verifying they meet the required criteria before moving them into the active pipeline
  • Track all active jobs through each stage of the process — from intake through inspection, claim submission, appraisal, and invoice
  • Maintain an accurate, up-to-date job tracker so the team always knows exactly where each job stands
  • Proactively identify jobs that have stalled or been sitting without progress and escalate them to the Operations Manager before delays become problems

Sales Team Coordination

  • Ping sales representatives to confirm inspection dates have been scheduled for new incoming jobs
  • Follow up consistently until confirmation is received — do not wait for the information to come to you
  • Move jobs through the pipeline stages as milestones are hit and document each transition

Insurance Company Communication — High Volume

This is one of the most critical and time-intensive parts of the role.

  • Contact insurance companies by phone and email to request and obtain claim documents, adjuster assignments, and claim numbers
  • Follow up with insurance representatives weekly — or more frequently when deadlines are approaching — until all required documents and approvals are received
  • Track the status of submitted estimates and appraisals, calling the insurance company to check on progress and push for updates
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with adjusters — you know how to be persistent without being difficult
  • Document all insurance communications including contact names, dates, outcomes, and promised follow-up timelines

Inspection Report & Estimate Support

  • Coordinate with field technicians to ensure photo and data capture from job sites is submitted in a timely manner
  • Enter field data into the platform to generate the inspection report
  • Use the completed inspection report to write the estimate and prepare it for submission to the insurance company
  • Ensure all estimate submissions are complete, accurate, and sent to the correct insurance contact

Appraisal Process Management

  • Track all submitted estimates through the appraisal process — logging submission dates and expected response windows
  • Follow up with the insurance company on the status of submitted appraisals — making calls to confirm receipt, ask for timelines, and request updates
  • Provide clear, timely appraisal status updates to the internal team so everyone knows where each job stands
  • Once appraisal decisions are received, communicate the outcome and relevant details to the operations and invoicing team so the job can move forward

Invoicing Handoff

  • Upon appraisal approval, compile and send the required information to the invoicing team
  • Ensure all documentation needed to close the job is organized, complete, and transmitted without delay

Required Qualifications

  • Prior experience in operations coordination, claims coordination, or a similar role in construction, restoration, roofing, or insurance-related services
  • Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls to insurance companies, adjusters, and internal team members
  • Persistent and proactive by nature — you follow up without being asked and escalate before things become urgent
  • Highly organized with the ability to track multiple active jobs at different stages simultaneously without losing detail
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills — your phone calls are professional and your documentation is clear
  • Reliable in a remote environment with a quiet workspace and high-speed internet

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with insurance claims, adjusters, or the property damage restoration process
  • Familiarity with construction or restoration job management platforms and reporting tools
  • Background in roofing, storm damage restoration, or property insurance claims coordination
  • Experience writing estimates or supporting the estimating process in a construction or restoration context

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You look at the job tracker every morning and immediately know what needs to move today — without anyone telling you
  • Insurance companies hear from you on a regular, consistent schedule — not whenever you happen to remember
  • No job sits in your pipeline without a status, a next action, and a follow-up date
  • You escalate stalled jobs before the Operations Manager has to ask about them
  • You are the reason jobs move forward — the team counts on you to keep the pipeline flowing from the first call to the final invoice

Requirements

This is a full time role

Up to $6/hr

100% Remote

Launch your product career at Europe's leading music education platform

Matchspace Music is Europe's leading music education platform. We help thousands of music teachers build sustainable careers from teaching, and we are scaling fast across international markets. You will work directly with our VP Product.

This is a role for someone hungry. You want to see how a product is discovered, specified, built, shipped, measured and improved, and you want to be hands-on across the whole cycle. Everything we build follows one cycle: build, measure, learn, repeat. We are looking for a sharp analytical mind that is also creative in solving problems and providing fresh insights. In return you get a front-row seat in building AI-powered platforms, an AI-first way of working, and high visibility to the leadership team as we grow internationally.

Tasks

  • Feature conceptualization. Turn evidence into product ideas. You will run the full loop, from insight, to concept and options, to a sprint-ready story, and back to the data to see whether it worked.
  • Requirements engineering. Turn customer insights and support feedback into clear, buildable user stories with business context, acceptance criteria and edge cases. Own the qualification funnel so nothing rots and no ticket enters a sprint under-specified.
  • Sprint operations. Run backlog hygiene, standup and review mechanics, dependency flags and blocker tracking with our development team, so decisions get made once and stay made.
  • UAT, QA and testing. Own regression and release testing. Reproduce defects properly, keep the bug board honest, and support UAT and end-to-end dry runs.
  • Analytics and performance measurement. Own recurring KPI reporting across our tool stack, close measurement gaps, and turn funnel and cohort data into insight the team acts on. Every feature we ship is measured against the question: did it work? What was the impact?

Requirements

  • A relevant degree in business engineering, IT, information systems, digital business administration, or a related field, whether ongoing or recently completed.
  • Analytical and creative. You enjoy digging into data to find the real problem, and you are creative about how to solve it. Build-measure-learn is how you already think.
  • Structured and detail oriented. You find clean documentation and reproducible analysis satisfying, not tedious.
  • Comfortable with data. Excel/Sheets at a solid level, able to read dashboards, willing to learn fast
  • Comfortable and confident with software development technicalities, with viewing software code and understanding code with the help of AI
  • Proficient in German (min. B2) and English (C1). You can write a requirement someone else can build from. Your main operating language is English. German is essential for our Swiss home market.
  • Already using AI tools in your daily productivity workflow and genuinely curious about how software gets built.
  • Self-managing in a fast-moving, distributed team.

Nice to have

Agile/Scrum exposure, ticket systems, manual QA or test-case experience, and an interest in music, education or marketplaces.

Benefits

  • Work directly with the VP Product in a dynamic, cross-functional team spanning Product, Marketing and Customer Success.
  • Full end-to-end exposure: discovery, requirements, delivery, release, measurement and growth.
  • A front-row seat at Europe's leading music education platform, with real breadth across very different product challenges.
  • A modern, AI-first working culture.
  • A high-visibility talent role with direct exposure to the leadership team and an attractive international career trajectory as we scale.

We run a short, structured screening built around real examples of your work and how you think. Tell us who you are, why this role, and when you can start. We will take it from there.

Job Description - Product Marketing Manager

Reports To: Director of Product Marketing

Department: Marketing

Location: Remote

Position Type: Full-Time

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Product Marketing Manager to join our dynamic marketing team. In this role, you will develop and execute marketing strategies for our home care software products. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including product management, sales, and customer success, to ensure our products meet market needs and drive growth. You'll be our champion for understanding the voice of the customer and market trends, translating those insights into actionable strategies, and crafting the narratives that resonate with our target audiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver biweekly training and communications to educate customers and customer-facing teams on newly released features.
  • Own go-to-market strategies for new and enhanced products, including sales enablement, marketing campaigns, and collateral development.
  • Conduct market research to identify customer needs, industry trends, and competitive landscape, owning battlecards, ROI tools, and competitive analysis.
  • Gather and analyze customer feedback to identify areas for product improvement and innovation.
  • Analyze market data to support product positioning and go-to-market plans
  • Develop distinct messaging and value props for various product lines and define target audience and segments.
  • Collaborate with the product team to ensure alignment between product features and market demands.
  • Develop marketing collateral, including product datasheets, case studies, whitepapers, webinars, and presentations.
  • Field ad hoc content and support requests from sales team with marketing collateral, training materials, product demos, and competitive analysis.
  • Work closely with product management, sales, and customer success teams to ensure alignment on product strategy and messaging.

What We're Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.
  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in product marketing, preferably in the software or healthcare industry. Experience in home care, skilled care, or IDD software is a plus.
  • Skills:
    • Strong understanding of marketing principles and product lifecycle management.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to craft persuasive messaging.
    • Proficiency in market research, data analysis, and competitive analysis.
    • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
    • Familiarity with marketing tools and platforms (e.g., CRM systems, email marketing software, analytics tools).
  • Attributes:
    • Analytical mindset and strong problem-solving skills.
    • Detail-oriented and highly organized with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
    • Creative thinker with a passion for understanding customer needs and delivering impactful marketing solutions.
    • Team-oriented with strong intrapersonal skills.
    • Self-starter, motivated by helping others succeed.

Working Conditions

  • Manual dexterity required to use desktop computer and peripherals.
  • Utilization of software and email to perform job functions.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
  • Medical insurance premiums are covered in full for the employee (Medical, Dental and Vision) 
  • 401K with competitive company matching.
  • Personal time off, sick leave, and holidays.
  • Company will provide laptop and other needed computer equipment.

About AxisCare

According to Pew Research, roughly 10,000 baby boomers turn 65 every day, and the American Society on Aging calculated that an American has a 70% chance of needing help with activities of daily living such as dressing, bathing, hygiene, etc. This has led to an unprecedented increase in Home Care agencies in the U.S. and abroad who strive to help those who have difficulty helping themselves, specifically offering non-medical (also referred to as non-skilled) services to seniors in their homes.

AxisCare was started in 2011 by industry leaders to help meet the demand for a more userfriendly and mobile-compatible solution. Our product is a web-based management platform that helps agencies manage CRM and marketing, Caregiver/Client scheduling, billing, payroll and much more. Headquartered in Waco, TX, AxisCare has clients in all 50 states as well as 7 other countries. We are a fast-growing company seeking high-performing individuals looking for a fast-paced, autonomous working environment.

Become a part of our caring community

The Manager, Quality Improvement implements quality improvement programs for the Kentucky Medicaid line of business. This includes quality compliance and quality improvement activities such as the annual Quality Improvement program description, work plan, and annual evaluation, as well as oversees, plans, and implements new and existing health plan quality improvement initiatives, including Performance Improvement Projects (PIPs), medical records documentation audits, and Early Periodic Screening Diagnosis and Testing (EPSDT). The Manager, Quality Improvement works within specific guidelines and procedures; applies advanced technical knowledge to solve moderately complex problems; receives assignments in the form of objectives and determines approach, resources, schedules and goals.

The Manager, Quality Improvement is responsible for monitoring and implementing activities related to quality improvement and quality compliance for both behavioral and physical health. The Manager, Quality Improvement is responsible for developing, implementing and monitoring the success of the quality assurance and performance improvement program and monitoring the success of quality improvement interventions, including EPSDT. The Manager, Quality Improvement works to coordinate resources and manages department reporting, audits processes as needed for compliance, completes and submits reports to internal committees and state regulators as required.

Decisions are typically related to resources, approach, and tactical operations for projects and initiatives involving own departmental area. Requires cross departmental collaboration and conducts briefings and area meetings; maintains frequent contact with other managers across the department. The Manager leads a team of both clinical and non-clinical associates and will need to travel as needed for state meetings and participate in other internal and external multidisciplinary meetings.

Essential Role Functions and Responsibilities

The Manager, Quality Improvement is responsible for managing a team of associates responsible for implementing the Kentucky Medicaid Quality Assurance Performance Improvement program. Essential role functions and responsibilities includes, but is not limited to:

  • Managing daily operation of member/provider outreach program
  • Managing ongoing medical record documentation review for physical and/or behavioral health
  • Managing on-going quality improvement activities for both physical and behavioral health based off analysis of performance measures (example HEDIS, CAHPS) or other quality measures (other satisfaction surveys, or other access or services measures)
  • Managing EPSDT processes and performance
  • Monitoring and reporting progress towards goals for performance and focus measures.
  • Completing quality related reports for various state and internal committees

Use your skills to make an impact

  • 3+ years of experience leading member-facing professionals or conducting direct member engagement, with demonstrated results.

Preferred Qualifications

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. 40

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

Who We Are:

AcuTech Group, Inc. is a premier provider of process safety, risk management, chemical security, industrial fire protection engineering, and emergency management services. We have deep expertise in Process Safety Management (PSM), Training, Implementation, Auditing, Process Hazard Analyses (PHA’s), Hazard and Operability Studies (HAZOPs), Quantitative Risk Assessment (QRA) and Facility Siting, among other engineering and consulting services. AcuTech has deep specialization in the oil and gas, chemical, LNG, petrochemical, renewables, hydrogen, and other industries handling hazardous materials. Our industry experts deliver these services to leading privately held and publicly traded companies, as well as government agencies, and state sponsored entities globally.

About The Job

AcuTech Consulting Group is seeking a Maritime Safety & Regulatory Consultant to support maritime safety, security, emergency management, and regulatory compliance projects associated with LNG facilities, marine terminals, port infrastructure, and energy transportation systems.

This role will support a variety of consulting projects involving the U.S. Coast Guard (USCG), FERC, PHMSA, terminal operators, engineering firms, and other maritime stakeholders. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical writing, analytical, and project coordination skills, along with an interest in complex maritime and energy infrastructure projects.

This position is well-suited for candidates with experience in maritime operations, emergency management, LNG or terminal operations, regulatory compliance, marine transportation, or operational risk analysis.

What You’ll Do:

Maritime Safety & Regulatory Support

  • Support development of Waterway Suitability Assessments (WSAs) under 33 CFR Part 127.
  • Participate in maritime risk assessments, navigation safety evaluations, and SIMOPS evaluations associated with LNG, crude oil, and marine cargo operations.
  • Conduct research and analysis related to USCG, FERC, PHMSA, TSA, and international maritime regulatory requirements.
  • Assist in development of Facility Security Plans (FSPs), Facility Security Assessments (FSAs), Emergency Response Plans (ERPs), and related regulatory documentation.
  • Prepare technical reports, presentations, regulatory summaries, and client deliverables.
  • Support emergency planning, operational risk evaluations, and consequence analysis activities.

Project Coordination & Client Support

  • Coordinate with clients, engineering teams, pilots, emergency responders, terminal operators, and regulatory agencies.
  • Support stakeholder meetings, workshops, and project coordination activities.
  • Track project schedules, deliverables, action items, and regulatory commitments.
  • Assist with development of briefing materials, meeting summaries, and executive-level communications.

Data Analysis & Technical Support

  • Support GIS-based and quantitative risk analysis activities.
  • Conduct research related to vessel traffic, marine operations, weather, tides, currents, and navigational constraints.
  • Collect, organize, and analyze technical data associated with maritime transportation and infrastructure projects.
  • Assist with development of hazard registers, risk matrices, and operational analyses.

Business Development Support

  • Support proposal preparation, technical scopes of work, and client presentations.
  • Assist with development of marketing materials and professional content related to maritime safety, security, and regulatory compliance.
  • Participate in strategic growth initiatives supporting maritime, energy, and critical infrastructure clients.

What’s Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Maritime Studies, Emergency Management, Engineering, Environmental Science, Homeland Security, Transportation, Criminal Justice, or related field preferred
  • Minimum 3+ years of relevant experience in maritime operations, LNG or energy infrastructure, emergency management, regulatory compliance, marine transportation, operational risk analysis, or consulting environments
  • Experience with the following:
    • USCG maritime safety and security regulations, including 33 CFR Parts 105 and 127, as well as FERC and PHMSA regulatory environments
    • LNG marine transportation operations, terminal infrastructure, SIMOPS evaluations, and marine operational risk analysis
    • Emergency response planning, incident management principles, and maritime security/risk assessment methodologies
    • GIS platforms, technical writing, data analysis tools, and development of technical/regulatory deliverables
  • Strong technical writing, communication, and organizational skills
  • Ability to synthesize complex technical and regulatory information into concise deliverables
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a consulting environment
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities

What’s Preferred

  • Prior military, Coast Guard, port operations, terminal operations, or marine transportation experience is highly desirable
  • Professional communication skills with clients, regulators, and project stakeholders
  • “Seller-Doer” mentality with the ability to both execute technically and grow client relationships

raw.description:
Cloud / Network / Cybersecurity Engineer – Infrastructure & Security | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Cloud / Network / Cybersecurity Engineer to support and maintain secure, reliable, and high-performing technology infrastructure.

Depending on your background and specialization, this role may focus on cloud engineering, network infrastructure, cybersecurity, DevOps, systems administration, or a combination of these areas.

You’ll help configure and monitor infrastructure, troubleshoot complex technical issues, manage access and authentication, support security operations, and contribute to infrastructure deployments and upgrades.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical troubleshooting skills with a practical understanding of networking, cloud environments, systems, and security best practices.

What You’ll Own

Cloud & Infrastructure Management

  • Configure, monitor, and maintain cloud and infrastructure environments
  • Support platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, GCP, or related technologies
  • Monitor infrastructure health, availability, and performance
  • Assist with infrastructure deployments, upgrades, and configuration changes
  • Help maintain reliable and scalable technical environments

Network Engineering & Troubleshooting

  • Configure and support network environments
  • Troubleshoot network, connectivity, DNS, routing, and infrastructure issues
  • Diagnose complex technical problems across systems and environments
  • Monitor network health and performance
  • Help maintain reliable connectivity across business systems

Cybersecurity & Security Operations

  • Implement and maintain security best practices
  • Monitor systems for potential security issues
  • Support security-related troubleshooting and incident response
  • Help identify infrastructure vulnerabilities and operational risks
  • Collaborate with relevant teams to improve the organization’s security posture

Identity & Access Management

  • Manage user access, permissions, and authentication
  • Support appropriate access controls across systems and platforms
  • Troubleshoot authentication and authorization issues
  • Help maintain secure access practices
  • Assist with onboarding, offboarding, and access changes when required

Monitoring & Incident Response

  • Monitor systems for performance, availability, and security issues
  • Investigate alerts and technical incidents
  • Support incident response and troubleshooting
  • Identify root causes and help implement corrective actions
  • Escalate critical infrastructure or security issues appropriately

Infrastructure Automation

  • Identify repetitive infrastructure tasks that can be automated
  • Build or support automation for routine technical processes
  • Improve consistency and efficiency across infrastructure workflows
  • Reduce unnecessary manual administration where possible

Documentation & Technical Operations

  • Maintain clear technical documentation
  • Document infrastructure configurations, processes, and troubleshooting procedures
  • Keep operational and security documentation current
  • Support repeatable processes for deployments, incidents, and system changes

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with engineering, IT, security, and business teams
  • Support technical projects and infrastructure initiatives
  • Communicate technical issues clearly to relevant stakeholders
  • Help coordinate deployments, upgrades, and operational changes

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in network engineering, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, DevOps, systems administration, or a related infrastructure role
  • Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, GCP, and/or enterprise networking technologies
  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity concepts and security best practices
  • Experience troubleshooting complex technical and connectivity issues
  • Understanding of user access, permissions, and authentication
  • Experience monitoring infrastructure, networks, or systems
  • Strong technical documentation skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Professional working English
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Relevant technical certifications
  • Cloud certifications related to AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • Networking or cybersecurity certifications
  • Experience with infrastructure or task automation
  • Experience supporting incident response
  • Experience with identity and access management
  • Familiarity with DevOps and deployment workflows
  • Experience supporting distributed or cloud-based environments

Tools & Technologies

AWS | Microsoft Azure | Google Cloud Platform (GCP) | Enterprise Networking | Identity & Access Management | Infrastructure Monitoring | Security Tools | DevOps & Automation Technologies

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Can troubleshoot complex technical problems methodically
  • Understand how networks, systems, cloud infrastructure, and security interact
  • Think about security as part of everyday infrastructure operations
  • Stay calm and organized when responding to technical incidents
  • Look for opportunities to automate repetitive work
  • Maintain clear documentation rather than relying on tribal knowledge
  • Communicate technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Take ownership of problems through resolution

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include reviewing infrastructure and security alerts, troubleshooting a connectivity issue, managing user permissions, supporting a cloud deployment, or investigating a technical incident.

You may also update infrastructure configurations, automate repetitive tasks, document technical processes, and collaborate with engineering or IT teams on deployments and upgrades.

In short: you help keep the organization’s infrastructure secure, reliable, accessible, and running smoothly.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Infrastructure availability and reliability
  • Network and system performance
  • Speed and effectiveness of technical issue resolution
  • Security and access-control compliance
  • Successful infrastructure deployments and upgrades
  • Effective incident response
  • Reduction in repetitive manual infrastructure work
  • Accuracy and completeness of technical documentation

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Infrastructure / Technical Interview
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have experience in cloud infrastructure, network engineering, cybersecurity, DevOps, or systems administration and enjoy solving complex infrastructure and security challenges, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help maintain secure, reliable, and high-performing technology environments.

Job Description:

DXC Technology is a leading enterprise technology and innovation partner delivering software, services, and solutions to global enterprises and public sector organizations — helping them harness AI to drive outcomes at a time of exponential change with speed. With deep expertise in Managed Infrastructure Services, Application Modernization, and Industry-Specific Software Solutions, DXC modernizes, secures, and operates some of the world's most complex technology estates.

The Client Success Manager (CSM) is a pivotal role responsible for driving client satisfaction, fostering account growth, and ensuring operational excellence within client engagements. This role focuses on managing all aspects of service delivery, advocating client needs, and collaborating cross-functionally to achieve desired outcomes. The CSM is responsible for key performance indicators including TCV, revenue, contract margin, and client satisfaction, while also playing a vital role in driving client retention and overall account success.

**Hiring Seasoned Client Success Manager with Healthcare industry focused in California**

What You´ll Do

  • Being Responsible for and owning ALL aspects (both project and run) of CES delivery on the account, including contract renewal, client satisfaction, profitability, resourcing, oversight of billable roles assigned to the account and service level agreements, thereby ensuring consistent high-quality execution across all engagements and meeting margin expectations.

  • Collaborating effectively with other offerings to deliver a consistent, full-stack experience for the account when needed, ensuring coordinated communication and clear ownership across all product deliverables from delivery through maintenance.

  • Carrying responsibility for on-account growth, focusing on driving opportunities, including pipeline development, proactive solutioning, change control and accurate forecasting of revenue and contract margin.

  • Serving as the central lead for all account activities outside of sales and Client Partner (CP) responsibilities, driving alignment and execution across internal and client-facing teams, and providing strategic oversight and progress reporting to the CSM Leader.

  • Drive effective client partnership by aligning on resourcing strategy—ensuring clients assign capable, knowledgeable resources that complement DXC teams, and intervening strategically to resolve resourcing gaps or constraints.

  • Drive financial governance by ensuring disciplined cash collection, proactively addressing AR challenges, and serving as the key decision-maker for issue resolution

  • Ensure delivery and commercial compliance by partnering with Project Managers to meet contractual obligations, maintain accurate internal systems, manage change controls, and drive post-project learning and improvement.

  • Collaborate effectively with peer CSMs—particularly within multi-layered or large account environments—to ensure consistent client engagement, coordinated delivery, and seamless sharing of insights and account intelligence.

  • Serving as the voice of the client within CES, advocating for their needs and expectations, aligning delivery teams to client priorities and desired outcomes acting as the central point of escalation for client issues.

  • Driving operational excellence on the account, implementing governance structures, tracking key performance indicators (KPIs) and identifying areas for continuous improvement.

  • Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams (e.g., delivery, sales, marketing, and product) to align on client objectives, escalate risks, and surface new opportunities for value creation.

  • Deep understanding of CES and DXC offerings to ensure DXC solutions are driven to the needs of the client.

Primary KPIs

  • TCV

  • Revenue

  • Contract Margin

  • Client Satisfaction (References, CSAT & NPS)

  • Operational and Delivery Excellence:

-Scope, SLAs, audits, risks, service governance/timely reviews with customer, etc.

-Productivity: On-time, great quality, within budget, LPI, right shoring, proactive rotation of talent, automation, lean, adherence to DXC standard tools, architecture, etc.

-Operational Excellence: Workforce planning, Billability, utilization, compliance, risk governance, etc.

-Pipeline: Own & win opportunities

​Secondary KPIs

  • Client retention rate

  • Churn management

  • Champion talent management by fostering development and engagement through coaching, mentoring, recognition, and succession planning

Key Competencies:

  • Client Relationship Management - Building trusted partnerships

  • Delivery Excellence & Project Leadership - On-time, quality execution

  • Value Realization & Business Impact - Demonstrating ROI

  • Account Growth & Expansion - Renewals and up/cross sells

  • Internal Orchestration & Collaboration - Team coordination

  • Resilience & Customer-First Mindset - Adaptability under pressure

  • Digital Agility & Continuous Learning - AI and technology adoption

Who You Are

  • Proven experience in client relationship management, demonstrating the ability to build, maintain, and leverage trusted partnerships to grow accounts.

  • Experienced Senior Client Success Manager with clients within Healthcare Industry

  • Authorized to work in the Us without requiring sponsorship now nor in the future

  • Strong background in delivery excellence and full lifecycle project leadership, with a track record of on-time, high-quality execution within budget.

  • Ability to demonstrate value realization and business impact, showcasing a clear understanding of ROI for clients — turning their requirements into reality while understanding market trends and clients’ competitors’ activities to offer the best solutions.

  • Experience in account growth and expansion, including successful renewals and up/cross-sells.

  • Demonstrates exceptional capability in internal orchestration and cross-functional collaboration, aligning diverse teams to deliver shared objectives while effectively managing risk, leading account escalations, and driving internal change initiatives.

  • ·Demonstrates resilience and a customer-first mindset, with the ability to adapt under pressure and prioritize client needs.

  • Demonstrates a commitment to continuously strengthening digital acumen, maintaining awareness of emerging AI and technology adoption trends, and applying this knowledge to clearly articulate DXC’s offerings and boundaries.

Compensation at DXC is influenced by an array of factors, including but not limited to the experience, job-related knowledge, skills, competencies, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. A reasonable estimate of the current compensation range for this position is $95,900 - $178,100.

raw.description:
We are looking for an experienced, highly organized Business Operations Coordinator to keep the firm running well and to own the operating processes behind our executive team, our partner program and our business development data.

This is not a traditional administrative assistant role. You will support the Managing Partner and other leaders, but you will also own areas of the business end to end. We want someone who notices what needs attention, closes the loop without being reminded, improves recurring processes and puts spare capacity to productive use.

What you will own

Executive scheduling and firm coordination

  • Manage calendars for the Managing Partner and other members of leadership, anticipate conflicts and propose solutions.

  • Arrange travel, expenses submission and in-person logistics for the Managing Partner and other leaders.

  • Coordinate internal, client, prospect and software-partner meetings across multiple calendars, including client calendars when authorized.

  • Schedule interviews for candidates advancing through our ATS and make the candidate experience responsive and professional.

  • Set up Zoom and Teams meetings, prep sessions and materials. Book in-office days and meeting space through Regus or similar providers.

  • Run regular check-ins with leadership, maintain action lists and follow up with owners so commitments do not disappear after a meeting.

Partner program operations

  • Maintain the operating record for each software partner agreement: deal registrations, referral submissions, commission and referral revenue tracking, certification requirements and renewal dates.

  • Maintain relationship maps of partner sales and alliance contacts, including the accounts and territories each covers.

  • Flag to leadership when representatives from different partners are working the same target account.

  • Coordinate partner-facing logistics: portal access, co-marketing assets, joint meeting scheduling and follow-up.

Salesforce and business development data

  • Own Salesforce data quality: keep account and contact records current, find and fix stale or inconsistent data, and drive the right person to supply missing information.

  • Enrich accounts and contacts from conversations, public sources and partner intelligence so that account history and context live in one place.

  • Perform account and contact research and build target lists in support of the SDR and leadership.

  • Set up and maintain outreach lists and sequences in Mailshake for the SDR and produce simple outreach activity reporting.

  • Maintain the firm's purchased and subscribed data sources and recommend additions or corrections.

  • Build productive working relationships with executive assistants at clients, prospects and partners.

Onboarding, offboarding and systems

  • Own administrative onboarding for new employees and associates: first-month schedule with the manager, introductions, accounts, licenses, access and basic firm information.

  • Be the first point of contact for new people during their initial weeks.

  • Administer licenses and user access across Google Workspace, Zoom, Lucid, Salesforce, our ATS, Mailshake and other SaaS tools; identify unused licenses; coordinate AWS and Amazon Business account administration with the responsible engineer.

  • Maintain the firm's access and credential inventory in the approved password manager, enforce MFA on administrative accounts, and remove access within one business day of a departure or role change.

  • Manage Zoom cloud recordings and verify storage and delete redundant copies.

  • Maintain naming conventions, folder structures and short written procedures so records can be found by anyone.

LinkedIn, website and external providers

  • Publish LinkedIn posts from content supplied by leadership and marketing, and keep the company page consistent and professional.

  • Make routine WordPress updates to the website and coordinate larger changes with outside resources.

  • Coordinate external marketing, graphics, content and legal providers: hand off assignments clearly, track open work and route completed deliverables to the right person.

Presentations, spreadsheets and meeting support

  • Build and format client-ready PowerPoint presentations from content supplied by leadership and subject-matter experts.

  • Build and maintain Excel trackers, lists and basic analyses using formulas, filters, lookups and pivot tables.

Continuous improvement and learning

What we are looking for

What Sets Us Apart

At DataCatalyst, you’re not a cog in a machine—you’re a trusted partner. Our culture is defined by:

  • Quality of Life: With our fully remote, low-travel model, you can do challenging, high-impact work without sacrificing personal priorities. We believe great consulting doesn’t require endless flights or late nights—it requires focus, autonomy, and sustainable balance.

Ready to Apply?

At DataCatalyst, we enable enterprises to transcend data disorder and gain clarity—fostering smarter, faster decision-making. Required:

  • Proven experience with SAP integration points between FI-PS-CO, including internal orders, cost centers, and profitability analysis

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills with ability to diagnose complex system and process issues
